chapters.title: Chapter 801 Evelyn's Priorities
paragraphs: "Father, what are you doing?" Evelyn turned around and looked at the man covered in bandages.
From her tone, everyone could feel that she was not happy.
"My daughter, this is not the right place to talk. We will talk once we return home." Fader spoke, then looked at all the other participants in the war.
Who had paused after Evelyn's outburst.
"Let's end this here for today." Some of the Crooked got so angry at that tone.
Was it a game that he could end whenever he wanted? This is a war!
They wanted to attack, but right then, a single loud word resounded.
"Return!!" All the crooks were startled, this was the voice of one of their top leaders.
Despite being filled with grievances, they could only turn back and leave.
The one whom Evelyn had almost killed and the ones who got captured by her were the first to escape.
Evelyn could only watch as all the Crooked just left, then the higher beings, as if nothing had happened, chatted and began to return.
The war had become nothing more than a game for them. Crooked appears, they fight, war ends and they return.
No surprises, no suspense.
Evelyn just teleported away, soon arriving back in the higher being realm, going straight to the cloud realm to meet her father.
Before long, her father returned to the cloud palace and went straight to his throne and slumped down on it.
Losing all the air of a leader from earlier, appearing lazy.
"So, my daughter, you want to know why I did that?" Before Evelyn, Fader broke the silence.
"Yes." Evelyn nodded, her anger was because of Evel though.

"The death of each Crooked or higher being is a very big matter. It has been after a very long time and much bloodshed that we were able to achieve this balance." Suddenly, in a serious tone, he spoke.
"Even a single death will result in breaking this balance. The Crooked want to achieve their goals, but even they know an all-out war will result in big casualties on both sides."
"So, whatever might have made you angry, it wouldn't be good if your anger led to such a war." Fader finished.
"..." Evelyn sighed. He is right. If she really killed him, it might have blown into something very big.
But if she were to see that woman again, she would still do her best to kill her, even if her father or grandfather got in the way.
"Forget that, we got to solve the issue with that realm." Fader suddenly changed the topic.
"How did it go?" Evelyn questioned.
"Of course, we got our rights to the realm back." Fader replied as if stating the obvious.
"And what is the cost you had to pay?" Evelyn narrowed her eyes, fully aware of how stubborn those Asura could be.
"..." After a brief pause, he smiled and spoke with a laugh. "The Asura Empress proposed a marriage, she wants her son to marry you."
Evelyn: "..."
She looked around, finding nothing, so she walked towards the heavy seat placed on the side.
She picked it up and swung it towards her father's head.
BANG
"W- Wait, my daughter, l- listen to me first, oof!" Fader did his best to dodge but, in the end, the brutal attack from his daughter struck him hard.
Fader rubbed his forehead, looking resentfully at his daughter. He had fallen behind his throne.
Evelyn was really pissed off, first her father and grandfather made that Armin her fiance against her wishes.
And now this again? Do they think she is some product they can use however they want for their benefit, sell her off to the highest bidder?
"Then explain, how is it my dea- I mean dear father." Evelyn asked, setting down the heavy seat she had picked earlier.
"You..." Fader huffed, that dead was definitely not a mistake.
"It's not like I agreed to their conditions, I told them that my daughter is already engaged to Armin of the Garissa family!" Fader said.
"..." Even though Evelyn doesn't participate in her family's or higher beings' politics, she quickly understood one thing.

"Are you trying to use me to create problems between those brute Asuras and the Garissa family? I understand the Garissa family part, but why would the Asura want to form this connection?" Evelyn asked.
If this really was their plan, then thinking of the arrangements they made over such a long time surprised her.

"Well, it's nothing too complicated. They might not be as ambitious as the Garissa or others, but they cherish talent and strength, and you don't lack either. Of course they would want you to be a part of their family, so my daughter, if given a chance, who would you want to choose?" Fader asked curiously while he held his throne protectively.
This wild daughter of his might start attacking him at any moment, you never know when she would make you see stars.

"Oh right, you have the Asura Empress's son, right? Though it must have been quite long, I heard he is quite impressive..." Fader shut his mouth in time, seeing the unpleasant expression on his daughter's face.
Of course Evelyn remembered that brute, all-muscle-no-brain burly man, who would fight anyone in sight.
He wasn't as disgusting as Armin but still, not the one she loves. Unfortunately, she cannot tell her family about Vritra yet.
As it will only increase his problems.
"None. When I select someone, I will tell you and he would be far better than the two of them..." Evelyn was speaking but then noticed the suspicious look on her father's face.
He might act like that, but he catches on quickly so she hurriedly changed her words.
"Anyway, I don't like either of them. Your goal really is to make both sides fight huh." She returned the question to him.

"Yes, sorry to use you like that, my daughter, but it's something your grandfather wanted. He wants to take complete control of the Garissa family and weaken the Asuras even slightly." Fader replied, not really hiding anything from her.
"Sigh Alright, play whatever games you are playing among yourselves, don't disturb me." Evelyn turned and started walking back to her room.
But she also knew that although one could be cancelled, she would still have to be engaged to one of the two.
Based on who the winner between Armin and that brute is, it made her feel uncomfortable, but for now she can't do anything about it.
"Bye my daughter, don't worry, I will handle these things." From behind, Fader said, waving his hand.
Soon Evelyn was back in her room with several things in her mind.
The first issue was this fiance thing, now that both the Asuras and the Garissa are in the picture.
It will only get too troublesome. The Garissa will definitely see through all this, and she wondered what they will do then.
Putting that matter aside, Evelyn was also worried about the issue with that Evel. Why does she speak as if Evelyn was the first to steal something from her?
Or was it just the resentment all Crooked feel? That she stole her existence?
But all that could wait, the existential crisis and the fiance crisis, more important right now is...
"Watching my darling love's matches!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 802 The Final Match
paragraphs: "Regrettably, this is the final match of this wonderful journey that seemed to have lasted for decades yet was too short!!" Uranus's loud voice reverberated throughout the god's arena.
The people, whose number was the highest it had been ever since the beginning of the battles, were shouting and cheering.
They were obviously very excited but wished these battles could continue to go on.
It was a pity that they were ending just after three weeks, which also made it more exciting.

"In today's final battle, all seven participants from team A will be fighting against Lord Art from team B; it is going to be very special. Hold your breath and let's welcome our champions onto the stage!"
Just as Uranus finished speaking, a large amount of smoke rose over the stage, blocking the sight of everyone.
Then the seven women and Vritra on the opposite side appeared; their bodies were surrounded by condensed energy.
To the point that all the people could clearly see different-coloured flames dancing around them.
Some had more than one colour like Yennefer; no matter how much people focused, they couldn't discern what colour her mana exactly was.
Similarly for Vritra, the energy around him consisted of too many colours.
On the other hand, Fiona, Yasmine, and others had more than one colour but could be easily recognized.
Vritra looked at Yennefer; her body had been acting strange recently, more specifically after her strength had suddenly increased.
She couldn't control it, but her affinity with all sorts of elements seemed to have increased by a big level.
If she is not careful, then the beautiful empress might get lost in those very elements.
He would just have to pay more attention.
Not to mention, this was going to be their final day of peace; from the very next day, things would get too violent.
And who knows how many enemies would pour in to attack him.
'The games will be starting soon as well.' He thought, but for now he needed to focus on fighting all his wives.
He had mostly seen and learnt their abilities through the battles over the days, so it won't be too difficult a battle.
{Sin Points Gained: Cheered +999,999}
{Sin Points Gained: Expected +999,999}
{Sin Points Gained: Awed +999,999}
{Sin Points Gained: Expected +999,999}
Seeing the sin points that were now pouring in millions, Vritra was very satisfied.
Initially he had not expected this much from these battles, but this was great; there were more than a million people seated here.
The seats needed to be increased, so Vritra used the spatial ability to get more seats inside.
Although the ones sitting at the back looked like ants from his position, they could perfectly clearly see everything.
It was all thanks to Teresa; she really is a genius when it comes to creation.
If that creation mythic halo had gotten into her hand instead of Divine's, maybe the skill she would have created would have power off the charts.
Clearing his mind, Vritra looked at all his wives, smiling.
"Please go easy on me." He spoke.
"Hehe Don't worry hubby, we will be very gentle." Yasmine replied with a chuckle; the dialogues of the two sides had interchanged.

"Here, all of you drink this. These are something I have been working on for a long time. The Perfect Defence potion; it is based on Onest's skill. As long as possible, even if you are careless, your body will dodge automatically. The Perfect Offense, which will increase your overall power by nearly two times for a duration of 30 minutes." Diana spoke.
And as soon as she took out the potions, a high vitality aura spread all over the place, even outside the island.
"Is it alright to use something so special for just a practice match?" Teresa held the two types of potions, five bottles of each.
Each of them had gotten ten bottles.
"Yeah, wouldn't it be a waste? It would be better to use them for real battles after all." Yennefer spoke; she too could sense how special these potions were.
All of them looked in amazement at the goddess; her skills had increased to such an extent.
None with such skills existed in the entire Zoratian planet.
But when did she exactly practice? Even with so little time, she had progressed so much?
'If she is given truly powerful materials and more recipes, then what sort of monstrous potions would she create?' Even Vritra was amazed.
But he didn't get any potions.
"It is fine, you can use them." Diana replied nonchalantly.
"Nothing for me?" he asked, eyes narrowed and staring at the goddess.
"Heh Of course dear, there are some for you but you aren't allowed to use any in this battle." Diana replied as she gave him ten potion bottles.
Vritra looked at them curiously; one red and the other blue, bubbling over inside the bottles. He had an urge to try them out.
But held back.
"I wasn't going to use them anyway in this fight." Vritra shrugged as he put them away.
"No no, it's not because your strength would increase too much, but it's just I haven't tested it enough yet-" As Diana was speaking, the other six women looked at her strangely.
Was this goddess using them as guinea pigs? So she only cares about Vritra and not them?
"What? They are not safe? Are you trying to cancel out the competition? Hmm?" Maeve questioned, her tails moving from side to side.
The people outside couldn't hear what was happening but the wait only made them more curious.
Meanwhile, Uranus was entertaining the crowd with his commentary.
Diana felt six piercing gazes; clearing her throat, she spoke hurriedly:

"I am going to consume these too; of course they are safe for consumption. I have already tested them but-" Everyone became uneasy at that but and waited; the next words would decide if they would give the potions back or not.
"Your physique, I don't know anything about it, so it might act more potent and lead to accidents here." She finished and everyone finally relaxed.
"..." Vritra nodded as he ran his gaze over all of them.
Diana is a goddess, Fiona is a phoenix, Yasmine is a dragon, Vanessa is a succubus, Yennefer and Teresa are humans, while Maeve is a demon.
When it comes to special physique, Yennefer has one too, while the others also have special physiques but not as mysterious as hers.
"What about me then?" Yennefer had the same doubts.
"It will be fine, probably." Diana said, shrugging, so Yennefer too put away the potions for now.
Her body was already being so strange; she wouldn't want to increase its strength and disappear into the air.
"Alright then, let's start the battle." Vritra said with a clap, pulling their attention towards him.
Diana took the lead to consume the two potions; her strength increased rapidly and the air around her body began to tremble.
Absolute offense and absolute defence in position.
The others did the same after slight hesitation but soon felt that the worries were for naught.
The auras of the six women grew quickly, making everyone feel awed.
"Darling, let's start!" Fiona spoke as red flames burst out of her body and soon she transformed into an enormous phoenix, glowing so brightly, lava seemed to flow down her body.

chapters.title: Chapter 803 The Explosive Strength
paragraphs: All the people trembled as they saw the beautiful yet dreadful phoenix, a tiny spark of her flames would be enough to burn them to death.
Her long feathers made of flames burned brightly, mesmerizing everyone.
Then Yasmine jumped into the sky, her body transforming into an enormous white dragon.
ROAARRRRRRR
She let out a thunderous roar, making the floor tremble, the scales on her body covered by dense mana.
Diana floated upwards gracefully, her body covered by white divine light, she didn't undergo some major transformation.
But the ethereal light had equally boosted her strength while making her look extremely beautiful.
The appearance of the goddess had instantly taken away the attention of all the people.
There were too many dreamy sights, the dragoness, the phoenix, now the goddess.
Next it was Maeve's turn, nine tails appeared behind her. After thinking for a bit, she decided not to go all out.
So she just ended it there, with her shadow ability, she liked staying in the shadows anyway.
It is easier to change the tide of the battle at any time.
Vanessa too transformed, but for others she looked the same as before.
Horns appeared on her head and a tail on her back, now perfectly looking like a succubus.
Yennefer had no flashy transformation, she just floated above, various elemental energies revolving around her.
Teresa swiped her hand across the air and she just disappeared, leaving the people confused.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +999,999}
{Sin Point Gained: Expected +999,999}
All the audience looked at Vritra, waiting to see if he would have any special transformation.
After thinking for a bit, he decided to use the half demonic dragon transformation.
Under over a million watchful eyes, black scales appeared around his arms, shoulders, neck and so on.
While two demonic horns appeared on his head and a purple energy burst around his body.
"The battle begins!!" Uranus announced, holding the railing of his stage tightly, almost falling over.
Vritra extended his hands, as large blood chains shot forward like snakes, unlike before he took the lead to attack.
On the other side, the dragoness and the phoenix stood at the front, Maeve disappeared into the shadows.
Yennefer, Diana and Vanessa decided to support them with long-range attacks, while Teresa was still nowhere to be seen.
BOOOM
The temperature of the arena suddenly rose as both Fiona and Yasmine roared, shooting out flames.
The chains collided, stopping for a moment before rushing forward again.
'Undying: Bind!'
The red flames on Fiona's body turned into two giant hands that moved towards the chains, grasping them and pushing them back.
"Null: Reverse." Yennefer spoke softly, surprising Vritra.
Using the match with such a powerful skill? But before he could intervene, the chains of blood he had shot disappeared.
"Wall Bind!" Teresa's voice sounded as if just beside his ear, and the space began to tremble.
Invisible walls appeared around Vritra, completely trapping him inside.
This was a skill Vritra had seen before so he didn't think much and used brute force to break the wall.
BANG
He created a staff with Goop and struck the wall.
But the moment it touched the wall, it simply passed through, while what came from the other side was not a staff.
It was flowers.
If it was just a physical wall then it could be broken easily, but this was tricky.
Vritra touched the wall with his finger and when it came from the other side, his skin, blood and bones turned into flowers.
He quickly pulled back, the others were also amazed to see such an imaginative binding method.
"Master, you didn't forget me, did you?" just then Maeve's voice sounded, as playful as ever.
The shadows like a tsunami consumed the entire binding room, cutting off Teresa's senses.
"What are you doing?!!" Teresa asked in bewilderment, did they have an imposter in their team?
"Hehe Just wait." Maeve smiled and pointed towards the shadows which then transformed into the form of a room.
In the next instant, loud sounds of explosions rang out, the space inside cracked, destroying everything that existed inside.
'W- What? Isn't this just a friendly match?' Teresa looked at Maeve with even more doubt, was she really an imposter in their family?
"Don't worry, this much won't do anything to master." Maeve spoke confidently, even while using full power to bombard that shadow box.
"O- Oh, will Lord Art be alright? That looks too dangerous, I thought they are his women, no?" someone in the crowd asked, trembling all over.
"T- This is crazy, just how powerful are they all? I want to grow strong like that, Lord Art is my role model!"
"Buy this potion, it will make you as strong as Lord Art within days, don't believe me? Buy it and see for yourself."
"Buy this skill sphere, the Shadow World, the one used by the leader of the best information organization, Maeve Arclis!"
All sorts of conversations were going on amongst the audience as they watched the brutal battle.
Although the other women were a bit worried about Vritra, they also believed this might not even leave a scratch on his body.
So, all of them got ready to launch powerful attacks.
A cloth floated around Vanessa, soon transforming into a huge finger that kept growing in size.
Seeing that she was charging a powerful attack, the others took the front.
Diana also began to charge up a strong attack.
She had been to the Tomb of the Gods, and this skill was truly terrifying so she decided to only use 50%.
As the divine light around her body began to brighten up, various huge images began to form behind her.
As if the gods themselves had descended, becoming more and more lifelike.
HUM
But suddenly, everyone's attention was grabbed by the shadow box which was now shaking violently.
HUM
Another strange sound rang out then cracks began to form all over it.
"It will be broken soon, get ready!" Maeve announced as she jumped back and disappeared into the shadows.
CRACK
Finally, the shadow box glowed from inside, and then burst out with extremely violent energy.
And Vritra's figure became visible, his right hand was raised forward, and it seemed he had just flicked a finger.
Nether Eye!
A third vertical eye appeared on Vritra's forehead, as a drop of blood flowed down from it.
Releasing an extremely powerful soul-corrupting wave, striking all seven of the women with high intensity.
Only Yasmine was the one who only staggered back a bit, otherwise was mostly fine, as Vritra held back greatly.
While the other women had their heads rolling.
They really felt like falling unconscious or even coughing up blood, had Vritra finally gotten serious?
And the answer was given to them in the next moment.
[Cry Baby Activated!]
The vertical eye on his forehead remained there, blood tears softly flowing down his face.
Vritra's body trembled as his aura intensified, the skills becoming far more deadly but that was not enough.
The aura alone was making them feel a bit suffocated.
[SUCK! SUCK! SUCK! Activated!]
Vritra inhaled, pulling out a vast amount of mana from all his wives' bodies, as his body began to glow even brighter.
The Cry Baby skill strengthening everything about him, raising it to an unbelievable level.

sentences.text: All the people trembled as they saw the beautiful yet dreadful phoenix, a tiny spark of her flames would be enough to burn them to death.
Her long feathers made of flames burned brightly, mesmerizing everyone.
Then Yasmine jumped into the sky, her body transforming into an enormous white dragon.
ROAARRRRRRR
She let out a thunderous roar, making the floor tremble, the scales on her body covered by dense mana.
Diana floated upwards gracefully, her body covered by white divine light, she didn't undergo some major transformation.
But the ethereal light had equally boosted her strength while making her look extremely beautiful.
The appearance of the goddess had instantly taken away the attention of all the people.
There were too many dreamy sights, the dragoness, the phoenix, now the goddess.
Next it was Maeve's turn, nine tails appeared behind her.
After thinking for a bit, she decided not to go all out.
So she just ended it there, with her shadow ability, she liked staying in the shadows anyway.
It is easier to change the tide of the battle at any time.
Vanessa too transformed, but for others she looked the same as before.
Horns appeared on her head and a tail on her back, now perfectly looking like a succubus.
Yennefer had no flashy transformation, she just floated above, various elemental energies revolving around her.
Teresa swiped her hand across the air and she just disappeared, leaving the people confused.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +999,999}
{Sin Point Gained: Expected +999,999}
All the audience looked at Vritra, waiting to see if he would have any special transformation.
After thinking for a bit, he decided to use the half demonic dragon transformation.
Under over a million watchful eyes, black scales appeared around his arms, shoulders, neck and so on.
While two demonic horns appeared on his head and a purple energy burst around his body.
"The battle begins!!" Uranus announced, holding the railing of his stage tightly, almost falling over.
Vritra extended his hands, as large blood chains shot forward like snakes, unlike before he took the lead to attack.
On the other side, the dragoness and the phoenix stood at the front, Maeve disappeared into the shadows.
Yennefer, Diana and Vanessa decided to support them with long-range attacks, while Teresa was still nowhere to be seen.
BOOOM
The temperature of the arena suddenly rose as both Fiona and Yasmine roared, shooting out flames.
The chains collided, stopping for a moment before rushing forward again.
'Undying: Bind!'
The red flames on Fiona's body turned into two giant hands that moved towards the chains, grasping them and pushing them back.
"Null: Reverse." Yennefer spoke softly, surprising Vritra.
Using the match with such a powerful skill?
But before he could intervene, the chains of blood he had shot disappeared.
"Wall Bind!" Teresa's voice sounded as if just beside his ear, and the space began to tremble.
Invisible walls appeared around Vritra, completely trapping him inside.
This was a skill Vritra had seen before so he didn't think much and used brute force to break the wall.
BANG
He created a staff with Goop and struck the wall.
But the moment it touched the wall, it simply passed through, while what came from the other side was not a staff.
It was flowers.
If it was just a physical wall then it could be broken easily, but this was tricky.
Vritra touched the wall with his finger and when it came from the other side, his skin, blood and bones turned into flowers.
He quickly pulled back, the others were also amazed to see such an imaginative binding method.
"Master, you didn't forget me, did you?" just then Maeve's voice sounded, as playful as ever.
The shadows like a tsunami consumed the entire binding room, cutting off Teresa's senses.
"What are you doing?!!" Teresa asked in bewilderment, did they have an imposter in their team?
"Hehe Just wait." Maeve smiled and pointed towards the shadows which then transformed into the form of a room.
In the next instant, loud sounds of explosions rang out, the space inside cracked, destroying everything that existed inside.
'W- What?
Isn't this just a friendly match?' Teresa looked at Maeve with even more doubt, was she really an imposter in their family?

chapters.title: Chapter 804 The Hunter
paragraphs: Cry Baby, it was the skill he had gotten after that criminal punishment tournament that Vritra had done.
And that war against the various entities was the first time he used this skill.
When he saw Vanessa's clone being killed, it broke him and he cried, activating it.
It was at that time that his strength rose rapidly, even his Dust skill was forcefully upgraded.
Aside from Titan Fall and a very highly charged Nuclear Fist, this was the skill that gave him the highest boost.
He had used it again against that Drino, and it had certainly helped him.
But now, he had learned how to activate it on his own, rather than waiting for a chance.
Through the Nether Eye!
The heads of people sitting even outside the arena began to buzz, despite the thousands of protective barriers.
Loud crying noises started to ring out, making all the women even more dizzy, as they held their heads.
Vritra was just standing there but the floor under his feet began to crack, the floor that didn't break despite the heavy attacks after so many days.
THUMP THUMP
His heart was beating so rapidly, veins clearly visible over his arms and neck, overflowing with mana.
It seemed as if he had become the very core of the planet, containing an endless stream of it.
[Strength Field: 100% Activated!]
Vritra's muscles expanded slightly before contracting, his entire body thumped like a heart.
Everyone around felt as if strength was leaving their bodies, they felt as if they hadn't slept for days and had been working out nonstop.
All their muscles aching.
While each muscle on Vritra's body contained extreme strength, he felt just flicking his finger would be enough to make space crack.
[Agility Field: 100% Activated!]
Strong wind began to storm around the arena, there were no visible changes on his body but for Vritra the world seemed to have slowed down hundreds of times.
Using these fields which had completely saturated, he can connect with the very rules of the world.
Borrow their power, and the jump in his fighting prowess would be explosive.
[Endurance Field: 100% Activated!]
Again, rapid changes occurred in his body, it appeared far tougher than even Shitless's metallic body.
His skin became a little shiny, and his organs were all covered by a faint layer of light.
"Uh... W- What's going on? What is hubby trying to do?" Yasmine in her dragon state panicked for a moment.
In this fight they were going to use more strength but wasn't he going overboard?
It's like bringing a real tank when they decided to fight with swords, just Cry Baby was overkill and now even this?
Thankfully he didn't activate any of the other fields, or other abilities.
"Can we still fight against darling?" Fiona asked, her eyes filled with doubt.
She also wanted to test her strength.
The seven women looked at Vritra in confusion, has the game changed from fighting to survival?
Vritra opened his eyes, it only took a couple of moments for all the transformations to take place.
"Y- You damned fox, did you make husband angry?" Yennefer glared at Maeve; she really wanted to go ahead and pull her tail.
"I- It's not my fault, I... uh it must be Teresa, yes, she is the one who trapped master first, did he get angry at us?"
But this was no time to chat, Vanessa who had been charging her attack all this time, had finally finished.
She had used a vast amount of energy and this was a treasure given by the divine.
She was sure this can stop Vritra, at least for a while, giving others the chance to attack.
BANG
Without a second thought, she threw it forward.
THUD
The finger was just midway when suddenly Yennefer fell to the ground and a faint red mark appeared on her forehead.
She stared at the sky in confusion, wondering what had just happened?
She was floating above just a moment earlier and suddenly she was down here?
Even the pain was delayed.
"Ouch." She felt a stinging pain on her forehead, while touching it she glanced at the spot Vritra was present.
He was still standing there and didn't seem to have moved, so how did he do this?
He didn't stop time, she has Null too.
'Oh right, Null, let me see what exactly happened.' Yennefer thought, and activated Null.
Instantly the scene played before her eyes very slowly, and she then saw the terrifying scene.
Vritra took a step forward and without even teleporting, he appeared right in front of Yennefer and then flicked her forehead.
Despite slowing down time, Yennefer found it hard to see how he exactly moved.
Was the Field of Agility so terrifying?
But then she saw something even more frightening, Vritra had flashed in front of all his wives.
Before returning to his original position.
But... but why flick only me?
Yennefer decided to play dead as she watched the scene, the finger appeared in front of Vritra.
BOOM
The explosive sound rang out as Vritra clenched his fist, the Field of Strength being exhibited to its maximum.
Pulling his arm back, he punched out at the mountain-like finger about to strike him.
CRACK CRACK
Space cracked like glass as his fist moved, and then the two sides collided.
BOOOOM BOOOOM
Space broke apart, the floor was unearthed, and all his wives were pushed back.
The large finger pushed forward for a moment, then it simply exploded, the cloth obviously wasn't destroyed.
But it instantly lost all energy and was thrown back at Vanessa who was struck and thrown back violently.
BANG
She was embedded into the floor.
Then came Fiona's turn.
Vritra inhaled and then let out a roar, as a wave of flames swept at the large phoenix.
Fiona let out a surprised sound, before getting buried deep into a large hole created in the unbreaking floor.
The other women were so startled, Diana didn't wait as she executed her ability.
Instantly, the god figures behind her rushed towards Vritra, with various skills.
"Forbidden: Divine Energy!"
[Forbidden Activated!]
The gods had just gotten close to Vritra when their bodies dissolved into thin air.
Diana: "..."
She had poured in more than half her mana into that attack for it to disappear just like that.
BOOM
Before she could think, the residual energies of the gods were shot back at her, making her body blast and embed into the ground beside Vanessa.
The demoness, Maeve, who was hidden in the shadows couldn't understand what to use.
But then another voice rang out.
"Forbid: Where there is air, shall no shadow exist!"
[Forbidden Activated!]
Instantly all the shadows disappeared from within the arena, leaving Maeve completely exposed.
"Uh..." Vritra snapped his fingers, and instantly a large piece of cloth which Vanessa was using fell onto her with terrifying force.
And she too got embedded into the ground.
Yasmine and Teresa gulped, both of them glanced at one another and decided to attack together.
"Forbid: Any who sees, cannot move!"
Their bodies froze completely, Vritra swiped his hand across the air as Teresa's figure got revealed.
Lying on the floor and watching all this with a red mark on her forehead, Yennefer felt chills all over her body.
Maybe she was lucky to be knocked out first.

chapters.title: Chapter 805 Bickering
paragraphs: Vritra floated in the sky and looked at his wives, aside from Yasmine and Teresa, all of them were already down.
If they were opponents, they would have already died.
He knew they were not going all out, but he was not either, there were still so many tricks he had held back.
Just Titan Fall alone would be enough to defeat them but Vritra was still not sure how to stop the skill once the task is done.
He didn't want to be destroyed like last time.
But now that he is a real titan, he doubted the situation would be that bad.
There were two reasons he suddenly attacked them like this, first he wanted to test his skills.
And secondly, to make his wives understand how to fight a stronger opponent.
"..." Yasmine in her dragon form stared at Vritra, then clearing her throat she asked:
"Are you going to attack?" Their bodies were completely frozen, so she asked mentally.
"Of course not." Vritra smiled faintly as he looked at Yasmine then looked at Teresa.
Although she was frozen, there were still quite a lot of treasures protecting her body.
And Vritra was surprised to find that she had actually created solutions for his skills.
So just after a few moments, her body disappeared again and somehow after a minute she was able to move again.
That skill has evolved and can now even restrain the gods, so Vritra was really curious how she managed to get free.
But it seemed she cannot free Yasmine.
Teresa launched an attack directly, sending sharp thin walls slashing at his waist.
Vritra didn't take her attacks lightly, his right fist turned absolutely black.
Resembling space as he used Null to turn it into something intangible.
Then he grasped at the thin walls she had thrown, and shockingly, it managed to slice through.
If given enough time, Teresa could really prepare to fight against any sort of opponent.
But her preparations for now were not enough, with a pinch Vritra destroyed the walls and threw the pieces back at her.
Oh!
BOOOM
As the pieces collided with her, Teresa's body exploded into countless pieces, startling everyone who was watching.
From Vritra to the audience.
For a moment, Vritra froze but soon understood what had happened.
'It was sort of a clone hmm no wonder she was able to move.' Vritra thought, still this was a top-notch skill.
He couldn't sense her real body or even tell if this was a fake, in escaping it could come in handy or fooling the opponent.
[Null Activated!]
With a wave of his hand, her real body reappeared in the place of the clone, still frozen there.
BOOOM
This time, the pieces struck her, blasting Teresa into the ground beside the others.
"Hello." Yennefer smiled and greeted her, being the first she felt she should do this.
"Uh hubby, I can drop down myself..." Yasmine said, as her body got released she simply fell down.
"Woah woah, what are we seeing? Did Lord Art just defeat everyone? S- So easily, he is that strong?!!!" Uranus's loud voice rang out, people were all still frozen.
The finale of the battle was crazier than they imagined, having seen something otherworldly.
"No, the battle is not yet over." Vritra shook his head, since this was the final day, he needed to milk it as much as possible.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched 999,999}
{Sin Point Gained: Amazed 999,999}
{Sin Point Gained: Revered 999,999}
The people were going crazy, almost all of them had already become Vritra's fans while the women, even the married ones were falling deeper and deeper.
He looked way too charming...
Vritra deactivated the three fields and the Cry Baby skill, while remaining in his half demonic dragon form.
"Do we still need to fight?" Yennefer glanced at the others.
They are all at the 3rd level, so how can there be such a vast gap. Is that how that Drino felt?
Poor guy must have been traumatized.
"Uh Looks like darling is not going to be so serious again but pfftt your forehead, it looks funny." Fiona climbed out of the deep hole and chuckled at Yennefer.
She was back to her human form, looking regal in her dress.
"Hahahahaha" Maeve hugged her belly and laughed out loud.
"Shut up!" Yennefer looked at the two angrily then rubbed her forehead, glancing at Vritra with resentment.
She would later make him pay in bed, she would suck him dry and leave him exhausted.
The mark quickly disappeared and so did the pain, all seven of them flew back up and faced Vritra again.
Another round started, this time both sides seemed equal but the power scale had increased once again.
The battle continued for several hours, even going a little late since this was the last day.
In the end, the two sides got exhausted and ended the match with a draw.
"And with this, my friends, we conclude the final battle in this God's Arena!!" Uranus announced, though like everyone.
He also felt it was a pity, this was a thing too good to be ending so soon.
All his wives left after the battle ended, they were really feeling a little exhausted.
While Vritra stayed behind, he floated at the centre and looked at the crowd.
"Thank you everyone for staying with us, it was fun, maybe we might do something even better in the future." He said and the dejected public instantly got happy.
They began to cheer for him, and another wave of sin points poured in.
He stayed there for a bit longer and as people began to leave and the number of points reduced, he too disappeared.
Though quite a lot of people wanted to meet him, for different reasons.
Most were women.
Some wanted to be his disciple, some wanted to be his woman and so on.
None of the men though dared to have any funny thoughts about Vritra's women, with a glare he can end them and their families.
Soon the enormous island got empty.
Back in the palace of the Yate family, around a big round table.
Gunter, Ava, Rich, Shitless, Onest, Vritra, Maeve, Diana and many others were seated.
They were chatting while eating, Rich was quite happy, the profits he had made in just these three weeks were more than half of his total net worth.
He really felt happy that Vritra is his friend and not an enemy.
Jean and Tiny also wanted to come to dinner here but they weren't allowed, sent away by Rich.
Though Sir Giant did stay to spend a bit more time with Teresa, he too was all smiles.
He was already old so he had long stopped worrying about useless things, and what could be more important than his family staying happy?
Shen had left since he was just too ashamed.

"So son, what are your plans going forward? Anything special or are you finally ready to be the head of this Yate family?" Gunter asked excitedly, but his excitement was stomped and crushed instantly.
"No, you can keep that position for now, I still have other important things to do. And I will be gone for a while." He announced.
"Again? Where? How long? Will it be dangerous? Are they all going with you? Do..." Ava threw a barrage of questions at him, her tone full of worry.
"Wait wait, calm down. Yes again and it is somewhere far. It will be a little dangerous and the 10 of us will be going together again." Vritra quickly answered all her questions.
Then added: "As for how long, I am not sure but definitely quicker than last time."
Vritra knew that only the 3rd level game takes so much time, the rest usually ends quicker as they are direct battles or shorter goals.
They might be more dangerous but also end fast.
And that's exactly what Vritra needs right now, to quickly gain levels and achieve godhood.
He wasn't sure about the journey from gods to higher beings though.
That can wait, and thankfully, in the next games, they would be able to use all their strength.
The 3rd game was really a shitty situation.
"Mugger, pass me that plate." Shitless spoke with his mouth stuffed with meat.
"Tsk You Baldy, don't eat too much or you will turn into that pig demon lord, a bald one at that." Onest clicked his tongue, pushing the plate further away.
"What? Pig? You are pig, your whole family is pig- oh wait, I shouldn't speak ill of your sons and wife pfft"
And the banter between the two began, Vritra had to step in so they don't make a mess of the dinner table.
"Haa Can you not fight for once? Why are you getting worse as time passes, I remember how lovey dovey you were back on the-"
"Ahhh Stop it!!" Shitless and Onest quickly shouted, panicking.
Finally they became quiet.
"Yea so, we will be leaving tomorrow." Vritra said, he hadn't told them before or they would worry each day.
"But... what about Yasmine? Will it be okay to take her there?" Ava asked, especially worried about her and her grandchild.
"Of course, I will be fine. Didn't you see earlier-" Yasmine said proudly, her head tilted up.
"Yea we did see, you fell without even getting attacked, it must have been the wind." Maeve spoke with a harrumph.
"I wasn't like a fish out of water as soon as someone flashed light." Yasmine retorted.
"Sigh not you two too." Vritra shook his head, it was fun to see them bicker.
But it wasn't always as fun, especially when they are talking about something important.
"Hehe we are just playing around." Yasmine shrugged, Maeve also chuckled, focusing on her food.

If they were opponents, they would have already died.
He knew they were not going all out, but he was not either, there were still so many tricks he had held back.
Just Titan Fall alone would be enough to defeat them but Vritra was still not sure how to stop the skill once the task is done.
He didn't want to be destroyed like last time.
But now that he is a real titan, he doubted the situation would be that bad.
There were two reasons he suddenly attacked them like this, first he wanted to test his skills.
And secondly, to make his wives understand how to fight a stronger opponent.
"..." Yasmine in her dragon form stared at Vritra, then clearing her throat she asked:
"Are you going to attack?" Their bodies were completely frozen, so she asked mentally.
"Of course not." Vritra smiled faintly as he looked at Yasmine then looked at Teresa.
Although she was frozen, there were still quite a lot of treasures protecting her body.
And Vritra was surprised to find that she had actually created solutions for his skills.
So just after a few moments, her body disappeared again and somehow after a minute she was able to move again.
That skill has evolved and can now even restrain the gods, so Vritra was really curious how she managed to get free.
But it seemed she cannot free Yasmine.
Teresa launched an attack directly, sending sharp thin walls slashing at his waist.
Vritra didn't take her attacks lightly, his right fist turned absolutely black.
Resembling space as he used Null to turn it into something intangible.
Then he grasped at the thin walls she had thrown, and shockingly, it managed to slice through.
If given enough time, Teresa could really prepare to fight against any sort of opponent.
But her preparations for now were not enough, with a pinch Vritra destroyed the walls and threw the pieces back at her.
Oh!
BOOOM
As the pieces collided with her, Teresa's body exploded into countless pieces, startling everyone who was watching.
From Vritra to the audience.
For a moment, Vritra froze but soon understood what had happened.
'It was sort of a clone hmm no wonder she was able to move.' Vritra thought, still this was a top-notch skill.
He couldn't sense her real body or even tell if this was a fake, in escaping it could come in handy or fooling the opponent.
[Null Activated!]
With a wave of his hand, her real body reappeared in the place of the clone, still frozen there.
BOOOM
This time, the pieces struck her, blasting Teresa into the ground beside the others.
"Hello." Yennefer smiled and greeted her, being the first she felt she should do this.
"Uh hubby, I can drop down myself..." Yasmine said, as her body got released she simply fell down.
"Woah woah, what are we seeing?
Did Lord Art just defeat everyone?
S- So easily, he is that strong?!!!" Uranus's loud voice rang out, people were all still frozen.
The finale of the battle was crazier than they imagined, having seen something otherworldly.
"No, the battle is not yet over." Vritra shook his head, since this was the final day, he needed to milk it as much as possible.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched 999,999}
{Sin Point Gained: Amazed 999,999}
{Sin Point Gained: Revered 999,999}
The people were going crazy, almost all of them had already become Vritra's fans while the women, even the married ones were falling deeper and deeper.
He looked way too charming...
Vritra deactivated the three fields and the Cry Baby skill, while remaining in his half demonic dragon form.
"Do we still need to fight?" Yennefer glanced at the others.
They are all at the 3rd level, so how can there be such a vast gap.
Is that how that Drino felt?
Poor guy must have been traumatized.
"Uh Looks like darling is not going to be so serious again but pfftt your forehead, it looks funny." Fiona climbed out of the deep hole and chuckled at Yennefer.
She was back to her human form, looking regal in her dress.
"Hahahahaha" Maeve hugged her belly and laughed out loud.
"Shut up!" Yennefer looked at the two angrily then rubbed her forehead, glancing at Vritra with resentment.
She would later make him pay in bed, she would suck him dry and leave him exhausted.
The mark quickly disappeared and so did the pain, all seven of them flew back up and faced Vritra again.
Another round started, this time both sides seemed equal but the power scale had increased once again.
The battle continued for several hours, even going a little late since this was the last day.
In the end, the two sides got exhausted and ended the match with a draw.
"And with this, my friends, we conclude the final battle in this God's Arena!!" Uranus announced, though like everyone.
He also felt it was a pity, this was a thing too good to be ending so soon.
All his wives left after the battle ended, they were really feeling a little exhausted.
While Vritra stayed behind, he floated at the centre and looked at the crowd.
"Thank you everyone for staying with us, it was fun, maybe we might do something even better in the future." He said and the dejected public instantly got happy.
They began to cheer for him, and another wave of sin points poured in.
He stayed there for a bit longer and as people began to leave and the number of points reduced, he too disappeared.
Though quite a lot of people wanted to meet him, for different reasons.
Most were women.
Some wanted to be his disciple, some wanted to be his woman and so on.
None of the men though dared to have any funny thoughts about Vritra's women, with a glare he can end them and their families.
Soon the enormous island got empty.
Back in the palace of the Yate family, around a big round table.
Gunter, Ava, Rich, Shitless, Onest, Vritra, Maeve, Diana and many others were seated.
They were chatting while eating, Rich was quite happy, the profits he had made in just these three weeks were more than half of his total net worth.
He really felt happy that Vritra is his friend and not an enemy.
Jean and Tiny also wanted to come to dinner here but they weren't allowed, sent away by Rich.

Shen had left since he was just too ashamed.

Vritra knew that only the 3rd level game takes so much time, the rest usually ends quicker as they are direct battles or shorter goals.

chapters.title: Chapter 806 The Games Hijacking Plan
paragraphs: They ate and chatted for a bit longer than usual, it was mostly Ava asking questions.
She was really worried about all their safety, especially Yasmine who is pregnant.
But Vritra reassured her, after all Yasmine still has the protective barrier given by the divine.
So maybe not even gods can harm her, divine had even beaten up the higher beings.
So, his strength is definitely very high, there shouldn't be a need to worry about Yasmine, still Vritra was worried about his wives.
"Still be careful, and just return home if it gets too dangerous." Ava said, she didn't try to stop them.
Seeing their strength earlier, she was sure they were dealing with matters she cannot understand.
So it was better to not bother them.
"Yes, we will be careful." Vanessa spoke, with a reassuring look.
Her strength was nowhere near Vritra but as the more mature one of the group, she would look over everyone.
Soon the dinner ended.
Onest and Shitless went to stroll around the kingdom since this was the day before chaos erupts.
While Vritra and his wives just strolled in the Yate realm, they had already travelled around enough.
Before Onest left, Vritra decided to have a chat with the divine.
Now that things were about to finally start, he needed to get answers for a few things.
So, with Shitless seated on top of Bullo, Vritra spoke: "I have a few questions."
"Ask away." Divine's voice rang out in his mind.
The others were looking on curiously but they couldn't hear it, making Vritra wonder if Divine was too shy.
Why doesn't he speak in front of others?
'What sort of games are we going to participate in?' he asked in his mind.
"I am not really sure, that will depend on you but since you have already completed the longer one the rest are pretty short but more dangerous." Divine replied, as usual while creating suspense.
'Depend on me? How? What exactly is the plan, I think it's time you come clean or something bad might happen to you.' Vritra asked in a serious tone.
"Something bad? Haa Anyway, like before we will need to hijack others' games, enter them, win them and steal their rewards!" Divine replied, his tone turning sinister.
Vritra was a bit speechless, then he focused on the wording and asked: 'Games? Are we going to play back-to-back games or something?'
"No no, we will... uh I mean you all will be participating in two games at the same time maybe, that way you can grow fast." Divine replied calmly.
The others stared at the silent Vritra and Bullo, who were just staring at each other, wondering how long this was going to continue.
Shitless scratched his head, wondering how exactly he can spread more evil into this world.
While Onest was thinking about how to hone his skills.
'Hmm That's not bad as long as we aren't facing monsters who can kill us with a snap. So how do we exactly go about it, you will just teleport us to the venue right?'
Vritra questioned, imagining that things would go just like last time, Divine must have already made the preparations.

"No no, I did make some preparations but since my other avatar is no more, because of the barrier it created for Yasmine, disrupting my plans a bit. I wasn't able to complete the plans." Divine said then continued: "So you just need to do a small task, that's why I said earlier it will depend on you."
Vritra felt like a headache was coming on, he had a really bad feeling about this.
'Okay, come clean and stop spiralling it, just tell everything in one go.' Vritra was quite irritated, his way of telling information was so bad.
He had to keep asking the right questions to pull out any important information.

"Alright alright brother-in-law, don't get angry. As you already know, quite a lot of people are out there to hunt you down and they will start popping here from tomorrow. So your only chance of survival is the games-"
Vritra glared at him for speaking so dramatically and overexplaining.
"Okay, so you will be going to the Gods' Office, and from there you will have to steal a few things and change a few things, that's all. Then you can participate in the games and win!"
Divine spoke innocently, then waited as if to get praised.
'...Okay so let's put aside the matters of games for a moment, how do we deal with the people who would be coming here?
And even if we leave, won't this planet be in danger? This plan seems like a mess, or do you just want to abandon all this?' Vritra asked, his eyes narrowing.

"Of course not, the first guests to arrive will be that friend Drino and his party and I am sure you can deal with them on your own, even if there is that Zihong. As for others, once the games start, they can't enter this planet anyway." Divine replied, he had thought it through, how dare Vritra call it a mess.
Vritra really felt like hitting Divine hard, but this guy wasn't going to show his true face after last time.
'And how exactly do I steal and change those things from the Gods' Office?' Vritra asked in exasperation, if he had that sort of strength would he need to worry like that?
"Ah don't worry, it will be ve~ery easy, like picking a fallen ball, you will know that tomorrow." Divine dismissed it and then without any warning.
MUHHHH
Bullo let out a loud sound and started running, making Shitless roll back as he barely managed to grasp its tail.
"Ieaaaaah Bu- Bullo wait- please wait a second!! Kiyaaaaaa Help me pitifulllll..." and soon the loud voice grew distant and disappeared.
The others were left standing there in surprise and confusion.
"Uhm So Husband what happened?" Yennefer was the first to break the silence, all of them were feeling very curious.
"Well the divine did share some important things. The games ahead will indeed be short- yea you heard it right, we will be participating in two games at once probably..."
Vritra explained whatever information he got to them all, Onest waited and listened.
He can tell these things to Shitless later, though it was pretty useless, he would just follow them wherever they go anyway.
"Oh, this plan seems messy. It will be too dangerous if you go to that office." Diana shared her worry, she knew that the gods have enough strength to wipe them all out in an instant.
It was not yet time to face those beings.
And normally they can't personally do anything but if Vritra were to barge into their office and try anything.
Then what more reason would they need to eliminate him? In fact they might even call for help and ask higher beings.
Saying that he is trying to mess with the games, complete annihilation wouldn't be an impossible possibility then.
Not to mention, Vritra is connected to the divine, if this news spreads too much then things would be even more troublesome.
"Yea it sure is." Vritra nodded, he wasn't sure either how this was going to work.
"Maybe Divine had really thought of something, let's wait I guess." Maeve said, trying to stay optimistic.
Though she was no less worried about Vritra.
"It's pretty late, let's return to our room." Vritra said, then looked at Onest: "Keep an eye on Shitless, don't let him wander off."
"I will, tell me if something happens." Onest replied and flew away in the direction of Monk Shitless.
While chatting with his wives, they entered the House of Darkness.
None of them were sleepy and since the end of current peace was getting close, none of them wanted to waste it by sleeping.
They stayed up, changing the topic to something light and joyous, laughing as they all shared different things.
After a while, Yasmine made a suggestion: "How about we all take a bath together?"
Maeve nodded while tapping over her cheek: "Hmm not a bad idea, I think we should."
"Yes! I mean, yea it's already pretty late and who knows when those people might come to attack so we need to be ready at all times." Teresa spoke, toning down her excitement.
"Good, since everyone agrees let's go!" Vanessa took Vritra's hand and pulled him towards the bathroom.
It was quite spacious and the bathtub was also big enough to have them all enter at once.
Of course, Vritra can change quite a few things with just his thoughts in the House of Darkness.
"Sure, it will take a long time to finish bathing though." Vritra chuckled, letting his mother pull him, while Fiona pulled his other hand.
Diana secretly pulled out a potion, which was full of tiny bubbles and pinkish in colour.
Without letting others notice her, she gulped it down.
Then an expression of confidence appeared on her face, today, she wouldn't lose, at least against the other women.
The goddess would last the longest against Vritra.
She wanted to take Yasmine's special title and be called: 'The Limitless Goddess'
Which is why she created that miraculous potion, though even with it, she can't defeat Vritra.
That isn't her intention anyway, this final day before the game starts, she will prove her dominance.
A faint grin appeared on Diana's face as she imagined the shocked looks on others' faces, especially Yasmine.
"What are you grinning about?" Maeve looked at Diana, her eyes narrowed and full of suspicion.
That smile definitely was because of something shady.
The demoness knew it but just couldn't prove it.

chapters.title: Chapter 807 Special Potion [R-18]
paragraphs: Entering the bathroom, Vritra took off his clothes while his gaze remained over his wives.
There was too much beauty and flashing all at once, as all of them started removing their clothes.
Despite having seen, touched and eaten it all quite a few times, the site was just as mouth watering.
He walked into the bathtub and felt relaxed upon getting into the cold water, the weather was warmer so it felt pretty good.
With thoughts about the words of divine still lingering in his mind, Vritra mind remained focussed on the sexy figures of the seven women.
"Hey quack goddess, why are you suddenly smelling like flowers?" Fiona also noticed the sweet smell emanating from Diana.
And they were sure she was doing some sort of foul play.
"I used a potion, how else? Anyway, you can continue chatting, I will be going up ahead." Diana said.
After getting naked she climbed into the bathtub, ignoring the other women she focussed on Vritra.
A beautiful smile appeared on her beautiful face, her pale milky skin looking smooth and soft.
Her thighs weren't too thick, compared to Maeve and others, but her figure was extremely sexy and face really beautiful.
With her waist moving in a hypnotizing manner, Diana made her way closer to Vritra.
A beautiful smile adorned her face, her eyes fixed on him.
"Dear, can you help me bath?" before receiving any answer from Vritra she softly settled on his lap, facing him.
"Mm You are smelling nice." Vritra said, his arms wrapping around her waist, as he pulled her closer.
He could tell she must have used some invention of her, and it certainly was making him more excited.
Or rather, making him want to take a bite off her.
"..." the other women glanced at her then shrugged, this was no competition.
They have enough time, so such petty tricks were useless.
"Hmm Are you getting bigger?" Fiona looked at Yasmine's breast and felt they appeared a bit bigger than before.
Or was it just her imagination?
"Are they?" placing her palms under her heavy boobs, Yasmine held them.
But it wouldn't be a surprise even if they did grow up a bit, she had heard such bodily change are normal in pregnancy.
She then glanced down at her belly, although very slight, but she could a slightly bugle.
Or again, was it just her imagination?
Fiona looked around, from vanessa, Teresa, Yennefer, Yasmine, Maeve and even that goddess, she looked the youngest in the room.
Thankfully, her body was well developed and she wouldn't lose in terms of her figure.
After tonight, who knows when they will get time to just relax like this or even get intimate like this.
So, she has to make the most of it.
"Fiona, the moves you showed during the battles, when did you create them?" vanessa asked curiously.
"Yea they were pretty cool, I also have some special ones in my mind after seeing them." Teresa added, appearing quite interested in this topic.
They chatted as the six women talked about different subjects as they turned on the showers.

paragraphs: Several figures flashed through the dark space, travelling at a speed so fast that they had far surpassed even light.
The one in the lead was a tree-like creature, his branches had spread in all directions, where various figures were seated.
From Drino to the other demi gods at the 3rd level, all were seated on the branches.
There were six other demi gods, aside from Drino and Mole.
After seeing Vritra's strength, Drino added a couple more demi gods just to be safe.
But his main force was still that 4th level demi god, he doubted Vritra can defeat him even with his high strength.
Drino while deep in thought and with a serious look on his face, kept shifting in his position, feeling as if something was poking his butt.
But he was sitting on a tree branch so he didn't put much mind to it, except that it wasn't a real tree.
"Oh dear, are you uncomfortable? Do you want to change your seats?" Mole asked in a gentle tone looking at his new favourite guy.
"Uh no thank you, I am fine here." Drino was pulled out of his thoughts as he replied awkwardly.
"It is fine lord, whatever he says you have to do it, he is also very strong." Lizzi, Drino's assistant's voice sounded.
'Shut up you bastard!' Drino cursed, he wasn't going to sell his soul or ass just to defeat Vritra.
Mole was moving forward at a high speed, he possessed a lot of skills, and this was just one of them.
It was far better than repeated teleportation though it did take a bit more time.
"Hehe Uff don't shift too much, I am a little tender there." Mole said in his thin old-man-like voice, giving a familiar smile.
"!!!" Drino shivered as he quickly jumped away from his position, landing right into the lap of a demi god.
He was seriously disgusted by this old tree, he is such a creep.
"Tsk What a joy killer, but I still like you. My Drino, after we are done, how about we do some overtime? I have a special branch I want to show you, it is a bit shrive-"
"Stop it! First we kill Vritra, we will decide other matters later." Drino shouted, he had never been this scared of anyone.
"Lord, just agree-" Lizzi suggested, but was cut off in the middle.
"Ah we are already here, and the fun was just getting started." Mole said regretfully, maybe he should have slowed down his speed a bit.
Or made the path a bit bumpy and applied random brakes, Mole licked his lips as he looked at Drino.
"Yes, this is the Zoratian planet. Our goal is simple, kill Vritra and leave, don't take him lightly and go all out from the start." Drino warned then looked back.
He couldn't see it but that level 4 demi god was surely there, he will definitely come to help.
"Don't worry my honey bee- COUGH I mean friend, I won't let anything happen to anyone." Mole reassured then finally got serious.
He looked at the planet and questioned: "So how do we find that guy?"
"It is easy, I can still locate one of his women. He should be around otherwise, once we capture her he will come on his own and we can use her as a hostage." Drino shared his plan.
He planned to set up various traps, he will make sure to kill Vritra no matter what.
It was early morning, the sun was rising and people were getting to work.
Many were going to work after a long time because they had been busy with the battles.
Some had earned enough to not do anything for years or even several lifetimes.
All people were happy and calm.
After the passionate and fiery night, Vritra barely slept for a bit before waking up.
Still, he wasn't feeling tired at all.
They took a bath together and changed into their battle armors, though Vritra has Goop so he didn't need anything.
While his wives got some treasures from Teresa.
Then they ate breakfast with Ava and Gunter, having short talks.
Finally, it was time to leave, and no one knew when they would return.
Ava was quite worried and sad, she wished they would just stay but since that was impossible she prayed for them to return safely.
"Art, be careful and return as soon as possible." Her eyes were teary as she spoke.
"Hmm I will be, don't worry." Vritra smiled and nodded as Ava came forward to hug him and his wives.
"Son, keep everyone safe." Gunter said, patting his shoulder.
Vritra nodded, after a short talk he stepped back.
"Uh we will be safe too." Shitless spoke, joining the group, and waving at them.
Ava and Gunter couldn't help but laugh at the way he acted.
They waved as the figures of the ten people disappeared, they sighed and were filled with worry instantly.
"Don't worry, they will be fine. Our son is very strong." Gunter said, putting his arm around Ava's shoulder.
"Mmm But where did Bullo go?" They looked around but couldn't see the monk's bull.
"Hmm that plan is not bad, even if his strength is high, once he is trapped in our encirclement he would have no choice but to die willingly." One of the demi gods spoke, nodding in agreement.
The six demi gods understood their parts perfectly, in fact they were quite excited about the rewards they would receive after this.
Not just from Drino and Mole but also from the Gods.

"Alright Drino, I will be your personal bodysui- COUGH bodyguard until the end of this operation. I will follow you like your shadow and be very close to you." Mole said, appearing right behind Drino.
"A- Anyway, you don't have to be so close. Let's go, I will first capture that woman, we can deliver her to the gods later for even better rewards-"
"Oh, are you planning to kidnap me?" a voice sounded from beside them.
"..." Drino looked up and saw a redhead, it was exactly the one whom he had almost kidnapped before.
"Yes you, see everyone, this is the woman we need to kidnap after we-" Drino suddenly paused, his gaze moving back to Yasmine.
'Wait, how is she here? Is this the ability of someone but none of these demi gods had seen her before...'
Drino was quite shocked, needing a second to snap back to reality.
He clutched his head and felt pain, wait was that a mental attack? No wonder his thoughts became jumbled.
"Hahaha So you came here on your own? What a great surprise!! Woman, you are stupider than I thought, to come despite being aware of the danger." Drino couldn't help but laugh.
While speaking he scanned the area but couldn't find anyone else around.
Vritra was nowhere in sight, so did she really come alone?
Or was it some illusion? What was the reality then?
BANG
Yasmine's figure transformed into her half-dragon state as she flicked a stone that hit Drino's forehead, making him land in Mole's arms.
"Oooh I knew it, you are finally accepting me, do you want to see that special branch? Do you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 810 The Competitive Waifus
paragraphs: Haa so comfortable, it's like returning to the mother's arms.
Drino sighed, the pain he just felt on his forehead disappeared and a warmth spread all over his body.
But he quickly snapped back to reality coughing out the strange scent that Mole was releasing that made him relax.
He jumped away from the tree, shivering.
"Damnit, y- you... you woman, how dare you do that?!!" Drino finally turned his rage from Mole to Yasmine and burst in rage.

"Hahaha What a clown, are you too scared of that wood guy? What a hypocrite, you can't say anything to him so you will take your anger out on others? Pfft Do you know what people like you are called? Barking dogs that only know how to wag their tails before the strong and bite at the weak."
"How dare you! Hoo Don't worry though, when I make your husband die, I will let you watch it." Drino quickly calmed down as Lizzi's voice sounded in his ear.
Yasmine glanced at the group of eight, asking: "Is it just you two?"
"Huh? Did you go blind? There are eight of us- what? Where are those six?" He rotated a full circle but couldn't find them.

"Oh, they were here just a moment ago haha what a tricky woman, too bad I have different tastes. But for my Drino, I will still have to capture you." Mole chuckled, his branches and roots expanding in all directions.
It wasn't just for attacking but also defence and to locate the missing six demi gods.
Even he couldn't tell what she had done.
"What, where are we?" one of the demi gods who was just looking at Yasmine, suddenly found himself standing in a forest.
The six were startled, Drino and Mole were gone.
"You came here to kill us, yet with just the eight of you? Haha That's kinda pitiful."
A mocking voice sounded, as the six demi gods looked up and saw six women. It was Maeve who spoke, nine tails appeared behind her.
From Vanessa to Diana, all of them were present there.
"Heh Look at their dumb faces, these good guys came here to deliver their souls to our darling." Fiona laughed too.
"How rude, you are in the presence of a real goddess, yet you are still standing? Kneel!" As Diana's voice resounded, the images of thousands of gods appeared behind her.
Pushing down at the six with immense pressure, her form appearing pure and godly, pushing the shocked demi gods to their knees.
"Tsk Don't get started on your own, let's compete and see who can defeat their opponent the fastest." Yennefer shook her head and interrupted.
"Uh I will divide the opponents then." Teresa said as she raised her hand, creating five enormous walls that separated the demi gods.
Vanessa smiled, all of them had certainly grown very strong, now fighting even the demi gods.

"Alright, let's get started. The last to finish will only be allowed to speak meow for three whole days!" Vanessa announced and before others could agree or refuse, she rushed in the direction of one of the demi gods.
"Uh... we haven't agreed to it yet..." Maeve tried to speak but it was useless.
So, she too flew in the direction of the closest opponent, enormous creatures of shadows rising all around her.
Yennefer directly teleported in front of the opponent Maeve was targeting.
"You- ugh I will remember this!" the demoness changed her direction at the last moment and took the opponent beside him.
Soon all of them were facing their opponents, not holding back at all, using strength and moves they hadn't before.
Diana created a hand symbol, opening the door of the God's Tomb while a tsunami of various potions rushed forth.
The opponent didn't even have time to get ready as he got smashed with the various effects of potions and powerful debuffs.
His body started to rot, spasm, shake and much more with all the rapid attacks.
Various statues of gods materialised behind Diana, attacking him, while she too attacked with a whip.
Fiona transformed directly into her strongest phoenix form, as her blood-red flames consumed everything.
Her opponent's body turned slimy as he tried to consume everything but it was Undying Mythic Halo, not something he could handle.
The opponent in front of Teresa was the most frightened, his body parts were floating away from him.
And that woman with her face covered with a veil was just moving a finger in the air, as if writing something.
Strange walls kept rising, each creating a different effect.
THUMP THUMP
CRACK
The walls collided and cracked, releasing unknown black energy that made his broken body disintegrate into tiny molecules.
This was something Teresa had learned from Vritra and Yennefer, to be specific, from their Null skill.
Using those walls to create an energy opposite of creation, it took a lot of time but she succeeded, calling it the energy of chaos.
And hence, Teresa was the first to completely annihilate her enemy.
In less than two minutes, she had killed a level 3 demi god, though instantly felt very exhausted.
She had used every bit of her stamina and energy in that single attack, if it missed or got countered, then her only choice would be to escape.
And another reason was that she didn't give her opponent any chance to attack or do anything.
The walls she had created initially weren't simple, they made her opponent hallucinate.
'I... did it!' Teresa was very happy, killing such a strong foe, finally made her feel that she was not lacking compared to others.
Then she threw out a small bell that quickly sucked in those particles.
The soul and physique would still be useful for Vritra so she had also taken the job to collect them.
After finishing all this she looked at others, they were also pretty close to winning.
Yennefer, who was destroying her opponent while controlling different elements was surprised to see Teresa win so quickly.
But what surprised her more was that energy, it was the first time she saw that.
Yet it was a bit familiar, she decided to ask about it later.
"I guess it's time to finish it." She mumbled, launching full power attacks.
The energy of the opponent got transformed into an explosive element, making his body explode and turn into pieces.
Then she captured the soul with a giant soul hand, giving it a squeeze to injure it before throwing it towards Teresa.
"Second." she added with a faint smile, as Teresa quickly collected the soul and physique.
She would collect the broken body, from which Vritra can absorb the physique.
Yennefer too joined Teresa in watching the others' matches.
Vanessa controlled the mind of her opponent directly, while the pinkish cloth wrapped around his body, cracking sounds ringing out.
BOOM BOOM
She channelled her energy into the treasure cloth, as suddenly the demi god turned into a blood paste, even the soul was disfigured.
At the same time, on the side the large phoenix created millions of tiny but explosive needles, sending them all crashing into the demi god's body.
TUK TUK TUK...
His body instantly turned into a filter before getting so thoroughly destroyed that he just became particles in the air.
