"Second." she added with a faint smile, as Teresa quickly collected the soul and physique.
She would collect the broken body, from which Vritra can absorb the physique.
Yennefer too joined Teresa in watching the others' matches.
Vanessa controlled the mind of her opponent directly, while the pinkish cloth wrapped around his body, cracking sounds ringing out.
BOOM BOOM
She channelled her energy into the treasure cloth, as suddenly the demi god turned into a blood paste, even the soul was disfigured.
At the same time, on the side the large phoenix created millions of tiny but explosive needles, sending them all crashing into the demi god's body.
TUK TUK TUK...
His body instantly turned into a filter before getting so thoroughly destroyed that he just became particles in the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 811 The Kitty in the Family
paragraphs: Both Vanessa and Fiona finished nearly at the same time, their opponents were thoroughly destroyed.
Their strength could be said to be at the very peak of level 3, though even the women weren't sure why there was such a difference between them and the opponents.
They were level 3 demi gods too and probably had been at the level for quite some time.
So why was their strength so high compared to these demi gods?
Is it because of their physiques and bloodlines? Were the cores they use to level up of different tiers or something too?
And Vritra, even without his skill, his strength surpasses the level 3 demi gods' strength.
Well, he is indeed a Titan so there is that too.
Teresa and the others all had these thoughts, but it wasn't a bad thing.

"Maybe... the demi gods don't get stronger over time after they level up, like two demi gods who level up at the same time don't necessarily possess the same strength. And even after several years, their strength remains at the same level without external stimulation." Yennefer shared.

"Yea, either the cores are different or the amount of energy we can absorb is different based on the individual person. But after we level up, our strength doesn't increase naturally unlike before." Teresa added.
Vanessa and Fiona too flew closer to listen to their discussion.
Teresa quickly collected the souls and physiques of the defeated demi gods.
"But of course, there are ways to get stronger other than leveling up." she added pointing to the absorbed physiques.
"Hmm you are right, so if a demi god stays locked and doesn't level up for a long time, his strength would stay the same." Vanessa mumbled.
Before it was different. They could level up by killing demons and others, or even just absorbing the mana from the air and environment would still increase their strength.
Even if slowly.
But now, they could only focus on other ways to increase strength, like Vritra strengthening his physique.

"It doesn't really matter for us, since we will be participating in the games quickly. I wonder if this level of strength will be enough to win, we don't even know yet what sorts of games we are going to enter." Fiona sighed.
It was surprising they would be fighting in two games at the same time.
But before that, it will depend on Vritra if he succeeds in doing the task in the Gods' Office.
And even before that they have to take care of all these people, especially that Zihong.
"Can husband really defeat a level 4 demi god? According to data I have analysed, the difference between two levels is like a mortal and a lord." Teresa added, maybe it's a bit exaggerated.
But everyone understood the difference.

"I am sure he has his plans, we just need to do our parts." Vanessa said calmly then she looked at the two remaining and added: "In any case, it seems they are almost done too, let's see who becomes the cat."
Maeve looked back and saw that only she and Diana remained, the others had already killed the demi gods.
"Tsk I can't lose!" she took out a potion and gulped it down, her power rapidly increasing.
Then she took out a treasure given by Teresa and used it.
It was a hexagonal plate that made the enemy freeze, unable to even move his energy.
"Ughhh" he struggled endlessly as the shadow blades continued to chop him down.
The goddess on the other side too noticed that others had finished.
She would've finished early too if this damned gate didn't take a bit of extra time to open.
'I am not going to lose to this fox, she is already a demon, it wouldn't be embarrassing for her to now become a cat.' Diana thought.
She has strange kinks but that remains between her and Vritra and in the bedroom, normally she is a dignified, respected and graceful goddess.
How can she do that?
But just then, Diana was baffled and almost lost her focus in the air upon seeing that fox use one treasure after another.
"That cheater..." there weren't really any rules but shouldn't they be fighting with their own strength?
"Annihilate him!" she gave an order as the countless statues of the gods began to glow.
All of them pointed their hands towards the demi god who was bound by the chains of divinity.
Then countless powerful rays of pure energy burst forth, hitting the demi god from all sides.
"Aghhhhhhh"
Maybe it was her bad luck but the demi god she had gotten had low attack power and speed but insanely high defence.
This piece of shit just wouldn't die even until just a little piece of his flesh remained, it kept squirming and trying to escape.
"Damnit-" Diana cursed and finally destroyed the last bit of it.
"Heh You lost, cute catty." Maeve chuckled, a gloating look on her beautiful face.
Teresa just collected the last two opponents and nodded, Maeve luckily finished just a second before Diana because of the treasures' help.
"You cheater-" Diana wanted to pull that demoness's tail so badly, feeling frustrated.
"No no, a cat doesn't speak human language, come on- wait you aren't planning to back out now, are you?" Maeve shook her head, sighing.
"Tsk tsk" Fiona joined in, looking on in disappointment.
"Hmph" Diana just decided to stay quiet, it's just for three days.
She will have to be the background character for 3 days and-
"Here let me help you out." Teresa being the kind person she is, decided to help Diana.
'Sigh I knew it, only she would come to my rescue. But how will she help me, is she going to take the punishment in my plac-'
But poor Diana was stunned as Teresa placed a white bracelet around her wrist.
There was a tiny glowing stone on it.
"Now for three days, you can only say meow, you won't accidentally break the punishment rules. It will disappear automatically later." Teresa said with a kind smile.
Diana was stunned, she tried to speak: "Meow?!!"
A cute sound came out of her mouth, like a confused hesitant kitty.
"Hahaha This is so fun, Diana, do you love darling?" Fiona asked, laughing non-stop.
"Meow!!" Diana nodded resolutely only to freeze, she glared and pointed at the redhead.
"Meow meow!" she threatened, but felt frustrated and fell silent.
She just won't speak, and she will pay them back later for this.
"haha Let's see what's happening outside, shall we?" Vanessa said, she could barely hold back her laughter.
She was the instigator of this all.
They were all inside a page of the dimensional book Vritra had given to them.
The moment Yasmine had arrived, Diana had used the Illusion Halo that was similar to Misty Essence Mythic Halo.
And kidnapped the six demi gods.
Teresa created a spatial window that only displayed what was happening outside.
The battle was yet to start, and right now Yasmine was facing both Mole and Drino.
"Can she fight them both though?" Yennefer asked, not yet sure about the whole plan.

"That tree, he is strong. Far stronger than these demi gods we just fought. His strength might be on a similar level to ours and it seems he had lived a very long life and collected a lot of treasures." Maeve shared, despite being away she can obtain quite a bit of information through the shadows.
She can even sense Mole's energy, it was one of the strongest among level 3 demi gods.
"Oh, looks like those six are already gone, that was quick." Mole suddenly looked in a particular direction as if seeing through space itself.
"W- What? They are already dead? Did Vritra kill them all?" Drino was shocked.
He had felt Vritra's strength first hand, but to kill six demi gods of the same level so quickly sounded quite shocking.
"I don't think so, it was some women." Mole replied, his gaze fixed on Yasmine.
Back in the page of the dimensional book, the six women were surprised to hear that. How does he know that?
Did he put something in the bodies of those six demi gods? That was the only possibility.
"Huh? But how do you know it?" Drino had the same doubt and he quickly realized something.
He looked at his butt and saw a few leaves sticking there, he hadn't paid them any attention earlier.
Shivering, he jerked them all off.
"Oh hoho My Drino, don't worry, they won't harm you." Mole said kindly, finding Drino cute.
Those leaves had already entered the bodies of them all, what's the point of this?
"Anyway, let's capture her and be done with it." Drino said, he was getting more and more afraid of Mole now.
"That's not a problem, whatever you say. Just give me a minute." Mole faced Yasmine, the entire air around him transforming.
The tenderness he showed towards Drino disappeared completely.
A branch moved forward at a high speed, Yasmine couldn't move out of the way and...
BANG
Some distance away from them all, a cloud of mist floated.
Two faint glows could be seen from time to time from inside it.
Despite watching the battle happening down below, the person present here didn't seem to be in a hurry at all.
'How foolish, he should've just remained hidden back on his little planet. Now he has even lost his only chance of survival.' Zihong couldn't help but laugh.
Young guys could sometimes be too hot-blooded and overconfident.
But where is the star of the party? Why hasn't he made his appearance yet?
Or was he just planning to make his wives fight for him?

chapters.title: Chapter 812 The Lizard Treatment
paragraphs: "Six are dead and these two... I wonder how long they will survive." Zihong looked down at the battlefield as if none of it mattered to him.
And honestly, he didn't care about those two.
His sole goal was to capture Vritra and with the strength of this body, that won't be a difficult task.
And it's not like he had not prepared other trump cards, just in case he brings a powerful treasure or something.
So if he and Vritra got into a fight, Zihong was confident that he can defeat Vritra.
Even if he uses that charged fist with high power, he had a way to counterattack it too.
Zihong just waited, he wasn't worried about any of them.
BOOM
Mole attacked Yasmine, the branches moving at extreme speed as they struck her body before she could react.
And suddenly her body exploded.
"Huh? She is that weak?" Mole muttered, both he and Drino confused.
"Wait... that's huh?" Drino pointed forward, and saw that instead of flesh and blood.
There were mechanical parts, it was as if she was some robot or something, but they quickly understood that it was not the real her.
"You stupid lizard, where are you looking?" The same voice suddenly sounded behind Drino.
He was startled and quickly swung a long sword around, hitting something tough but the sword couldn't cut through it.
Upon turning he finally saw her, Yasmine was there with white scales covering her body.
She easily stopped the sword, flames rising around her.
"A mere lizard dares to challenge the Empress of Dragons? Ha what a joke." Yasmine squeezed as the sword began to crack as she threw him away along with the sword.
"How dare you!!" Mole was instantly angered by that sight, how dare that woman hurt his lovely Drino.
His roots, branches, leaves all suddenly spread in all directions as he suddenly went berserk.
"Pfft what a pair." Yasmine shook her head, completely ignoring Mole as she flew towards Drino.
"You are going to die if you hurt my Drino, he is carrying my child!!"
Yasmine: "What the fuck?!!"
Drino: "What the fuck?!!"
Both of them froze in shock, looking back at the old strange tree demi god in utter shock.
Yasmine then looked at Drino.
"You uh are you sure you want to fight in your condition? A mommy lizard should just stay home you know haha" Yasmine couldn't stop her chuckle in the end.
"What the hell are you talking about?!" Drino couldn't control it anymore, glaring at Mole.
This was going too far.
"Take deep breaths sir, it's alright, even if you have to give birth to his children don't offend-" Lizzi called, calming him.
"Shut up you motherfucker, or I will put this tree bastard up your ass." Drino roared.
"..." Lizzi finally went silent, wondering when they did the deed.
"And you, what the fuck do you mean?" Drino asked, his eyes were bloodshot.
"Ah earlier when you were sitting on top of me, didn't you feel something? I planted my seeds in you, now after a few days, you will be giving birth to small Moles for me." Mole replied, happily.
It wasn't exactly as others might think about reproduction, it was completely different for Mole.
"Ugh fuck, I will deal with you later, first I have to take care of this woman. I am dragging you to the gods, you and your family are dead this time." Drino lunged in Yasmine's direction.
Mole also attacked at the same time, those six had died he can't let Drino get harmed.
But just before he could intervene, something heavy and solid collided into his back.
BANG
The impact was hard enough to make his stem almost snap, making him cough some sort of liquid.
"Ughh my back." Shitless stretched his body, as he kicked Mole and jumped away.
"You damned mugger, why did you push me so hard?" he cursed.
"Forget that, first let's deal with this tree first." Onest too appeared there, hands in pockets.
Mole looked at the two and could sense the two are at level 3 too, so for a moment he gave up on Yasmine and decided to kill them first.
WHOOSH WHOOSH
He attacked relentlessly, shooting all sorts of things at the two while preparing a powerful energy attack.
But Onest's body was automatically dodging all the attacks, not a single leaf or branch could even touch him.
While Shitless's metallic body wasn't affected in the slightest bit, he didn't possess mana and all his capabilities were related to physical prowess.
"I haven't used this skill, let's see how good it is." Onest mumbled as he spread his arms and suddenly his body was torn into two.
But then another part turned into a clone and the scene continued, within moments there were hundreds of clones.
It was the skill he had taken from that bandaged guy who worked for Red from Blood Bone Cult.
"Attack my minions!!" Onest shouted as hundreds of naked Onests attacked Mole at once.
The scene looked way too strange.
After creating so many clones, Onest was completely exhausted. Thankfully he still had many potions given by Diana, so he kept refilling his mana.
"W- Woahhh!!" Mole's eyes were glinting, honestly, Onest didn't look bad.
"Yes, come to me!" he spread his arms, trying to embrace him.
And the Onests didn't struggle, they just moved closer to Mole, latching onto him.
"Boys, Explode!!" Onest commanded after moving far away, Shitless also moved quickly.
On the other side, Yasmine transformed into her dragon form while Drino was also going all out.
But the difference between the two was too big, Yasmine was beating him so badly.
She still remembered how he attacked them last time, almost succeeded in kidnapping her and hurt Vritra.
The more she thought about it the more mad she became, this lizard dared to hurt her hubby, she would make him suffer so much that regret would be the only thing left in his mind.
Space trembled as she launched powerful mental shocks, that almost fried up Drino's brain, making sizzling sounds.
BOOM
Her claws struck Drino, every bone in his body began to crack as she followed with rapid attacks.
'W- What the hell? She is that strong too, but how?' Drino was utterly shocked, seeing the enormous figure of the dragon before him.
He became uncertain and began to feel a new sensation... fear.
The deadly look in those eyes made something in him crack, his confidence and fighting spirit began to break.
Yasmine didn't hold back, thrashing him worse than a punching bag.
She transformed into her half-human form, pulling out a weapon from her inventory.
Drino's wounds were healing at a rapid speed but the wounds accumulating were too many.
'H- How can I fight against monsters like that?!! I was stupid, w- why did I ever come back here?' he truly began to regret ever coming to get his revenge.
"You bug, how dare you come here with the intention of hurting my husband!" Yasmine's voice, full of rage, reverberated all across space.
The weapon Yasmine was holding was a bit strange, it was like a whip but like someone's spine.
It was created by Teresa with the pure intention of torturing the opponent, its strength depends on the strength of the user.
The dragoness swung the whip which struck Drino who was trying to create some distance, wrapping around his body.
"Ughh Aaaaaaaaah S- Stopppppp ahhhhhhhhh" loud screams reverberated as the whip like a snake kept coiling around him, tightening and digging into his body.
It was releasing some sort of poison created by Diana into his body, while attaching to all the bones in his body.
"I will burn it into your body, into your mind and soul, the consequences of hurting someone far beyond your level!" with a strong pull, Yasmine suddenly drew back the whip.
CRUNCH
"Aghhhhhh Nooooo" Drino felt such immense pain to the point that he didn't think was possible.
In battles, he had gotten a lot of injuries but why was this so painful?
He wanted it to just end, he will hide and never even think about Vritra, he was really, really scared.
"Helpppppp, Mole, Sirrrrrrrrr, help meeeeeee ahhhhhhh" as his bones got torn out of him, Drino began to beg.
Yasmine showed no mercy continuing with her torture.
On the other side, Mole saw this and went mad but his hands were full with these strange people, he was suddenly engulfed by a terrifyingly violent explosion.
That was too much to handle even for him, these psychos, Mole finally understood the severity of the situation.
"Hah how unexpected they are getting their ass beat up by these kids, this has to be a joke." Zihong shook his head, he had expected Vritra's family to be strong.
But they are far beyond expectations.
Thankfully he got this level 4 demi god body, so even at their strength, he can still kill them all.
"I guess, it is time to get involved now, it wouldn't be good if they all die after all." Zihong sighed and decided to lend a hand, he also needed to draw out Vritra.
And he will definitely appear once his family is threatened.
"Yo, where are you going?" but he had just had this thought when he heard a calm voice from the side.
"Oh Vritra, so you finally decided to come here huh." Zihong smiled, finally it was time to get started with his plan.
It was a bit surprising that he appeared here out of nowhere, but the moment Vritra appeared, he was caught up in the trap.

"Ughh my back." Shitless stretched his body, as he kicked Mole and jumped away.
"You damned mugger, why did you push me so hard?" he cursed.
"Forget that, first let's deal with this tree first." Onest too appeared there, hands in pockets.
Mole looked at the two and could sense the two are at level 3 too, so for a moment he gave up on Yasmine and decided to kill them first.
WHOOSH WHOOSH
He attacked relentlessly, shooting all sorts of things at the two while preparing a powerful energy attack.
But Onest's body was automatically dodging all the attacks, not a single leaf or branch could even touch him.
While Shitless's metallic body wasn't affected in the slightest bit, he didn't possess mana and all his capabilities were related to physical prowess.
"I haven't used this skill, let's see how good it is." Onest mumbled as he spread his arms and suddenly his body was torn into two.
But then another part turned into a clone and the scene continued, within moments there were hundreds of clones.
It was the skill he had taken from that bandaged guy who worked for Red from Blood Bone Cult.
"Attack my minions!!" Onest shouted as hundreds of naked Onests attacked Mole at once.
The scene looked way too strange.
After creating so many clones, Onest was completely exhausted.
Thankfully he still had many potions given by Diana, so he kept refilling his mana.
"W- Woahhh!!" Mole's eyes were glinting, honestly, Onest didn't look bad.
"Yes, come to me!" he spread his arms, trying to embrace him.
And the Onests didn't struggle, they just moved closer to Mole, latching onto him.
"Boys, Explode!!" Onest commanded after moving far away, Shitless also moved quickly.
On the other side, Yasmine transformed into her dragon form while Drino was also going all out.
But the difference between the two was too big, Yasmine was beating him so badly.
She still remembered how he attacked them last time, almost succeeded in kidnapping her and hurt Vritra.
The more she thought about it the more mad she became, this lizard dared to hurt her hubby, she would make him suffer so much that regret would be the only thing left in his mind.
Space trembled as she launched powerful mental shocks, that almost fried up Drino's brain, making sizzling sounds.
BOOM
Her claws struck Drino, every bone in his body began to crack as she followed with rapid attacks.
'W- What the hell?
She is that strong too, but how?' Drino was utterly shocked, seeing the enormous figure of the dragon before him.
He became uncertain and began to feel a new sensation... fear.
The deadly look in those eyes made something in him crack, his confidence and fighting spirit began to break.
Yasmine didn't hold back, thrashing him worse than a punching bag.
She transformed into her half-human form, pulling out a weapon from her inventory.
Drino's wounds were healing at a rapid speed but the wounds accumulating were too many.
'H- How can I fight against monsters like that?!!
I was stupid, w- why did I ever come back here?' he truly began to regret ever coming to get his revenge.
"You bug, how dare you come here with the intention of hurting my husband!" Yasmine's voice, full of rage, reverberated all across space.
The weapon Yasmine was holding was a bit strange, it was like a whip but like someone's spine.
It was created by Teresa with the pure intention of torturing the opponent, its strength depends on the strength of the user.
The dragoness swung the whip which struck Drino who was trying to create some distance, wrapping around his body.
"Ughh Aaaaaaaaah S- Stopppppp ahhhhhhhhh" loud screams reverberated as the whip like a snake kept coiling around him, tightening and digging into his body.
It was releasing some sort of poison created by Diana into his body, while attaching to all the bones in his body.
"I will burn it into your body, into your mind and soul, the consequences of hurting someone far beyond your level!" with a strong pull, Yasmine suddenly drew back the whip.
CRUNCH
"Aghhhhhh Nooooo" Drino felt such immense pain to the point that he didn't think was possible.
In battles, he had gotten a lot of injuries but why was this so painful?
He wanted it to just end, he will hide and never even think about Vritra, he was really, really scared.
"Helpppppp, Mole, Sirrrrrrrrr, help meeeeeee ahhhhhhh" as his bones got torn out of him, Drino began to beg.
Yasmine showed no mercy continuing with her torture.
On the other side, Mole saw this and went mad but his hands were full with these strange people, he was suddenly engulfed by a terrifyingly violent explosion.
That was too much to handle even for him, these psychos, Mole finally understood the severity of the situation.
"Hah how unexpected they are getting their ass beat up by these kids, this has to be a joke." Zihong shook his head, he had expected Vritra's family to be strong.
But they are far beyond expectations.
Thankfully he got this level 4 demi god body, so even at their strength, he can still kill them all.
"I guess, it is time to get involved now, it wouldn't be good if they all die after all." Zihong sighed and decided to lend a hand, he also needed to draw out Vritra.
And he will definitely appear once his family is threatened.
"Yo, where are you going?" but he had just had this thought when he heard a calm voice from the side.
"Oh Vritra, so you finally decided to come here huh." Zihong smiled, finally it was time to get started with his plan.
It was a bit surprising that he appeared here out of nowhere, but the moment Vritra appeared, he was caught up in the trap.

chapters.title: Chapter 813 Untouchable
paragraphs: "Uh So how long do I have to stay here?"
Hugging his knees, a man sat in an absolutely dark space, rocking back and forth.
This was none other than Number Zero of the Divine Kage organization who had come to get help from the gods themselves.
After the whole organization was annihilated, he only had one choice.
Unfortunately, the gods were not present so he relayed his message to the thought image left by the god.
The thought image made some arrangements but for big decisions, it too could only wait for the gods themselves to return.
But even after the punishment should have ended, they were yet to return.
"Until they are released, you are to stay here. This mission is important, we can't allow any mistakes." The thought image spoke.
Number Zero waited for weeks and finally the gods were released after facing severe punishments.
All ten of them were very unhappy, yet they can't display any hostility towards the higher beings.
They could be crushed and replaced at any moment and lose everything built over such a long time.
So, their rage was directed towards one single guy, Vritra who was becoming a bigger and bigger thorn in their side.
Finally, in the dark space, the thought image of the god disappeared and got replaced by the real god.
"G- Greetings!!" Number Zero knelt, striking his head against the invisible floor.

"I know all that you have said already, and quite a few had already gone to take care of him. But we won't underestimate him anymore, he is after all associated with the Divine." The unknown god spoke, his voice alone held so much pressure.
"Yes, please tell me what I should do!" Number Zero asked, he was sure the god can see his physical condition at a glance.

"We have a reason to eliminate him, the connection to the Divine. Still we can't directly intervene, so I will share a bit of my power with you, enough to kill any demi god under level 6." The god said.
Of course, he didn't have full confidence in Number Zero, he was just one of the cards.
"T- Thank you, god! I won't disappoint you, I will kill him and anyone related to him." Number Zero spoke, shaking with excitement.
This was his chance to shine in life, he was finally going to make it big and increase his strength.
'If I do this right then I might get the power of a high-level demi god.' He thought.
"There is no time to waste, start the task immediately." The god said as he pointed a finger towards Number Zero.
A pillar of energy rose around him and an immense amount of energy rushed into him.
"Ahhhhhhhhhh"
Number Zero let out a scream, but instead of pain he was feeling euphoric.
What is Vritra? Even if Divine came himself, he won't go back with an arm or two missing.
On one side, Drino was getting the beating of his life, experiencing something far worse than his previous near-death encounter.
On the other side, Mole was annoyed to death by Onest and Shitless.
No matter what skills or attacks he used, those guys weren't affected, both of them were the perfect counter.
He was actually getting pushed back.
"Vritra, we meet again, how I have waited for this moment." Zihong spoke, his lips curling.
Vritra looked on, trying to sense his strength.
Zihong's current appearance wasn't all that much different from a normal human, with short black hair and a buff body.
He didn't try to hide his strength and Vritra could tell there is a big difference between them.
"Zihong, I feel like I should thank you, thank you for delivering that skill and those treasures to me." Vritra said, there was no fear in his eyes.

"Haha So arrogant, you almost make me feel as if you have prepared something for me. Too bad, I have prepared all the countermeasures, so whatever you try, you are going to fail." Zihong spoke with a laugh then added:
"Oh right, I am taking good care of that wraith for you, too bad though, it will be dying with its owner soon."
"Ha I like your confidence, by the way did you enjoy being locked away on this very planet for so long?" Vritra asked, not hurrying to make any move yet.
He already sensed that the six demi gods had died and the remaining two were no big threat.
"..." Zihong clenched his teeth, glaring at Vritra then relaxed. That was one of the most unpleasant things in his life.
If he could, he would really never return to this wretched planet.
But behind his downfall there were two reasons, one being the Divine and the other person who was also quite mysterious.
Someone that everyone on the Zoratian planet knows and respects.
That was the past, it doesn't matter... for now. His current goal is just to get his things from Vritra and more.
Once Vritra is defeated, he would have a way to get his body back, to be specific with that special fishing rod.
And get Divine's abilities and much more.
"Thank you for delivering all your abilities and Mythic Halos to me, I will make good use of them." Zihong chuckled, as he finally decided to not waste any more time and get started.
Zihong took out a glowing dagger, this was one of the treasures he had prepared, especially for Vritra.
'One of his abilities is time, I guess I would be relying on Null.' Vritra reacted just as quickly.
"All Fields... Activate!" a large circle of complex patterns rose under Vritra's feet, expanding quickly to hundreds of kilometres.
His strength rose rapidly, his agility increased to a very high level along with his endurance, his physical stats rising more than twice.
Whether it be his mind or soul, all of them were instantly strengthened, the aura around him becoming denser and denser.
100% comprehension of those fields meant understanding the very rules of the world.
Even his charm increased to a high level, making him extremely attractive.
[Nether Eye Activated!]
The third eye opened on his forehead and a drop of blood slowly slid down, giving off an eerie feeling.
[Cry Baby Activated!]
Instantly all of Vritra's skills were enhanced and his physical body was enhanced further.
The atoms around him began to rotate rapidly as Atomic was pushed to the peak.
The SUCK! SUCK! SUCK! skill devoided the surroundings of all energy, filling Vritra's body with a vast amount of mana.
"Forbid: Agility, Stre-" all of it had taken less than a second, but that was enough time for Zihong to make his move.
Without any big movements, he filled the blue-coloured glowing dagger with immense energy and slashed in Vritra's direction.
[Forbidden Activated!]
Vritra didn't stop his actions, using Forbidden to limit the speed, agility and mana of Zihong, and with its current power it was extremely effective.
Zihong instantly felt all strength leaving his body, his speed was gone and he couldn't sense any mana in his body.
Any demi god, even level 5 or 6 would have been flustered and terrified, with no hopes of winning.
The right corner of his mouth rose, as if mocking Vritra; would he be stupid enough to come without finding out anything about his opponent?
Of course he had prepared for this skill too, but it was still a little surprising.
He hadn't expected it to completely lock away those things.
[Dust Manipulation Activated!]
A blue glow flashed in Vritra's direction, the slash from the knife was so quick that Vritra could barely react.
His body broke into dust particles as he dodged the slash, it passed through thin air, doing no harm to the scattered dust.
But just after a moment the blue glow disappeared, and Vritra felt pain rising in his chest.
BANG
He was forced back into his normal form and a big slash stretched from his chest to abdomen, oozing out black blood.
Ghhkk-
A shocked look appeared on Vritra's face, so that was the ability of that knife, it was more special than he expected.
But... he wasn't going to be the only one to take damage.
His main skill, Dust Manipulation with 100% comprehension and now added with Blood Manipulation burst with incredible power.
Zihong felt the blood flowing in his body churning and getting hotter before...
BOOOOM
There was a loud explosion, smoke rising around Zihong's body as every drop of blood in his body ignited.
Both of them were pushed back, but he was still a level 4 demi god, the expression on his face didn't even change as he got pushed back a bit.
"Not bad, you have grown even more it seems." Zihong while swinging the blue dagger again, took out a bronze bell.
'Can he still use that dagger?' Vritra wondered but wasn't one to underestimate his enemies.
Forming a heavy sword from Goop, he blocked while sensing the wound on his body.
Blood was constantly leaking, and despite his terrifying healing ability, the wound was healing very slowly.
Not to mention that dagger had actually managed to go through his defence and destroy it, it must be a very special treasure.
Another flash of blue energy was released, as expected, even after cutting the mana supply he somehow managed to do so.
Vritra had no time to think of the reason, as he put more strength into blocking.
But he too had other hidden cards, he had used all those hard-earned sin points to prepare his own tricks after all.
BANG
The energy struck the blade, making his arm shudder as heavy pressure descended upon him.
But then, the blue energy disappeared again, striking directly at his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 814 A Losing Battle, or is it?
paragraphs: Some time ago, Vritra had spent nearly three weeks earning sin points.
There were some days off but the number of audience members was very big, making them increase rapidly.
Sitting on a chair made of dust, he finally looked at the sin points.
So many!! This was the first time he had earned this many sin points, almost two billion!
Even after upgrading Dust Manipulation, he would have nearly 1.5 billion left.
'12,000 more and it would truly be 2 billion, I guess I will earn it tonight.' Vritra decided, thinking of the long night ahead.
Without any further thoughts, he was going to upgrade Dust Manipulation first and think about what to upgrade later.
But just then, Divine spoke.
"Don't use those points yet, use them once your battle with Zihong begins."
Vritra was surprised, he looked around but Bullo wasn't there, instead a small insect flew in front of him.
CLAP
Without a second thought, Vritra hit the bug, as if killing some mosquito.
"Ugh What is this for now?" Divine acted as if he received major damage, laying sprawled over his palm.
"Anyway, why did you tell me not to use the sin points yet?" Vritra asked with a frown, this insect looked exactly the same as he had seen before.
In that Divine Realm where he was stuck with Yennefer.
CLAP
Remembering that torture, he struck the bug's body again, making Divine groan.

"Isn't it better to prepare early? And I might not even get the chance to do anything if he brings out some big moves." Vritra said, while still squeezing the bug between his palms with all his might.
"W- Wait, let me- HUFF I am trying to help you and you are hurting me? Ouch I am so hurt." Divine quickly flew away from his palms, yet not transforming into Bullo.

"Hmm that is true, it is always better to be prepared for such strong enemies, but even if you are losing, with your plan, do you really fear Zihong?" Divine asked, he was well aware of Vritra's plan.
And felt that it was quite reliable.
"That aside, give me one reason not to do it?" Vritra asked firmly, he wanted so badly to use those points on something.
The feeling of constantly growing was just otherworldly.
"Just trust me, do it during the battle and it would be more fun. Also, I will have a nice surprise for you tomorrow." Divine replied, just as always not giving complete information.
"Sigh" Vritra sighed then taking something out of his inventory, he aimed at the bug and...
PSSHHH...
He sprayed the bug-killing spray on Divine.
"Ahh Where did you even get that? You prepared it for ughh for me, right? Hehe You sure care a lot about me." Divine quickly flew away while screaming.
Vritra stared at the empty sky, Divine might be a piece of shit, but he is trustable even if a tiny bit.
"I guess I will have to wait a bit longer then." And so Vritra didn't invest those glittering sin points.
He headed back to his home, back to his wives.
The blue glow disappeared and somehow ignored the defences of Goop, directly striking Vritra.
It tore through his heart, as more and more blood rushed out.
COUGH
Vritra felt slight pain, but nothing he couldn't handle, though the healing was still too slow.
"Really not bad, your physique is quite strong. Even my wounds wouldn't start healing for a few days after getting struck by this." Zihong praised.
"But if that's all you have, then it is time to end you." He shook the bell in his left hand, making faint ringing sounds.
TING TING TING
The vibrations spread in all directions. Vritra managed to balance his body, wondering what this new treasure is.
He quickly read its description but just like the knife, Zihong had used some way to mess up its description.
The skills he had obtained through Mutamorphis aren't absolute, they can still be countered.
A strange coffin began to form around Vritra, like how a bird builds its nest, strange lines assembling in some sort of pattern.
"You might be curious about this thing, but can't see anything, right? haha" Zihong laughed and decided to tell him about it, since he was going to die soon anyway.

"Once you are caught inside it, then there is no escape. Your mind, soul, body, heart, brain, all cells, everything would be separated, leaving you completely powerless, there is just no way to escape." His voice grew menacing as he spoke.
Vritra frowned, trying to destroy those lines with various of his skills but it really wasn't having any effect.
It was as if those lines didn't exist in reality, none of the attacks worked.
Even his Dust Manipulation was completely useless, even though it was already at the SS rank.
He teleported away but those lines were completely attached to him, increasing in number with each passing moment.
They teleported along with him.
'Now this is annoying.' Vritra thought, as he activated yet another powerful skill.
[Null Activated!]
He first tried using the spatial ability to send the strange cocoon forming around him into oblivion.
Yet it failed.
"Hahaha" Zihong was truly enjoying himself, this was what he wanted to feel after being trapped in that hellhole for so long.
To see his enemy struggle helplessly yet still falling into his trap, this was just too much fun.
"It is pointless, no matter what you try." Zihong shook his head, he had many more things he had prepared for Vritra.
He let go of the blue dagger and pulled out a small pouch, while Vritra was struggling, he poured down the contents.
Some sort of dust leaked out, which then flew towards Vritra, quickly sticking to his body.
'What the hell is this now?' Vritra had just finished trying to use his spatial skill to move the thin cocoon and failed.
As he noticed the dust sticking all over his body.
Frowning, he tried using Dust Manipulation as his body was about to burst into tiny particles of dust.
But!
The skill for the first time actually failed, making it impossible to turn himself into dust, the dust kind of merged into his body.
And no matter how much he tried, it was impossible to separate.
It seemed like a completely one-sided battle, he couldn't do anything.
The only trick he had was the Forbidden skill which was still effective.
Finally, Vritra decided to use the time from the Null ability, as everything paused.
The threads slowly began to disappear, the dust was pulled off of him, yet that too lasted just a mere moment.
"Tsk tsk I thought you were smarter than that." Zihong shook his head, as he threw the pouch away and took out a staff.
A white light engulfed everything as time stopped once again.
His ability was mainly related to time too and with this staff he could barely match Vritra, and that was more than enough.
The threads reattached to the cocoon and the dust disappeared into his body again, Vritra found it hard to properly use time to change the tide of the battle.
Slowly at first then quickly, he disappeared inside the cocoon.

"Isn't it better to prepare early?
And I might not even get the chance to do anything if he brings out some big moves." Vritra said, while still squeezing the bug between his palms with all his might.
"W- Wait, let me- HUFF I am trying to help you and you are hurting me?
Ouch I am so hurt." Divine quickly flew away from his palms, yet not transforming into Bullo.

"Hmm that is true, it is always better to be prepared for such strong enemies, but even if you are losing, with your plan, do you really fear Zihong?" Divine asked, he was well aware of Vritra's plan.
And felt that it was quite reliable.
"That aside, give me one reason not to do it?" Vritra asked firmly, he wanted so badly to use those points on something.
The feeling of constantly growing was just otherworldly.
"Just trust me, do it during the battle and it would be more fun.
Also, I will have a nice surprise for you tomorrow." Divine replied, just as always not giving complete information.
"Sigh" Vritra sighed then taking something out of his inventory, he aimed at the bug and...
PSSHHH...
He sprayed the bug-killing spray on Divine.
"Ahh Where did you even get that?
You prepared it for ughh for me, right?
Hehe You sure care a lot about me." Divine quickly flew away while screaming.
Vritra stared at the empty sky, Divine might be a piece of shit, but he is trustable even if a tiny bit.
"I guess I will have to wait a bit longer then." And so Vritra didn't invest those glittering sin points.
He headed back to his home, back to his wives.
The blue glow disappeared and somehow ignored the defences of Goop, directly striking Vritra.
It tore through his heart, as more and more blood rushed out.
COUGH
Vritra felt slight pain, but nothing he couldn't handle, though the healing was still too slow.
"Really not bad, your physique is quite strong.
Even my wounds wouldn't start healing for a few days after getting struck by this." Zihong praised.
"But if that's all you have, then it is time to end you." He shook the bell in his left hand, making faint ringing sounds.
TING TING TING
The vibrations spread in all directions.
Vritra managed to balance his body, wondering what this new treasure is.
He quickly read its description but just like the knife, Zihong had used some way to mess up its description.
The skills he had obtained through Mutamorphis aren't absolute, they can still be countered.
A strange coffin began to form around Vritra, like how a bird builds its nest, strange lines assembling in some sort of pattern.
"You might be curious about this thing, but can't see anything, right? haha" Zihong laughed and decided to tell him about it, since he was going to die soon anyway.
"Once you are caught inside it, then there is no escape.
Your mind, soul, body, heart, brain, all cells, everything would be separated, leaving you completely powerless, there is just no way to escape." His voice grew menacing as he spoke.
Vritra frowned, trying to destroy those lines with various of his skills but it really wasn't having any effect.
It was as if those lines didn't exist in reality, none of the attacks worked.
Even his Dust Manipulation was completely useless, even though it was already at the SS rank.
He teleported away but those lines were completely attached to him, increasing in number with each passing moment.
They teleported along with him.
'Now this is annoying.' Vritra thought, as he activated yet another powerful skill.
[Null Activated!]
He first tried using the spatial ability to send the strange cocoon forming around him into oblivion.
Yet it failed.
"Hahaha" Zihong was truly enjoying himself, this was what he wanted to feel after being trapped in that hellhole for so long.
To see his enemy struggle helplessly yet still falling into his trap, this was just too much fun.
"It is pointless, no matter what you try." Zihong shook his head, he had many more things he had prepared for Vritra.
He let go of the blue dagger and pulled out a small pouch, while Vritra was struggling, he poured down the contents.
Some sort of dust leaked out, which then flew towards Vritra, quickly sticking to his body.
'What the hell is this now?' Vritra had just finished trying to use his spatial skill to move the thin cocoon and failed.
As he noticed the dust sticking all over his body.
Frowning, he tried using Dust Manipulation as his body was about to burst into tiny particles of dust.
But!
The skill for the first time actually failed, making it impossible to turn himself into dust, the dust kind of merged into his body.
And no matter how much he tried, it was impossible to separate.
It seemed like a completely one-sided battle, he couldn't do anything.
The only trick he had was the Forbidden skill which was still effective.
Finally, Vritra decided to use the time from the Null ability, as everything paused.
The threads slowly began to disappear, the dust was pulled off of him, yet that too lasted just a mere moment.
"Tsk tsk I thought you were smarter than that." Zihong shook his head, as he threw the pouch away and took out a staff.
A white light engulfed everything as time stopped once again.
His ability was mainly related to time too and with this staff he could barely match Vritra, and that was more than enough.
The threads reattached to the cocoon and the dust disappeared into his body again, Vritra found it hard to properly use time to change the tide of the battle.
Slowly at first then quickly, he disappeared inside the cocoon.

chapters.title: Chapter 815 Grand Transformations!!
paragraphs: Vritra tried to use Forbidden but it seemed Zihong had even countered that now, he took out talismans.
Attaching them to himself and throwing the remaining towards Vritra, so getting hit by Forbidden at first was also a part of his plan.
The laughter of Zihong continued to sound for a little longer then the cocoon completely closed and everything went silent.
"That was a little too easy, it seemed I prepared too much and overestimated him. Still, I am surprised he didn't use some of his trump cards." Zihong spoke to himself.
Vritra hadn't even used the Nuclear Fist or the Titan Fall skill and a few other things like the Mythic Halos or his innate Titan abilities.
If he really did use those, Zihong had counters for them too, there was no way he would be defeated by a skill given to Vritra by himself.
Titan Fall would have been a little tricky though, for that Zihong could only leave for now.
As once that skill activates, it will keep increasing Vritra's strength to an impossible level.
Though the bigger the increase the more damage it will cause to himself.
"I guess that is why he didn't use that skill, I wonder if he is regretting it now." Zihong chuckled, this battle was over.
Then he glanced at the remaining people.
Drino was tortured by Yasmine for a good while, and finally she killed him.
The other women finally came out of the page of the dimensional book and all nine of them together were attacking Mole now.
Despite his high strength and tricks gathered over centuries, Mole was having a really hard time.
He was getting beaten up one-sidedly and was quite close to death, a few more seconds and he would die.
The number advantage had been completely reversed.
"H- Help!!" Mole shouted, he could clearly sense the gaze of the demi god from far away.
These women and those two annoying guys, they were literally slaughtering him, turning him into a torn and beaten punching bag.
Their arsenal of skills was endless and for each of his tricks, they would present something more deadly.
All his leaves were gone, the branches were broken or burnt, his eyes gouged out and roots turned to powder.
He was in such a bad state, like a dying tree.
Not to mention, his favourite, his lovely Drino had been killed, that completely broke him.
"..." Zihong looked at Mole, he was certainly quite strong. Most level 3 demi gods would have long ago folded in front of all nine of them.
But he was still holding on, so he might as well get a good dog.
"Alright, that is enough. Women, your husband has already been captured, stop right now if you don't want to see him die." Zihong appeared along with the white cocoon.
All nine of them paused for a moment, looking back at the cocoon and Zihong who floated there with a condescending look.
Then looked at the cocoon.
"T- Thank you sir, I will COUGH COUGH do whatever ughhh you o- order me to! Just p- please help me kill them all!!" Mole begged, he was happy to finally find his lifeline.
He was truly saved or was he?
BOOOOM
Mole's mind exploded. Yasmine's eyes glowed intensely, as she used Spiritual Burst.
Instantly, Mole was attacked from all sides, destroyed to bits, whether it be his mind, soul or body, all of it was getting attacked.
"What?!!" Zihong's eyes widened in shock at first but then he got angry, glaring at those ants.
They dared to treat his words like air? They have got a death wish, at most he can let Divine's sister live but the rest of them, are going to die.
Why were they being so stubborn? Or do they still have something hidden?
'Don't believe me, they still think Vritra can reverse the situation? Pfft well this is going to be fun.' His sour mood quickly disappeared.
Mole wasn't worth getting angry over anyway, he would just enjoy killing these women and then bring Divine's sisters to the gods.
Finally, he can free his real body.
Inside the cocoon, there was complete darkness, a colourless flame burned with intensity.
Vritra lay back, tapping over his chin, he was protected by the Nihil-Anima Mythic Halo.
The cocoon couldn't really pass through its defences, he wondered how Zihong made this mistake.
Maybe just restraining him was enough, in any case, it was finally time.
In the middle of the battle he got time, just like the Divine had said, but he was yet to get that surprise.
"That was a nice battle, how was it fighting against someone so much stronger than you?" an insect suddenly appeared over Vritra's shoulder and spoke.
"Sigh it is no time to be wasting time, I am going to use the sin points now." Vritra said and Divine didn't stop him, instead spoke:
"Sure, go ahead. Oh right I almost forgot, that gift I promised to you. It won't work for long and honestly the cost is too high but for now this will be of great help."
Vritra wondered what he was talking about as he opened the system panel, despite being locked inside the cocoon.
He was well aware of everything happening outside through a Soul Wraith, Psyche.
First his gaze moved to Dust Manipulation but then he noticed there was an additional line of text, something that surprised him actually.
"Well well, not a bad surprise. I wasn't planning to fight him much, but it seems I can try it out a bit longer now." Vritra said as his lips curled up.
He stared at the line for a few moments, wondering how many sin points he should pour into it as there was no upper limit.
[Physique: Titan] *(UPGRADE: 0-∞ Sin Points)
Unlike before, he can directly invest into his physique now, and strengthen it even without stealing it from others.
And honestly, upgrading his physique was one of the most satisfying feelings for Vritra.
His current sin points were...
[Used 500 million to upgrade Dust Manipulation!]
[Dust Manipulation is evolving to SSS class (Level 9)]
[Dust Monarch is Evolving into Cosmic Dust God!]
[Progress: 0%]
Just after upgrading Dust Manipulation, Vritra wasted no time, before the upgrade starts, he decided to upgrade his physique too.
Though the question was how many points should he spend? There are still many other skills that needed to be upgraded.
After a moment's thought, he finally came to a conclusion.
[Used 1.5 Billion Sin Points to upgrade Physique!]
He is going to go all out!! Titan Physique? Upgrade it as much as possible.
[Titan Physique is strengthening!!]
[Warning! Warning! Warning!]
[Noticed a big amount of Sin Points!]
[The Transformation will now begin!]
Vritra was surprised by the words but suddenly, he felt everything shift.
His own body, the cocoon around him, the space around him, all of it began to change.
DRRRRRRRR...
Massive tremors passed through space, forming large cracks that spanned over thousands of kilometres.
The cocoon broke into tiny pieces, the space began to break and massive amounts of energy were being sucked into Vritra's body.
Two devastating transformations were taking place at the same time.
The Lord of Dust was finally regaining his actual powers while the feared and forbidden Titan was becoming the thing that even the higher beings feared.

chapters.title: Chapter 816 Meeting her again...
paragraphs: BOOOOOOM
Dust flooded in all directions, drifting away from the Zoratian planet which was protected against all the external changes.
Yasmine and the others just disappeared, fully aware that a storm would be coming.
Vritra had informed them in advance, still it came as a shock, the changes were too devastating.
After Teresa had absorbed all the remaining souls and physiques, they were ready to leave the battlefield completely for Vritra.
The difference between their strength was too big.
"What the hell is this?!" Even Zihong was pushed back, covered by the storm of dust.
Aside from the dust transformation there was also the Titan Physique transformation.
Which made Zihong feel at a loss, he couldn't do anything, even his great treasure was destroyed.
Clicking his tongue, he slashed out with the blue blade only for it to be unable to find the target.
[Progress: 10%]
[Progress: 9%]
Vritra felt his body evolving, immense strength filled his being, as the space cracked further.
It now looked like a massive cracked glass, out from which enormous dark tentacles began to move, bringing along terrifying energy.
Along with the massive tentacles, there were also countless dark creatures who looked like ghosts, releasing ghastly noises.
"!!!" Zihong was startled, just what sort of transformation was he undergoing?
Wasn't it too extreme? Dust? And what is this other feeling?
The world laws constantly tried to repair the damage, pulling back those cursed beings which seemed like disasters that could destroy everything.
"This... has to be a joke!" now this was something out of Zihong's expectations, he hurriedly moved back.
Those things could kill him within seconds, these are things that the higher beings should deal with.
He looked at the centre of the storm, Vritra was covered by glowing dust, cracks forming all over his body.
"This crazy bastard, stop right now!! Are you trying to get this universe destroyed?" Zihong shouted while constantly running.
Vritra couldn't hear or sense anything and with the extreme amount of energy concentrating in his body as a Titan, he looked more delicious to those cursed creatures than the planets themselves.
They all began to move in his direction, the tentacles began to wrap around the massive storm and those countless dark creatures swarmed him.
"Noooo, damnit you can't die!!" Zihong screamed at the top of his lungs, but his own survival was getting difficult.
There were still many things he needed from Vritra.
Far, far away, inside a room with faint light, a cheerful sound suddenly rang out.
"Yes!! It is happening!" Evelyn jumped off the bed, clapping.
Finally, those universe-eater bugs and other cursed creatures were coming, though was this a thing to be happy about?
Evelyn didn't care about any of that, such a big problem had arrived.
Even gods would be troubled, only higher beings are capable of properly dealing with it, so someone had to go there to fix things.
And who could be more suitable than herself? None!
'I can meet him again, hehe this time I will completely make him mine!' Evelyn was so excited by this giddy feeling.
Her personality looked completely different right now, if her family or others were to see her current expression, they would receive the shock of their lives.
She had been watching the battle from the start and felt like killing that pig Zihong, but she couldn't.
It was an uncomfortable feeling.
Without wasting a moment, she left her room in a hurry and appeared in the cloud palace, where her father was present as usual.
"Father, there is some problem, I am going to solve it." Evelyn spoke calmly, appearing as uninterested as usual.

"Ah those annoying bugs? Go ahead and make sure the space is properly patched, can't let even a single one escape. And be careful, they are still quite dangerous." Fader spoke, drinking something from a large metallic cup.
"Oh right, check what it is that made the space crack that badly, deal with it properly." Fader said, dismissing her.
Evelyn nodded, she turned and started walking. She could barely stop herself from just running, she was going to meet him, it's been so long.
"Ah right I forgot to mention, he is here too..." suddenly remembering something, Fader quickly added but Evelyn wasn't paying any attention to him.
Evelyn was just about to disappear when suddenly a person spoke: "Hello, did you miss me?"
Her expression instantly became annoyed and angry, that voice made her feel like vomiting.
"Armin, what is it now?" she asked.
"Oh nothing, I just came here to talk about that promised battle with the Asura race. Sigh don't worry though, for you I will defeat that brute, but you will choose me over him right?" Armin asked.
"Get lost." She didn't even want to waste any words on him.
But now she was worried that he might follow her, so she decided to use her father as a scapegoat.
"I heard father prefers that guy over you, he is planning to go meet the Asura Empress soon." She spoke, pointing back at Fader who was lazing around.
"What?! That brute over me? That is insanity, how can he even compare us? Wah I can't believe this, we need to talk." Huffing, he rushed into the cloud palace.
Evelyn heaved a sigh of relief, then she disappeared, making sure he doesn't follow her.
[Progress: 100%]
[Progress: 100%]
Finally, both his physique and Dust Manipulation had evolved into far more powerful versions of themselves.
The storm slowly began to subside, the cracks in space stopped and a glowing figure could now be seen a bit clearer.
Inhaling deeply, Vritra finally opened his eyes, thankfully the two transformations didn't take too long.
And the increase in his power?
It was massive!!
Just in terms of physical prowess, he could easily defeat himself from some minutes ago, maybe in two or so punches.
Even Vritra himself wasn't exactly sure about the extent of the changes, thankfully there was a live target here.
There is also the Dust Manipulation which has now evolved into Cosmic Dust God.
'God? Now what does this mean?' Vritra wondered and was even more curious to check out the effect of the SSS rank Dust Manipulation.
It was at level 9, just one level away from SSS+.
"Now shall we test its powe..." Vritra finally noticed the absurdity of his surroundings.
"What the hell is this?!" he was taken aback upon seeing countless creatures and those giant tentacle arms.
He looked to the other side and saw Zihong running and barely escaping from those unknown lifeforms.
'They look dangerous.' He thought, and decided to tactically let Zihong take the brunt.
[Dust Manipulation Activated!]
Vritra released a long breath, his body started breaking apart. The energy disappeared from his body, his very existence seemed to merge with the universe itself.
And in a moment, he was completely gone, just like true death.
Dust Manipulation had truly become too terrifying, Vritra could feel atoms, and even the very components of those atoms.
With a single thought, he could create nuclear fusions or fissions, now it had become offensive in and of itself.
He could even change the nature of matter and much more, despite having disappeared completely from there, Vritra could perfectly sense everything.
"That damned bastard, he ran away?!!" Zihong was so angry, yet could do nothing but run.
He had prepared countless things to fight Vritra, but none of them would be of use right now.
CRUNCH
A scary-looking creature suddenly bit at Zihong's shoulder, tearing apart his shoulder and arm.
"Aaaaah" Screaming, he took out a white plate and crushed it, instantly creating a powerful shield around himself.
He had prepared things that could allow him to fight even against level 5 demi gods.
But this...
CRACK
The tentacle struck the shield and broke it instantly, hitting Zihong.
CRACK CRACK
Some distance away the space crackled and then out walked a figure, looking around with excitement in her eyes.
"My husband, I am here!"
Evelyn glanced around, for now she ignored those ugly creatures and sensed Vritra's presence which was scattered around thousands of kilometres.
But of course, how could she not be able to find her man?
"There you are!" she could sense him but actually meeting him would be tricky.
Vritra also noticed Evelyn as soon as she had appeared, and could tell she was searching for him.
'Is she here to deal with those things?' he wondered, he understood her a bit, but knew too little about her.
Should he stay hidden or meet her? She is one of the people who had helped him a lot, just like Divine, Yasmine and his family.
Even in that court trial, it could be said she is the one who had helped him the most while staying behind the scenes.
"..." sighing, his body returned to its normal state as the particles converged.
"Why are you here-?" Vritra asked, but there was a flash in front of his eyes.
Everything paused and the dark space became white, the dark creatures paused as well.
The wounded Zihong also froze, and the piece of space around Vritra was cut off from the rest of the world.
Of course, to stop the prying eyes.
"My Darlinngggg!!" Evelyn with a big beautiful smile jumped into Vritra's arms, throwing herself at him.
Vritra, startled, almost disappeared like before but wasn't fast enough as her soft body pressed against him, the sweet familiar scent wrapped around him.
Her arms circled around his waist, her palms softly moving over the muscles of his back, her face buried into his neck.
She inhaled deeply, letting his scent crawl over her body, it was the most pleasant smell for her in the world.

Her personality looked completely different right now, if her family or others were to see her current expression, they would receive the shock of their lives.
She had been watching the battle from the start and felt like killing that pig Zihong, but she couldn't.
It was an uncomfortable feeling.
Without wasting a moment, she left her room in a hurry and appeared in the cloud palace, where her father was present as usual.
"Father, there is some problem, I am going to solve it." Evelyn spoke calmly, appearing as uninterested as usual.
"Ah those annoying bugs?
Go ahead and make sure the space is properly patched, can't let even a single one escape.
And be careful, they are still quite dangerous." Fader spoke, drinking something from a large metallic cup.
"Oh right, check what it is that made the space crack that badly, deal with it properly." Fader said, dismissing her.
Evelyn nodded, she turned and started walking.
She could barely stop herself from just running, she was going to meet him, it's been so long.
"Ah right I forgot to mention, he is here too..." suddenly remembering something, Fader quickly added but Evelyn wasn't paying any attention to him.
Evelyn was just about to disappear when suddenly a person spoke: "Hello, did you miss me?"
Her expression instantly became annoyed and angry, that voice made her feel like vomiting.
"Armin, what is it now?" she asked.
"Oh nothing, I just came here to talk about that promised battle with the Asura race.
Sigh don't worry though, for you I will defeat that brute, but you will choose me over him right?" Armin asked.
"Get lost." She didn't even want to waste any words on him.
But now she was worried that he might follow her, so she decided to use her father as a scapegoat.
"I heard father prefers that guy over you, he is planning to go meet the Asura Empress soon." She spoke, pointing back at Fader who was lazing around.
"What?!
That brute over me?
That is insanity, how can he even compare us?
Wah I can't believe this, we need to talk." Huffing, he rushed into the cloud palace.
Evelyn heaved a sigh of relief, then she disappeared, making sure he doesn't follow her.

[Progress: 100%]
Finally, both his physique and Dust Manipulation had evolved into far more powerful versions of themselves.
The storm slowly began to subside, the cracks in space stopped and a glowing figure could now be seen a bit clearer.
Inhaling deeply, Vritra finally opened his eyes, thankfully the two transformations didn't take too long.
And the increase in his power?
It was massive!!
Just in terms of physical prowess, he could easily defeat himself from some minutes ago, maybe in two or so punches.
Even Vritra himself wasn't exactly sure about the extent of the changes, thankfully there was a live target here.
There is also the Dust Manipulation which has now evolved into Cosmic Dust God.
'God?
Now what does this mean?' Vritra wondered and was even more curious to check out the effect of the SSS rank Dust Manipulation.
It was at level 9, just one level away from SSS+.
"Now shall we test its powe..." Vritra finally noticed the absurdity of his surroundings.
"What the hell is this?!" he was taken aback upon seeing countless creatures and those giant tentacle arms.
He looked to the other side and saw Zihong running and barely escaping from those unknown lifeforms.
'They look dangerous.' He thought, and decided to tactically let Zihong take the brunt.
[Dust Manipulation Activated!]
Vritra released a long breath, his body started breaking apart.
The energy disappeared from his body, his very existence seemed to merge with the universe itself.
And in a moment, he was completely gone, just like true death.
Dust Manipulation had truly become too terrifying, Vritra could feel atoms, and even the very components of those atoms.
With a single thought, he could create nuclear fusions or fissions, now it had become offensive in and of itself.
He could even change the nature of matter and much more, despite having disappeared completely from there, Vritra could perfectly sense everything.
"That damned bastard, he ran away?!!" Zihong was so angry, yet could do nothing but run.
He had prepared countless things to fight Vritra, but none of them would be of use right now.
CRUNCH
A scary-looking creature suddenly bit at Zihong's shoulder, tearing apart his shoulder and arm.
"Aaaaah" Screaming, he took out a white plate and crushed it, instantly creating a powerful shield around himself.
He had prepared things that could allow him to fight even against level 5 demi gods.
But this...
CRACK
The tentacle struck the shield and broke it instantly, hitting Zihong.
CRACK CRACK
Some distance away the space crackled and then out walked a figure, looking around with excitement in her eyes.
"My husband, I am here!"
Evelyn glanced around, for now she ignored those ugly creatures and sensed Vritra's presence which was scattered around thousands of kilometres.
But of course, how could she not be able to find her man?
"There you are!" she could sense him but actually meeting him would be tricky.
Vritra also noticed Evelyn as soon as she had appeared, and could tell she was searching for him.
'Is she here to deal with those things?' he wondered, he understood her a bit, but knew too little about her.
Should he stay hidden or meet her?
She is one of the people who had helped him a lot, just like Divine, Yasmine and his family.
Even in that court trial, it could be said she is the one who had helped him the most while staying behind the scenes.
"..." sighing, his body returned to its normal state as the particles converged.
"Why are you here-?" Vritra asked, but there was a flash in front of his eyes.
Everything paused and the dark space became white, the dark creatures paused as well.
The wounded Zihong also froze, and the piece of space around Vritra was cut off from the rest of the world.
Of course, to stop the prying eyes.
"My Darlinngggg!!" Evelyn with a big beautiful smile jumped into Vritra's arms, throwing herself at him.
Vritra, startled, almost disappeared like before but wasn't fast enough as her soft body pressed against him, the sweet familiar scent wrapped around him.
Her arms circled around his waist, her palms softly moving over the muscles of his back, her face buried into his neck.
She inhaled deeply, letting his scent crawl over her body, it was the most pleasant smell for her in the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 817 Scolding
paragraphs: Vritra found himself trapped in a tight yet soft embrace of the woman he knew too little about.
But someone who had been present in his life since the beginning.
"Evelyn?" He called out, his body frozen against the warmth of the blonde hugging him.
"Yes!" Evelyn felt butterflies in her belly just by hearing him say her name, feeling the love in his voice. "Your Evelyn!"
"Mhmm" she snuggled closer, rubbing her face gently against him.
"Wait, let's talk but first, can you let go?" Vritra asked, feeling helpless.
"We can talk just fine like this, and yea I came to deal with those dark creatures. They eat planets and all life forms, but in the dark galaxy, they are like weeds." Evelyn spoke without letting go.
She never wanted to let go.
'I came here only for you, so stop struggling and just give yourself to me...' she thought, feeling her heart thumping quickly, getting all possessive.
Her eyes glowed, but then she smelled something.
"Blood?" pulling her head back a bit she smelled the scent of blood over his body, which was from the battle against Zihong.
Evelyn's heart clenched, her expression changing suddenly as a killing intent covered the whole space.
The killing intent was so thick that even Vritra was shocked, the light space and the dark space outside, all turned blood red.
Strange cries began to ring out, just the thought that someone had hurt him made her so angry.
This wasn't the first time though, she had been watching over Vritra from the beginning and every time he got hurt.
She was filled with worry and rage, especially in that war where he died again.
She just held back for Vritra's sake, Evelyn thought she could still hold on. But now being here, and remembering the scene of Vritra getting injured.
Her killing intent exploded.
"Wait-" Vritra tried to hold her but her body moved way too quickly, the white space exploded.
He remained completely safe at the centre, Evelyn's body seemed to be burning with dense mana, destroying the space even further.
The damage she was causing was at least more than five times what Vritra did, and it was just her aura.
'She is strong!' Vritra could tell that she hadn't completely let go yet or the scene would be far more terrifying.
This was the true strength of a higher being, Vritra wondered how long it would take for him to reach that level.
"Ah" Zihong suddenly returned to his senses, his body no longer frozen.
He was still afraid of those dark creatures, but what he saw next frightened him to the degree that he almost peed.
All his schemes and games were nothing in front of such absolute power.
He had never seen her before but could tell it was at least a god or someone even stronger.
'No, I have seen a god and even they aren't this oppressive, but why is her killing intent focused on me?'
His body felt like exploding, pain began to seep out from all sides, as he fell limply.
"How dare you hurt my husband!!" reality seemed to be distorting as she raised her hand, then brought it down at Zihong's head, destroying all world laws, space and time.
"I- f- f- forgive meeeeee" Zihong screamed in panic, unsure of what made her so angry.
But it was too late.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!
An explosion that destroyed everything around thousands of kilometres swept all over, even killing a large number of those dark creatures and pushing back those giant tentacles.
The poor space was even further destroyed, completely opening this universe to the dark galaxy.
The dark galaxy was the place where even the Crooked were thrown, that place is filled with the most dangerous creatures who can bring destruction.
Frowning, Vritra used Null to make everything stop, and Evelyn didn't interrupt, finally calming a bit as Zihong got erased from existence.
Using the enormous amount of mana in his body, Vritra reversed everything caused by Evelyn, he knew it would get too troublesome.
Seeing Vritra doing that, Evelyn was happy, as she expected he still loves her.
Should she just marry him in secret and use some trick to fool her family and just settle down with him?
She was lost in a dreamy world as Vritra reversed everything.
Evelyn returned to her senses after a moment and quickly helped Vritra, but Zihong was revived again.
She could kill him but again, others might get alerted.
"Haa Haa" Vritra panted lightly, wiping the sweat from his forehead, that was way too taxing.
"Are you really here to solve that?!" Vritra asked, looking at Evelyn.
This woman was a whole box of new troubles, her strength is undeniable but she gets angry too easily.
Evelyn pouted, murmuring to herself: "Wouldn't you do the same if any of your wives were injured, why am I the one getting scolded?"
"Hmm Did you say something?" Vritra narrowed his eyes, looking at her as if she is a problem child who had just made a big blunder.
"Uh N- No I didn't." Evelyn shook her head quickly, looking away from him, suddenly finding counting those creatures interesting.
Evelyn secretly glared at Zihong, he was totally to blame.
If her father were to see the current her his body would go into paralysis, since she was young, he hadn't seen her like that.
In fact he was the one who felt a bit afraid of her, when she got angry she would turn the entire Vespera family upside down.
And now here she was, acting cute like a child getting scolded.
Vritra calmed down a bit, he could tell why she got angry.
"It's alright, I can deal with Zihong." Vritra said, then asked: "Won't you be in trouble for doing all that?"
Evelyn didn't answer instead her red lips stretched into a smile, as she asked: "Are you worried about me?"
"No" Vritra shook his head and glanced up at the broken space.
Evelyn giggled, it seemed her husband has a tsundere side to him, in that dream he was pretty direct.
She too looked at the creatures of darkness and decided to deal with them, it wouldn't be good to keep the space like that for long.
There are many dangerous creatures there, many powerful races, if even one of the top figures managed to cross over.
Things would become too complicated.
So pausing her reconciliation with Vritra for a bit, she began to repair the space, pushing back those countless creatures.
Vritra watched Evelyn focus with a serious look and was lost in her beauty for a moment.
Her appearance was almost equally beautiful to Teresa, and the seriousness and air of superiority present around her naturally, made her look even more charming.
Vritra really might have pursued her if they had met early, but now he didn't really want to add another woman to his life.
Though fate did have other plans.
"My love, I am almost done, so just wait a few more moments." Evelyn said as she glanced back at Vritra, even the fact that he was looking at her made her feel euphoric.
She is the only one in his eyes right now, what could be better than that.
"Huh? Love? How did you know I was coming here?" just then a surprised voice sounded as another person appeared.
