chapters.title: Chapter 818 A Dog?!
paragraphs: "Huh? Love? How did you know I was coming here?" a surprised voice sounded as the space cracked open.
Then a figure wearing a fancy and expensive-looking outfit appeared.
His white hair fluttered despite there being no wind, a heavy pressure present around him.
Armin ran his gaze all over the place, at the space that had just been sealed, the frozen Zihong.
And finally, Armin's gaze landed over Vritra, a surprised look appearing on his face, not just because of his shockingly attractive appearance.
But something about the black outfit he was wearing gave him a feeling of familiarity.
'I... have I seen something like that somewhere?' he scratched his head, then just shrugged.
Maybe he saw such clothes in the collection of his older brother, he loves collecting expensive and pretty things after all.
In any case, Vritra was just a lower worldly, he didn't even deserve a single glance from him.
So, he turned his attention back towards Evelyn whose expression had shifted completely, looking extremely unpleasant.
The killing intent was heavy in the space, her eyes carrying a chill.
"WHY. ARE. YOU. HERE?!!" she spoke, each word slowly, barely holding herself back from attacking him.
"Ouch, do you really have to be so heartless? Of course I came here to be with you, is that a problem, my fiance?" with a gentlemanly smile, Armin spoke.
"Oh!" now it was Vritra's turn to be surprised, as he unconsciously called out.
"Fiance?"
His eyes narrowed as he looked at Evelyn, although he didn't want to get involved with her, it still for some reason felt unpleasant.
The last time the woman he loved had a fiance, it almost ended in a very bad manner.
And this woman, she was doing all this despite having a fiance?
"Uhm..." Evelyn froze, her expression growing grave, that was the last thing she wanted Vritra to know.
Of course, he had that title only till Vritra's strength was enough and she didn't have to worry about his safety.
But her heart chilled just upon imagining what Vritra might be thinking, what if he started disliking her?
She had seen how Yennefer's and his relationship almost ended because of a so-called fiance.

"NO!! He is not, he is just a stray dog that keeps annoying me, I would rather gouge my eyes out than take a look at him!!" Evelyn spoke without thinking and in a hurry, the most important thing was to not create any unnecessary misunderstandings.
"Wha... Dog? G... Gouge your eyes? Ugh..." Armin clutched his chest, stumbling back, having just received critical damage.
Wasn't that too harsh? She had ignored him all the time and Armin didn't mind that much.
Her family had even played that trick to make the Garissa family fight against the Asura race, but he didn't mind.
He was ready to go to any length to marry her and knew how to break and rebuild her after marriage even if it meant he had to hurt her.
But what was going on now?
"Hoo." Evelyn calmed down, she had completely lost her composure earlier.
Armin is like a sly fox, just seeing her reaction he can connect the dots and might trace it to Vritra.
She glanced at Vritra first whose face was completely expressionless, her heart clenching, then she looked at Armin.
Who seemed completely lost and baffled, thankfully he couldn't think straight for now either.
'I cannot stay here any longer, damn that pig. He dared to ruin my precious time with my husband!!' Evelyn was feeling extremely angry.
But for now she could not do anything, if she stayed here any longer, it would only reveal her secret.
She took a long look at Vritra, looking longingly. Feeling jealous of all his other women, they could just stay with him.
'Next time, for sure, we will stay together for very long!' she thought with determination.
Divine had helped her create this opportunity, but it got wasted in the end.
With a snap of her fingers, she created a portal then walked into it.
The dazed Armin also turned and left through a separate portal, only her heartbreaking words ringing in his heart.
As the most talented in his family, when had he ever been called that?
So he was only a dog in her eyes? It seemed she was not aware of his excellence, then the fight with that brute would be the perfect opportunity.
And thus, they were gone, things returned to normal.
Now only Vritra and Zihong were left there standing in the endless dark space.
"W... What just happened? I am alive?" Zihong broke out in sweat, looking all over himself, unable to remember anything.
'So she has a fiance...' Vritra thought, staring at the portal for a moment longer.
Putting the matter to the back of his head for now, he looked at Zihong, he still needed to deal with this.
But now he was no longer interested in fighting with him.
"Hoo, I don't know what happened, but I guess it is time to end our battle." Zihong spoke, his expression becoming ferocious.
Vritra somehow had managed to get free from that cocoon but he had many more treasures.
"Sigh, let's wait a bit and just chat, I am sure you are tired too." Vritra spoke as he just sat back.
Zihong was on alert, wondering if it was some trick, still he didn't launch any attacks yet.
"So, what exactly was it that you were searching for so madly that you even got trapped on Zoratian planet?" Vritra asked.
"...Fine, since you are going to die anyway, consider it your dying wish." Zihong said, and relaxed a bit.
"It was the Divine's skills, and that guy, the creator of glyphs." He added.
"Rodrick Mech? If I remember correctly, the creatures called Grieves were also searching for him." Vritra shared.
"Oh, you have met them, they were something I had released to search for Rodrick Mech." Zihong said, reminiscing about old days.

A confused look appeared on Vritra's face as he asked: "But those Grieves were acting as if Rodrick had annihilated all their fathers or something, they seemed to have some innate hatred towards him."

"Haha. Just like their name says, they are grievous creatures, giving them a target for their grief is the only way to control them. But it seems while I was gone, their memories and story got distorted, but they didn't forget their original goal. Did they succeed?" Zihong questioned, he couldn't be the only one answering.
"No, they didn't, all of them were wiped out by me." Vritra replied, it felt better to solve old mysteries.
No wonder those creatures acted so crazy about catching Rodrick Mech, even getting their entire race annihilated.
"What a pity, but about those abilities of the Divine, have you met him? How did you get them?" that was something Zihong was even more curious about.
"Of course I have met him, in fact he was here just some time ago, maybe he still is." Vritra shrugged.
But his words brought a massive shock to Zihong's face, Divine really is a big deal outside.
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Doubted +1}
"Are you joking?" Zihong asked sceptically.
Vritra took out a fishing rod and while shaking it he asked: "Now my turn to ask a question, what are its uses exactly?"

But now he was no longer interested in fighting with him.
"Hoo, I don't know what happened, but I guess it is time to end our battle." Zihong spoke, his expression becoming ferocious.
Vritra somehow had managed to get free from that cocoon but he had many more treasures.
"Sigh, let's wait a bit and just chat, I am sure you are tired too." Vritra spoke as he just sat back.
Zihong was on alert, wondering if it was some trick, still he didn't launch any attacks yet.
"So, what exactly was it that you were searching for so madly that you even got trapped on Zoratian planet?" Vritra asked.
"...Fine, since you are going to die anyway, consider it your dying wish." Zihong said, and relaxed a bit.
"It was the Divine's skills, and that guy, the creator of glyphs." He added.
"Rodrick Mech?
If I remember correctly, the creatures called Grieves were also searching for him." Vritra shared.
"Oh, you have met them, they were something I had released to search for Rodrick Mech." Zihong said, reminiscing about old days.

A confused look appeared on Vritra's face as he asked: "But those Grieves were acting as if Rodrick had annihilated all their fathers or something, they seemed to have some innate hatred towards him."
"Haha.
Just like their name says, they are grievous creatures, giving them a target for their grief is the only way to control them.
But it seems while I was gone, their memories and story got distorted, but they didn't forget their original goal.
Did they succeed?" Zihong questioned, he couldn't be the only one answering.
"No, they didn't, all of them were wiped out by me." Vritra replied, it felt better to solve old mysteries.
No wonder those creatures acted so crazy about catching Rodrick Mech, even getting their entire race annihilated.
"What a pity, but about those abilities of the Divine, have you met him?
How did you get them?" that was something Zihong was even more curious about.
"Of course I have met him, in fact he was here just some time ago, maybe he still is." Vritra shrugged.
But his words brought a massive shock to Zihong's face, Divine really is a big deal outside.
{Sin Point Gained: Shocked +1}
{Sin Point Gained: Doubted +1}
"Are you joking?" Zihong asked sceptically.
Vritra took out a fishing rod and while shaking it he asked: "Now my turn to ask a question, what are its uses exactly?"

chapters.title: Chapter 819 A Planned Trapped
paragraphs: "So, you still have it huh..." Zihong stared at the fishing rod which soon disappeared.
With this in hand, it would be impossible to kill Vritra, that is why his aim wasn't that.
Zihong merely wanted to capture him for now, the rest could wait.
"Haa, this, you don't know anything about it?" he asked but Vritra didn't say anything, his silence irritating Zihong.
But he knew the reason, to get the most information.

"Well, I am sure you already know that you won't die while you have that, but in front of me that's useless since I have thought of countermeasures. Then there is also stealing, which is its main job, and it could steal a lot of things." Zihong didn't go into further details.
"I see, so you planned to use this to free your original body." Vritra said, stretching slightly.
"Something like that, anyway do you know anything about Rodrick Mech?" he asked, looking very curious.
"No, I don't. I don't think he is even on this planet, maybe he already died or maybe he is on a different planet." Vritra shrugged.
The two didn't look like enemies trying hard to kill each other as they exchanged answers, neither was in a hurry to attack just yet.
"About the games, from four and ahead, what do you know?" Vritra asked, very soon he would be participating after all.

"Oh, it's been quite long since I last participated in a game, such good memories. Anyway, the games are ever-changing and mysterious, your group just has to achieve some goal. The danger level undoubtedly is high, but they end quicker too. Mine was delivering something to a location." Zihong shared with a chuckle.
Vritra nodded, the problem is according to Divine's plan, they would be participating in two games at once.
For their fast leveling mainly.
He still felt a headache just thinking about how he would finish that task in the god's office.
"My turn, why exactly were you chosen by the Divine? He gave you all those abilities and treasures and you even married his sisters. That doesn't seem normal." Narrowing his eyes, he asked.
If he could find out the secret maybe after Vritra's death it would be easy to inherit those abilities.
"Ah that..." Vritra fell silent, of course it must be because of Evelyn, she was the first to choose him and then included Divine in her plan.
Or maybe Divine started it himself? It was too confusing anyway.
"I guess, he saw my limitless potential, my unbending will, this unachievable charm, there could be more." Vritra shrugged.
Then he asked: "What is it that you hate the most?"
Zihong was still frowning upon hearing that absurd answer, but then was surprised by this question.
Why was he asking such a personal question now, did he really start to think they were friends now?
But then he started thinking, there really wasn't anything he hated initially, but now?

"I hate getting trapped in that damned suffocating space, losing myself, it was worse than dying. The most uncomfortable feeling, staying trapped for hundreds of years." Zihong spoke, his voice full of anger, he would rather die than get himself trapped again.
Last time it was because of his stupidity and overconfidence, he got tricked by the traps set up for him, and then got stuck.
"Ah, sounds rough, you must really hate being trapped." Vritra nodded in understanding, staying like that all alone must be unbelievably frustrating.
"Then my question is..." Zihong thought of something and was about to ask when Vritra suddenly stood up.
Making him jump back in alert, was the fight already starting?
"Enough with this, let's just end it." Vritra said.
'T... This bastard, doing as he pleases!!' Zihong clenched his fists, wasn't he the one who started it?

"Haha. Now with that strengthened body and that dust skill, do you think you can defeat me? Heh. Too bad, I had prepared for situations where you suddenly become a level 4 demi god. No way this is enough." He shook his head confidently.
"Is that so?" Vritra nodded then spoke: "Well I didn't really plan to fight you from the beginning, I was just checking my limits. By the way, have you been holding onto Knight still?"
"???" Zihong frowned, unable to understand anything.
Of course that soul wraith was still trapped in a space, frozen by his time ability, what about it?
"Sorry, but you are gonna have to stay locked up for a while longer." Vritra said calmly, as he raised his hand and snapped his finger.
There was no change, but soon Zihong noticed that the trapped Knight seemed strange.
[Null Activated!]
The barrier of time was momentarily broken, the energy that connected Zihong to Knight suddenly turned into some sort of bridge.
"What the..." Zihong was alerted, quickly trying to stop time but he noticed that his time staff and all other treasures were missing.
His reddened eyes instantly shifted back to Vritra, glaring and roaring at him.
"You bastard, I am going to kill you!!"
But when did he steal everything? In the short span of time when he took out that fishing rod? H... How is that even possible?
It was out for merely seconds, and right in front of his eyes.
No no, why did he even start exchanging answers in the first place?
That was so stupid, he could have gotten all answers after capturing him, so how come he felt that was a good choice?
He was sure this Vritra must have used some trick to control his mind without even him noticing.
The more he thought about it the more his heart palpitated, he is too terrifying.
A literal monster!!
In any case, he was unable to push back Vritra's time energy, as his body got firmly connected with Knight.
Far away, somewhere on a planet with no demi gods.
A large sorcerer had appeared, he seemed to be made of darkness itself.
After arriving he began to wreak havoc, destroying mountains and changing the natural climate.
He didn't go out of his way to kill people, but was constantly using his ability, even as the shackles of the planet began to tighten around him.
The planet laws were dense and clearly didn't welcome him here.
The Hellmancer, sent here by Vritra after making it consume the soul of a level 1 demi god.
It had too reached the demi god level and hence couldn't stay here for too long or would get trapped on the planet forever.
After many days of wreaking havoc, just when the pressure was extremely heavy and Hellmancer was sensing a dangerous pull by the planet.
It received the signal from its master, it was finally time!!
Suddenly Hellmancer's body began to glow, strange patterns lighting up around it. At that moment suddenly thick arms from the planet rose, finally pulling it with extreme force.
Back on the other side, Zihong panicked, he tried to throw the dark Knight away, sensing that something bad was about to happen.
In a calm voice, Vritra asked: "Did you also... prepare for this?"
"Swap!" with a shout, the bright bridge connecting Knight and Zihong shook.
And the two swapped places with each other, Zihong was screaming trying to do something as colourless flames burned around him.
But suddenly he further exchanged places with Hellmancer, getting thrown onto that very planet.
Hellmancer and Knight stood some distance away from each other, bowing respectfully towards Vritra.
Knight didn't understand what had just happened, he only remembered getting captured.
So Hellmancer shared the whole plan telepathically.
Vritra had made this plan to defeat Zihong the moment Dark Knight was captured.
And the fight wasn't only to test Vritra's strength, it was also to make Zihong reveal his main treasures.
That's why Vritra revealed most of his tricks and abilities.
Knight, yet again, was surprised by the plan of its master, quite amazed even.
Almost everything that happened here was already calculated, poor Zihong had no chance of winning.
On the other side, Zihong still couldn't understand what exactly had happened, as he suddenly found himself on a different planet.
Yet suddenly, a strangely familiar sensation enveloped him.
By the time he came to his senses, he felt the world laws tightly wrapped around him, pulling him down.
"W... What is going on?!!" he screamed and roared, using all his strength to get away from those arms and break free.
He had just arrived here so how come this planet was already trying to capture him?
Suddenly, everything clicked in his mind, that damned Vritra!! It was all because of him, so he had made this sort of plan!
Zihong felt shocked and enraged, he didn't underestimate his opponent at all, preparing his best to fight Vritra while he was busy with the apocalyptic game.
Even finding all those rarest treasures, which had now fallen into Vritra's hands.
RAAAAAAAAAAAA!!
He screamed resentfully, not wanting to accept this type of defeat, struggling endlessly as his body slowly sank into the planet.
World laws kept wrapping around him, rendering all his abilities useless, he couldn't even use time.
He had suffered this once already, and now again?
Within moments, he was already trapped near the planet's core, unable to move an inch.
Unable to do anything at all, his thoughts getting lost in endless darkness and loneliness.
A punishment worse than death, something he hated more than anything in the world.
But now he hated Vritra even more, his resentment couldn't be measured.
And just like that, Zihong once again got locked away, trapped for an unknown amount of time.
His mind wandering endlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 820 Lovely Treasures (Final!!)
paragraphs: Finally, Zihong was taken care of, Drino and his group were gone as well.
"I am done with the first step of our plan, that wasn't too hard." Vritra mumbled to himself as all his wives appeared in front of him.
Shitless and Onest also appeared, looking around in disbelief.
"Whoa, you really defeated him!" Onest muttered, wondering just how high Vritra's strength was.
They had seen the battle between them before Vritra got captured, and so far it seemed he was losing.
And then suddenly the vision was cut off, and they couldn't see the battle anymore.
"Yea, something like that, he is just locked away for now." Vritra said, then looked at Yennefer.
"This is for you." After speaking he took out a staff and made it float towards her.
The blue-haired empress had seen this staff and could sense the powerful time energy around it.
She stretched her hand out but stopped, looking back at Vritra quizzically.
"Wouldn't it be better for you to use this?" she asked, if he really used this then wouldn't his strength become even higher?
So, it was better if it stayed with him.
"Not really, my time field is already perfected, so it would be of little help to me.
But for you, it would be almost like comprehending time to a very high degree." Vritra said, watching her.
He could also feel a familiar feeling from it, as if it resonated with the Null ability.
He didn't know where Zihong had gotten it but it might have belonged to the previous users of Null.
Yennefer nodded, she finally held the staff and felt a wave of energy expand all around.
It felt so familiar, almost as if she had been using it all her life.
With this, her comprehension of Null would rise greatly and even the power output would become very high.
This was tailor-made for her, the staff itself seemed excited as if it possessed consciousness.
"Looks like Zihong hadn't made a connection with this staff and was just using it superficially. Thank you, husband." Yennefer smiled.
"Go ahead and form a connection, make it completely yours before we enter other dangers." Vritra urged.
"Here?" she asked, glancing around, there was nothing around but that also gave a sense of danger.
"Yes, go ahead." Vritra nodded and Yennefer no longer wasted any more time.
She closed her eyes and relaxed her posture; it didn't need her blood to form the connection.
The staff began to revolve around her, forming a strange energy barrier as everyone created some distance.
"Hmm this will take a few minutes..." Vritra mumbled then looked at the goddess.
"Diana, this one is for you." After speaking he took out a blue glowing knife.
Getting the spoils of war is really one of the best experiences in battle.
'Oh.' Diana perfectly remembered just how powerful this knife was, it was even able to cut through Vritra's physical defences.
And the attacks from it couldn't be stopped by any defences, it just passed through Vritra's weapon.
"M..." Diana opened her mouth but Vritra interrupted:

"This is for you, I don't need it. That god's tomb is powerful but it's slow, before you unleash its full power, the enemy won't give you enough time." Vritra said, as he sent it flying slowly towards her.
"..." Diana caught it, she sensed the unknown blue energy revolving around it but felt she couldn't use it yet.
She too would need to first form a connection, Zihong's connection had already been cut off by Vritra.
Without any further questions, Diana accepted the powerful knife, it would certainly increase her strength.
Then she looked at him and decided to thank her lovely master and husband.
"Meow~!"
Vritra: "..."
Diana covered her mouth as Vritra stared at her in surprise. He had seen their battle but hadn't paid much attention when they were talking.
"What's wrong?" he asked, looking at the goddess whose face was turning red.
"She lost a bet and that's the punishment for three days." Fiona spoke, laughing at her.
"I see, that was cute." Vritra appeared beside her, and his hand instinctively rose to pat her head.
Diana instantly relaxed, feeling a comfortable sensation spreading through her.
"Meow~"
Vritra inhaled a long breath, why does she look so cute? If she could have cat ears, it would be cuteness overload.
And what a pleasant surprise, Diana did have a cat costume she had worn before in the bedroom.
Vritra's hands turned into a blur as the fishing rod flashed for a moment, and he took out the cat ears from her inventory.
He put the almost realistic cat ears on her head, and took a good long look at her.
Her milky skin and blushing cheeks, she really looked too beautiful and cute, and too delicious.
Diana glanced up at him, not removing the cat ears, and saw the intense look in his eyes.
'So I look good to him? Then this is fine!' Diana no longer felt embarrassed, instead she was happy to have lost the bet.
'Heh. Thank you.' She glanced at the others and smiled.
"Tsk, did we make a mistake?" Maeve wondered, now feeling jealous of her. How dare that goddess steal the cute role from her, she is a fox!
"Haha." Yasmine also hadn't seen that bet so it seemed even funnier to her.
Vritra calmed himself down, this wasn't the time for that, he looked at Maeve and took out another great treasure from Zihong's collection.
"Foxie." Vritra called out, she too needed a good weapon.
Something that could match her shadow abilities.
"Yes, master!" she quickly appeared beside him, her tail moving cutely behind her.
Vritra smiled and patted her head too, then showed her another great treasure, which wasn't any weaker than the previous two.
There was a 10 or so centimetre long black needle resting over his palm, emanating darkness and poisonous energy.
Zihong sure made his preparations, but thankfully it all landed in Vritra's hands.
He thanked that good guy in his mind as he handed the needle to Maeve, while explaining:

"Be careful when using it, it matches your shadow attribute and also possesses a poison attribute, a very deadly one. But the greatest thing about this needle is its speed, it can almost match the speed of your thoughts within a certain range." Vritra handed it over to her.
Maeve was amazed, just the speed made it extremely deadly. It might not pierce through all defences but the opponent wouldn't even get the chance to do anything.
She held it and felt it merging perfectly into her palm, turning into a faint shadow.
The demoness could even change its size at will, turning it as small as 20 or so micrometres while as big as hundreds of metres.
This was truly an amazing weapon, and the more energy she injected the more potent the poison became.
"You two should just start too." Vritra said, looking at Diana and Maeve, who both nodded and started.
The process for everyone was different.
He looked at the rest of his wives, Vanessa and Fiona didn't need a strong weapon urgently.
Neither did Teresa, she could create all sorts of weapons.
So only Yasmine was the one who needed to get a better weapon that suited her, unfortunately there was nothing in Zihong's collection.
"Wifey, it looks like we will have to wait a little before you can get a strong weapon." Vritra said then added: "But you can look through this and check if there is anything to your liking."
"Okay, I will." Yasmine nodded.
Taking out a couple more weapons which were extremely powerful, and were at the level of a level 5 demi god, Vritra created a spatial ring.
And stored away the rest of the treasures into it, even the broken bell which trapped him earlier.
"Tess, these are for you." He tossed the ring at her and didn't explain anything.
"I have something for you as well." Tess quickly took out two energy orbs she had created.
One orb was full of the physiques she had absorbed from eight level 3 demi gods.
And the other was full of their souls.
"Oh." Vritra had almost forgotten about that, he took the two orbs.
Handing the soul orb to his soul wraiths, currently there were Dark Knight, Hellmancer, Bob, Bobby, the Chimera and Psyche.
Dark Knight was already at level 3 while Hellmancer was at level 1, they could distribute it among themselves.
Vritra squeezed the other orb, absorbing the enormous energy directly.
His physique instantly began to undergo a rapid transformation though nothing as shocking as earlier.
While absorbing he looked at Tess and lightly pinched her cheek.
"Thank you."
But Tess didn't reply, she just closed her eyes and tilted her face up, making Vritra chuckle lightly.
She still remembered that.
He leaned gently and pressed his lips against her soft black juicy lips, giving her a thank you kiss.
After a dozen or so seconds, they separated, Teresa looked very pleased.
She then walked over to Yasmine and the others, letting them see the treasures.
"What's for me?" Shitless asked excitedly.
CLAP CLAP
"Bravo sir Shitless, you did an amazing job." Vritra said, giving lots of praise.
Shitless's lips stretched into a thin line, it's not what he wanted.
"Haha, you can check and see if there are any treasures suiting you, I will absorb this energy now." Vritra said as he sat down and closed his eyes.
Very soon, a really dangerous adventure was about to start, something Vritra or even Divine had no idea about.
A totally unhinged and chaotic experience, the unbelievable games and more.

"Looks like Zihong hadn't made a connection with this staff and was just using it superficially.
Thank you, husband." Yennefer smiled.
"Go ahead and form a connection, make it completely yours before we enter other dangers." Vritra urged.
"Here?" she asked, glancing around, there was nothing around but that also gave a sense of danger.
"Yes, go ahead." Vritra nodded and Yennefer no longer wasted any more time.
She closed her eyes and relaxed her posture; it didn't need her blood to form the connection.
The staff began to revolve around her, forming a strange energy barrier as everyone created some distance.
"Hmm this will take a few minutes..." Vritra mumbled then looked at the goddess.
"Diana, this one is for you." After speaking he took out a blue glowing knife.
Getting the spoils of war is really one of the best experiences in battle.
'Oh.' Diana perfectly remembered just how powerful this knife was, it was even able to cut through Vritra's physical defences.
And the attacks from it couldn't be stopped by any defences, it just passed through Vritra's weapon.
"M..." Diana opened her mouth but Vritra interrupted:
"This is for you, I don't need it.
That god's tomb is powerful but it's slow, before you unleash its full power, the enemy won't give you enough time." Vritra said, as he sent it flying slowly towards her.
"..." Diana caught it, she sensed the unknown blue energy revolving around it but felt she couldn't use it yet.
She too would need to first form a connection, Zihong's connection had already been cut off by Vritra.
Without any further questions, Diana accepted the powerful knife, it would certainly increase her strength.
Then she looked at him and decided to thank her lovely master and husband.
"Meow~!"
Vritra: "..."
Diana covered her mouth as Vritra stared at her in surprise.
He had seen their battle but hadn't paid much attention when they were talking.
"What's wrong?" he asked, looking at the goddess whose face was turning red.
"She lost a bet and that's the punishment for three days." Fiona spoke, laughing at her.
"I see, that was cute." Vritra appeared beside her, and his hand instinctively rose to pat her head.
Diana instantly relaxed, feeling a comfortable sensation spreading through her.
"Meow~"
Vritra inhaled a long breath, why does she look so cute?
If she could have cat ears, it would be cuteness overload.
And what a pleasant surprise, Diana did have a cat costume she had worn before in the bedroom.
Vritra's hands turned into a blur as the fishing rod flashed for a moment, and he took out the cat ears from her inventory.
He put the almost realistic cat ears on her head, and took a good long look at her.
Her milky skin and blushing cheeks, she really looked too beautiful and cute, and too delicious.
Diana glanced up at him, not removing the cat ears, and saw the intense look in his eyes.
'So I look good to him?
Then this is fine!' Diana no longer felt embarrassed, instead she was happy to have lost the bet.
'Heh.
Thank you.' She glanced at the others and smiled.
"Tsk, did we make a mistake?" Maeve wondered, now feeling jealous of her.
How dare that goddess steal the cute role from her, she is a fox!
"Haha." Yasmine also hadn't seen that bet so it seemed even funnier to her.
Vritra calmed himself down, this wasn't the time for that, he looked at Maeve and took out another great treasure from Zihong's collection.
"Foxie." Vritra called out, she too needed a good weapon.
Something that could match her shadow abilities.
"Yes, master!" she quickly appeared beside him, her tail moving cutely behind her.
Vritra smiled and patted her head too, then showed her another great treasure, which wasn't any weaker than the previous two.
There was a 10 or so centimetre long black needle resting over his palm, emanating darkness and poisonous energy.
Zihong sure made his preparations, but thankfully it all landed in Vritra's hands.
He thanked that good guy in his mind as he handed the needle to Maeve, while explaining:
"Be careful when using it, it matches your shadow attribute and also possesses a poison attribute, a very deadly one.
But the greatest thing about this needle is its speed, it can almost match the speed of your thoughts within a certain range." Vritra handed it over to her.
Maeve was amazed, just the speed made it extremely deadly.
It might not pierce through all defences but the opponent wouldn't even get the chance to do anything.
She held it and felt it merging perfectly into her palm, turning into a faint shadow.
The demoness could even change its size at will, turning it as small as 20 or so micrometres while as big as hundreds of metres.
This was truly an amazing weapon, and the more energy she injected the more potent the poison became.
"You two should just start too." Vritra said, looking at Diana and Maeve, who both nodded and started.
The process for everyone was different.
He looked at the rest of his wives, Vanessa and Fiona didn't need a strong weapon urgently.
Neither did Teresa, she could create all sorts of weapons.
So only Yasmine was the one who needed to get a better weapon that suited her, unfortunately there was nothing in Zihong's collection.
"Wifey, it looks like we will have to wait a little before you can get a strong weapon." Vritra said then added: "But you can look through this and check if there is anything to your liking."
"Okay, I will." Yasmine nodded.
Taking out a couple more weapons which were extremely powerful, and were at the level of a level 5 demi god, Vritra created a spatial ring.
And stored away the rest of the treasures into it, even the broken bell which trapped him earlier.
"Tess, these are for you." He tossed the ring at her and didn't explain anything.
"I have something for you as well." Tess quickly took out two energy orbs she had created.
One orb was full of the physiques she had absorbed from eight level 3 demi gods.
And the other was full of their souls.
"Oh." Vritra had almost forgotten about that, he took the two orbs.
Handing the soul orb to his soul wraiths, currently there were Dark Knight, Hellmancer, Bob, Bobby, the Chimera and Psyche.
Dark Knight was already at level 3 while Hellmancer was at level 1, they could distribute it among themselves.
Vritra squeezed the other orb, absorbing the enormous energy directly.
His physique instantly began to undergo a rapid transformation though nothing as shocking as earlier.
While absorbing he looked at Tess and lightly pinched her cheek.
"Thank you."
But Tess didn't reply, she just closed her eyes and tilted her face up, making Vritra chuckle lightly.
She still remembered that.
He leaned gently and pressed his lips against her soft black juicy lips, giving her a thank you kiss.
After a dozen or so seconds, they separated, Teresa looked very pleased.
She then walked over to Yasmine and the others, letting them see the treasures.
"What's for me?" Shitless asked excitedly.
CLAP CLAP
"Bravo sir Shitless, you did an amazing job." Vritra said, giving lots of praise.
Shitless's lips stretched into a thin line, it's not what he wanted.
"Haha, you can check and see if there are any treasures suiting you, I will absorb this energy now." Vritra said as he sat down and closed his eyes.
Very soon, a really dangerous adventure was about to start, something Vritra or even Divine had no idea about.
A totally unhinged and chaotic experience, the unbelievable games and more.

chapters.title: Chapter 821 A Thief in the House
paragraphs: In a spacious room whose walls appeared to be made of space, star-like lights blinking all over them.
A figure, out of nowhere, suddenly flashed inside the room.
It was bright with countless shelves on the walls, and a round table at the centre with ten seats of different sizes arranged neatly around it.
The room was perfectly clean, no one had set foot in there in several weeks.
Several powerful demi gods were present outside, guarding the entrance to the Gods' Office.
It was completely silent, and even with the absence of the gods, the large room contained a heavy aura.
The demi gods outside ranging from level 8 to 10 were all startled, there were over 20 of them, ready to rush in.
"Forbid: One can't sense, see or hear beings weaker than them." There was a faint sound, and the twenty demi gods looked around in confusion.
There was clearly no one inside, they looked at each other.
[Lost Activated!]
But they all shrugged their shoulders as if nothing had happened and returned to their posts.
"Hoo." Vritra exhaled a long breath, finally it was time to carry out his biggest heist.
Stealing from the gods themselves, he was certainly a bit nervous. Those gods could kill him easily.
If even someone like Zihong could find countermeasures for the Forbidden skill then it couldn't stop gods for long.
Thankfully the gods were yet to return, as Divine had told him, they shouldn't be returning anytime soon... probably.
Calming his mind, Vritra looked around, searching for his targets.
The nervousness mixed with excitement made him feel a bit colder suddenly or was the office originally cold?
Who cares, Vritra perfectly remembered everything Divine had told him.
"I will send you to the Gods' Office." Divine said, floating in front of Vritra in its insect form.
"And then what?" Vritra asked.
"Looks like you have become quite proficient in using that fishing rod, that is exactly what we will need." Divine said and after a pause continued:
"There are a few things you have to steal. First is ten entrance beads, that is what one needs to enter the game, one for each of you."
Hearing that Vritra hummed and waited for further instructions.
"You can find them in a white drawer that has 108 four-clover leaves and 23 three-clover leaves, oh and also every third adjacent leaf must have a fly on it." Divine said while thinking hard.
This was from his observations the last time he went to meet the gods, that is exactly why he wasted that time playing games.
Or he could have just directly done his task.
"Uh... Okay." Vritra nodded, carefully remembering the details, it shouldn't be too hard to find right?
Then he questioned: "Wouldn't it be better to steal more for future games?"

"Haha. Getting greedy, are we? Well it will be pointless, you have to leave these extra beads there, it can fool the gods for some time. But after they find out about you, those fake beads will be discovered and all of it will be changed." Divine said.
"Oh, it makes sense." Vritra nodded, otherwise, Divine himself would have just taken those beads the previous times.
He nodded and stored the ten fake beads that Divine gave him.

"Now the second task is more important, it will be very complex and needs to be handled with extra care. One tiny mistake and the whole plan will be ruined. Then you would have to fight all those demi gods directly." Divine spoke in a solemn tone.
"Okay, I will do my best." Vritra put forth his utmost attention as Divine began to explain.
"You ten will be playing two different games, so you could level up twice, directly moving to level 5." Divine then continued:
"And to do that, you have to find the emblems of the two exact planets I am about to tell you and remove them from their original places and place them in a single void bubble."
Vritra couldn't properly understand but he continued to nod, then Divine explained in simpler terms.
And the process was certainly much more complex, just finding the two emblems would be so difficult.
Then finding the original void bubble and then the target void bubble and doing so much more.
Vritra's memory was exceptional, but even he had to hear the plan a few times to properly set it in his mind.
"Alright I understand, will you be coming with me as well?" he asked, while remembering the complex patterns and plans.
Certainly, it was so deeply hidden by the gods, he wondered how Divine even found out.
"Of course, I can't since you will be there." Divine said with a faint laugh and disappeared.
"Huh?"
Soon after, Vritra was teleported to this office and now he was ready to begin his work.
"Now, let's see where the drawer with 108 four-clover leaves and 23 three-clover leaves with those damned flies is." Vritra looked around at the countless drawers.
After scanning he found several hundred with 108 four-clovers then he reduced the number further by searching for the 23 three-clovers.
Even those were a lot, finally the last parameter.
'There it is!' Vritra found the drawer, he wasted no time and took out the fishing rod.
He didn't even need to open it, and began searching for the beads.
It still took him a few minutes, but he finally found those beads, each one was placed in particular spaces and away from one another.
'It's done!' his face was covered by sweat as Vritra stole exactly 10 beads and replaced them with the fake beads.
Now it was time for the main thing, it would merge two games into one, and turn it all into a mess.
Winning would be difficult but at least progression would be faster.
"Good job, task 1 complete." Divine's voice rang out in his mind, praising him.
Ignoring him, Vritra began to look for the second drawer which was a lot harder to find and had all sorts of protection placed over it.
"Welcome back!!" just then a loud united voice from the group sounded, as they all knelt at the same time.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Startled +1}
'What the fuck?!!' Vritra almost dropped the fishing rod he was holding.
The gods are back!!
Outside of the room, the ten gods who had just experienced an elongated punishment, had returned.
All of them were in terrible moods, unfortunately they couldn't do anything about the higher beings.
So, the first thing they had to do was kill Vritra, that thing took precedence over everything.
And they couldn't get dragged to court ever again, that place is too rigged.
"Relax." the old god spoke, his hands behind his back.
SLURP
The baby god licked the lollipop then chuckled, looking at the expressions of the other gods.
"Hehe. What's there to be sad about? Thankfully we didn't receive any major punishment." he spoke, offering his lollipop to the angry burly god.
"Tch. Keep that disgusting thing away from me, the moment I find that bastard, I am going to rip him apar-"
The ten gods suddenly paused as they saw a figure inside the office.

chapters.title: Chapter 822 The Godly Humiliation
paragraphs: "The moment I find that bastard, I am going to rip him apar-" the burly god was speaking in rage when they all suddenly froze.
Right after stepping into the room, they all saw a figure, someone they recognized very well.
"Yo, you sure made me wait quite long for you."
The man dressed in a black outfit sat over one of the gods' seats, looking at them with a bored expression.
"D- Divine!!" all the gods were alerted; they unconsciously took a step back.
The Sun God, leader of the ten, too almost took a step back but forced himself to stand straight.
"Divine, why are you here again?" The book-like god asked, a forced calmness in his voice.
"Why, of course I am here to congratulate you on your release." The Divine, with his head tilted and resting over his arm, looked over all ten of them.
There was a short period of silence, as they all just stared at one another.
"Wait, something is wrong..." the oldest god narrowed his eyes, staring at this odd Divine.
{Sin Point Gained: Doubted +1}
'F- Fuck, did he find out?' Vritra was going mad inside, cursing that damned Divine.
No wonder he said that, he knew Vritra would have to transform into himself.
If they found out his real identity, he would be killed right away.
"You are right, something indeed feels different." The eyeless burly god calmed himself and felt that this Divine wasn't putting out the sort of pressure that he did last time.
Was it a fake Divine?
{Sin Point Gained: Doubted +10}
GULP
Vritra swallowed his saliva, sweating heavily but thankfully, with his transformation, they couldn't see any of it.
He also used Misty Essence Mythic Halo to be safe.
Vritra had transformed into the image of the Divine he had seen just once, when he even punched Divine several times.
That was the only time Divine appeared in his real form, wait so, he knew this was going to happen from the start?
Is that why he showed him his human form?
But alas, it wouldn't be so easy to fool these veteran gods, but then Vritra noticed something.
'Wait, right, there should be 10 of them. But why are there only 9?' he was again startled, seeing only nine blurry figures.
{Sin Point Gained: Got Startled +1}
No matter how much he looked around, he couldn't find the tenth god.
[Nether Eye Activated!]
Afraid that the tenth god might launch a sneak attack, Vritra had to use his skill as a vertical eye appeared on his forehead.
Instantly he found the last god, a blurry silhouette of darkness appeared in his field of view.
"T- That eye!!" the eyeless god instinctively touched his face where the eye sockets were empty.
His rage instantly flared up. Divine, that bastard was the one who ripped away his powerful eyes.
"Oh, that's surprising, you want to attack me?" the Divine turned his head, as his playful expression disappeared, focusing all three pupils on the burly god.
BOOM
A heavy pressure suddenly pressed down on the burly god, making him unable to move.
'I- I can't move?! So it really is the Divine!'
{Sin Point Gained: Alerted +10}
On the other hand, Vritra was sweating even more heavily, he was really feeling quite nervous.
While pulling away the gods' attention he was also completing his final task.
Thankfully, he had Forbidden that worked even on the gods, or he would be done for.
"H- He really is the Divine!" the baby god shivered, clutching his head and chest.
"Hmm. Looks like you have enjoyed your stay quite a lot in prison, wanna play the same game again?" the Divine chuckled as the heavy pressure disappeared.
But none of the gods dared to move.
"Why exactly are you here for?" the Sun God didn't make a move but he didn't appear afraid, as the strongest among the ten and the leader, how could he appear weak?
But he too was a bit afraid of the Divine, so he didn't dare make any moves.
"Haa. You guys sure are boring, but consider yourselves lucky, I am not here to pop your heads again." The Divine shook his head and stood up.
Seeing the ten docile gods, Vritra wondered how they would feel later on, when reality was revealed.
Vritra walked closer to the gods, he stopped in front of the eyeless god.
"Heh. You are as unsightly as ever, didn't I do a favour by taking your eyes away, now you can look into the mirror all you want without scaring yourself."
Grrrr...
The burly god growled, barely holding himself back from attacking this damned Divine.
But the Sun God shook his head, this Divine was acting too strange, he was intentionally trying to provoke them.
There must be a reason, so they had to be careful and not fall for his trick.
But this time he had obtained a way to contact the Vespera family in case of such an emergency.
They would surely be happy to deal with the Divine.
He secretly sent the signal to the Vespera family, now they just needed to wait.
Far away, a beautiful blonde woman received the emergency signal, so she acted quickly and turned it off.
Returning to watching her husband.
'Damn, it took too long, I have to keep them distracted a while longer.' Vritra thought, he had almost found the drawer.
After passing the comment, Vritra didn't dare provoke this mad burly god anymore, he really might launch an attack.
And his trick would be exposed.
He then walked up to the frightened baby god, patting his head and speaking:
"Is your head still aching? I heard hitting the same place twice can make the pain go away, do you wanna try?"
The baby god shivered, hiding behind the largest god who remained silent like a statue.
"Also, kids shouldn't eat too many candies, okay?" he added and had finally found the drawer.
'Yes, now I just need to steal the two emblems from the void bubble...' Vritra was growing more nervous the longer he stayed there.
The pressure these gods exhibited made him feel suffocated, the difference in strength was too vast.
He needed to muster all his strength just to speak calmly.
"Why exactly have you come here?! Don't think I would be afraid of you even if your strength is higher, I am not afraid of a fight!!" the Sun God's angry voice almost made Vritra teleport away.
That damned Divine, it was all his fault.
Vritra's heartbeat rose rapidly, he couldn't remember the last time he was this nervous while doing something.
"Calm down, don't you know how scared of your attacks I am? Look I am shaking literally." The Divine spoke, raising his shaky hand.
'Ugh, I want to kill him, he dared to mock me!!' The Sun God almost launched an attack, but Vritra's hand was really shaking.
"And you lady, I don't remember telling you to stop your dance, do you want me to-"
Vritra looked at the shadow goddess, whose presence was so low that it was nearly impossible to remember her.
"..." the shadow goddess trembled and began to shake her body, left to right.
"You Divine bastard, it's fine if you come to kill us but how dare you humiliate us."

Seeing the ten docile gods, Vritra wondered how they would feel later on, when reality was revealed.
Vritra walked closer to the gods, he stopped in front of the eyeless god.
"Heh.
You are as unsightly as ever, didn't I do a favour by taking your eyes away, now you can look into the mirror all you want without scaring yourself."
Grrrr...
The burly god growled, barely holding himself back from attacking this damned Divine.
But the Sun God shook his head, this Divine was acting too strange, he was intentionally trying to provoke them.
There must be a reason, so they had to be careful and not fall for his trick.
But this time he had obtained a way to contact the Vespera family in case of such an emergency.
They would surely be happy to deal with the Divine.
He secretly sent the signal to the Vespera family, now they just needed to wait.
Far away, a beautiful blonde woman received the emergency signal, so she acted quickly and turned it off.
Returning to watching her husband.
'Damn, it took too long, I have to keep them distracted a while longer.' Vritra thought, he had almost found the drawer.
After passing the comment, Vritra didn't dare provoke this mad burly god anymore, he really might launch an attack.
And his trick would be exposed.
He then walked up to the frightened baby god, patting his head and speaking:
"Is your head still aching?
I heard hitting the same place twice can make the pain go away, do you wanna try?"
The baby god shivered, hiding behind the largest god who remained silent like a statue.
"Also, kids shouldn't eat too many candies, okay?" he added and had finally found the drawer.
'Yes, now I just need to steal the two emblems from the void bubble...' Vritra was growing more nervous the longer he stayed there.
The pressure these gods exhibited made him feel suffocated, the difference in strength was too vast.
He needed to muster all his strength just to speak calmly.
"Why exactly have you come here?!
Don't think I would be afraid of you even if your strength is higher, I am not afraid of a fight!!" the Sun God's angry voice almost made Vritra teleport away.
That damned Divine, it was all his fault.
Vritra's heartbeat rose rapidly, he couldn't remember the last time he was this nervous while doing something.
"Calm down, don't you know how scared of your attacks I am?
Look I am shaking literally." The Divine spoke, raising his shaky hand.
'Ugh, I want to kill him, he dared to mock me!!' The Sun God almost launched an attack, but Vritra's hand was really shaking.
"And you lady, I don't remember telling you to stop your dance, do you want me to-"
Vritra looked at the shadow goddess, whose presence was so low that it was nearly impossible to remember her.
"..." the shadow goddess trembled and began to shake her body, left to right.
"You Divine bastard, it's fine if you come to kill us but how dare you humiliate us."

chapters.title: Chapter 823 The Mindless God
paragraphs: "Hey hey, this is no time to be getting angry." Vritra shook his finger at the burly god, still pretending to be the Divine.
Then he sat back on the table and looked at the shadow goddess.
"You can stop now, instead let's play a simple game. Whoever blinks first loses, and if I lose, the Divine will have to do something for the winner."
Right after speaking, Vritra gave them no time and opened his eyes wide, staring at them.
"Ha! We didn't agree to this, do you think you can just come here and do as you please?" It was the Sun God who spoke, the others didn't want to fight the Divine.
"Sure, if you don't want to participate then why aren't you blinking? Blink and show me your courage." Vritra said, all three of his eyes wide open.
"You think I would lose to someone like you? Bring it on! If you lose I am going to make you regret it!" the Sun God retorted.
The other gods had frowns on their faces but didn't dare blink, the office suddenly fell silent.
With the ten gods staring at him, Vritra was sweating buckets, it was too sudden and that's the only thing he came up with.
Behind him, Hellmancer, Dark Knight and Psyche appeared, now he passed on the task of locating the exact planets.
Hellmancer is pretty smart and capable, he can even use the fishing rod and complete the task in Vritra's place.
He also called out Bob and Bobby, for moral support.
'I just need to hold on for a little longer, I am so going to kill that Divine after this.' Vritra kept staring.
A few minutes passed in silence, one of the guards from outside looked inside and was baffled.
The ten gods and that unknown man were just staring at each other and doing nothing, what was happening?
He didn't dare do anything and quickly looked away, what if he catches that disease or something.
"Wait, he is cheating!!" Vritra suddenly stood up on the table and shouted in an enraged tone.
He pointed at the burly god who had no eyes, adding: "He doesn't even have eyes, that's cheating."
"You... W- Who do you think ripped my eyes away?" the burly god almost jumped forward, shaking angrily.
"In any case, you are disqualified from this game. Leave the room!" Vritra ordered, staying in character to the end.
"How dare you-"
"Leave!" the Sun God gave the order, so the burly god could only leave.
Now only the ten of them remained in the absolute silence of the office.
'Master, I have found it! The planet numbered 8,929,852,593, should I start the process?' Hellmancer was the first to ask.
'Yes, just do it quickly, once you find the other, just finish it. We don't have much time.'
The soul wraiths could sense the nervousness emanating from their master, so they began to work quickly.
They controlled the fishing rod to steal the planet emblem and put it in a different void bubble.
All three of the soul wraiths got to work, doing their best relentlessly, going through each void bubble.
Psyche seemed the most motivated, rapidly doing his tasks.
"Wait, something is indeed strange..." suddenly the Sun God said and Vritra froze, trying to act calm he looked at the Sun God and smiled.
"Oh is that your trick to win the game? Too bad, this trick-" he was speaking when the Book God interrupted.
"Indeed, I had my followers do a little divination to find the relative direction of the Divine and it was nowhere near here." The Book God spoke.
"So, who are you exactly?" the expressions of all the gods suddenly shifted, the room filled with murderous intent.
Vritra suddenly burst out laughing, laughing so hard that tears came out of his eyes, then shaking his head he spoke:

"Hahahaha. You pitiful bugs, you think your pretty little tricks will work on me? You weaklings can find my location? Do you want me to prove if I am Divine or not? Should I?" the more nervous he felt, the more oppressive Vritra became.
If the act ends, he will too, there is no way he would admit it.
"This..." the Book God felt uncomfortable and unsure, yeah if it's Divine, they could be wrong.
He possesses all sorts of skills, but that divination is of the highest degree, not even the higher beings can stay hidden from it.
Is Divine really that strong?
"Prove it!" suddenly the Sun God took a step forward and challenged Vritra.
He was feeling really afraid, but he decided to be reckless to maintain his dignity, if it's really the Divine, then they would still have a chance to survive.
The help from the higher beings should be here at any moment, that fact gave him confidence.

"Hey end it quickly, they will catch you soon. Also, his confidence is rising from the help he is expecting from the higher beings, but it won't be coming, thanks to her." The Divine decided to help him, giving a way out.
Vritra's lips curled up, he tilted his head and looked straight at the Sun God.
"Haha. Such a confident little god, I am impressed. But the help you are expecting from those beings, it won't be coming here anytime soon. Are you sure you can handle the consequences on your own?"
Now it was the Sun God's turn to feel a shiver, how did he know about that signal?
Is it really Divine? Then won't he end up dying? Should I stand down?
'Master, I have found the other planet 69,392,000,067!!' Psyche suddenly shouted, stealing the planet emblem quickly.
'Master, I have found the desired Void Bubble.' Dark Knight added, sharing the details.
Vritra was overjoyed for a moment, praising the two in his mind, Dark Knight surprisingly found the right bubble so quickly.
This guy was also so smart but then Vritra and at the same time a shout came from outside.
"Aaaaaaaah. Fuck it, I am going to kill you!!" the blind god madly charged inside, lunging towards Vritra.
'Forbidden: Everything ugly cannot move!' Vritra hurriedly used the Forbidden.
[Forbidden Activated!]
Just a few centimetres away, the burly god was stopped, his attack almost blasted Vritra to pieces.
THUMP THUMP
His heart almost exploded, this mad bull, can't he play by the rules?
Why the fuck is he just charging like that? Are you not afraid of the Divine? I am the damn Divine, someone who kills higher beings for fun!!
Mindless people can't be reasoned with, and they are the worst enemies of smart people.
This skill too can't keep him frozen for long, but there was another problem, he shouted in his mind at his dear soul wraith.
'Psyche, that's the wrong number!' Vritra even made Bob and Bobby work now that the time was too little.
"..." The other gods looked at one another and finally felt that something was seriously wrong.
If it was really the Divine, they would have experienced a near-death experience a few times by now.
Especially that burly god, yet this Divine only froze him, either the Divine is too weak or it's just fake.
"Let's attack him!!" the Sun God finally made up his mind, he would take the gamble.
'Fuck fuck fuck, this is all because of the eyeless pig!! Forget the wrong number, throw whatever you found in it, at most the game will change!'
Vritra could only stop the gods for a few seconds with Forbidden, he didn't want them to already find a solution for this skill.
In the future they would have to fight without a doubt, if this skill gets useless then that would be a problem.
'My wraith soldiers, hurry it up! Destroy the void bubbles you have taken the emblems from and throw the emblems into one void bubble that Knight found!' Vritra gave the order.
The soul wraiths too panicked, it was like a disease spreading through the air.
Psyche who was about to put the wrong emblem back hurriedly began to pull it out.
Bob and Bobby who were supposed to help, ended up helping a bit too much, trying to look for the correct number and found:
Only Dark Knight remained still, since he had completed his task and instead focused on helping Vritra out.
But as a level 3 demi god, there was little he could do too.
'Done!'
'Done!'
'Done!'
'Done!'
Four "done" sounded at once, Vritra didn't pay them any mind, since now it was time to escape.
The soul wraiths, after finishing the tasks, just disappeared, now only Vritra remained there, facing the three gods.
"Hahaha. So you have found out my truth huh, well I am not afraid of fighting you. I am the next successor of the Divine, Zihong!"
Vritra said confidently, taking out the fishing rod that surprised the gods.
It was a treasure that shouldn't be possessed by someone of that level, even gods would kill each other for something like that.
"Zihongggggg!!" the Sun God roared as the fake Divine laughed and hooked himself with the fishing rod, throwing himself into the unknown space.
"Then see you again, you assholes." These words were left behind as his figure disappeared, attacks landing from all directions.
"Aaaaaah. Find him, we cannot let him escape!!" the Sun God ordered before adding: "And you Book, see why exactly he was here?"
"Y- Yes, I will." The Book God felt the killing intent of the Sun God, all of them had been fooled by a low-level demi god.
That was surely very humiliating.

chapters.title: Chapter 824 Negligible Mistake
paragraphs: The ten gods were going crazy, having been fooled by such a weak demi god.
They trembled in rage just thinking that they had been afraid of that person, going along with whatever he said.
Just because he used the Divine's name, they lost all reason.
"Find him at any cost, I will give him the most painful punishment!!" The Sun God roared as the nine gods dispersed in different directions.
Only the Book God was left there to check what damage that Zihong guy had caused.
"Haa. Where do I even start?" feeling a headache, the Book God began to check up on everything.
They can't overlook even a tiny error after what happened last time, or they would receive an even longer punishment.
The nine gods and countless demi gods began to search for him, looking far and wide, going through all planes and planets.
But they couldn't find anything, after some time they did find a Zihong but that Zihong had been locked up for a long time.
And he was still locked up, so were they fooled again?
That was not Zihong, and remembering the Nether Eye, they knew exactly who it was.
Vritra!!
ACHOO
On the other side, Vritra rubbed his nose, the gods sure were going hard at worrying about him.
'Heh, they found out rather late, there is no point now.' Vritra appeared in the Dimensional Book where the rest of his family was present.
"Honey, did you finish it?" Vanessa and the others hurriedly walked over, looking at him with worry.
"You fought with the gods? Cool!" Shitless's and Onest's eyes were gleaming, they appeared even more impressed.
"Of course, I finished the task." Vritra said with a smile then cursed under his breath and added:
"Just as I started all ten of the gods arrived there, I had to pretend to be Divine and fool the gods."
"Meow!"
{Sin Point Gained: Amazed +9}
"But once they recognize you, won't they chase and come right away to Zoratian Planet?" Maeve asked, glancing at the goddess who seemed to have gotten used to her punishment.

"They won't personally, but they will surely send some people to check this place up. But it's fine, the games are about to begin, oh right these guys helped me out." Vritra gestured as all the soul wraiths appeared, the Chimera for some reason seemed the proudest, despite not even making an appearance.
The ones who had done the main tasks were Dark Knight, Hellmancer, Psyche, Bob and Bobby.
"Thank you, lord." All of them responded, just then a fly appeared there, circling around the group.

"Good job, Vritra, that was an impossible-level task. The next games are going to be easy so you don't have to worry much, now give me the exact coordinates of the two planets." Divine said, and as always his voice was only heard by Vritra, who nodded and instructed.
"Give the coordinates of the two planets you stole and put in the void bubble."
Dark Knight stepped back, since his task wasn't to steal the planet emblem but to find the void bubble.
He would give the exact information later.
The other soul wraiths replied respectfully.
"Planet: 69,391,000,067, the coordinates are..."
"Planet: 69,393,000,067, the coordinates are..."
"Planet: 69,394,000,067, the coordinates are..."
"Planet: 10,452,211,305, the coordinates are..."
Vritra: "?!!"
"Huh? You don't have to speak at once, just the ones who remember the coordinates of the two can speak."
Vritra said calmly but the four spoke again, each speaking a different serial number of the planet.
By now, everyone was confused.
"Wait, wait! Hellmancer, you go first." Vritra said, rubbing his forehead, what he was thinking had gone wrong.
"Planet: 10,452,211,305, the coordinates are..."
"Correct, that's one of the planets we needed to select." Divine nodded, then waited.
"Uh now, Psyche, you tell me." Vritra spoke, trying to remain calm.
"Planet: 69,391,000,067, the coordinates are..."
"No, that's not the right planet, the number was 69,392,000,066!" Vritra said, a grave look on his face, but then tried to calm himself down.
"It's alright, one game would change, that is not a problem. I am sure that with your strength, you can handle these games." Divine added, further calming them all down.
The first game would be for the level 3 demi gods while the second game is for level 4 demi gods.
That's why Divine had selected games where victory wouldn't be guaranteed just based on strength.
And with the Forbidden skill, Vritra would have a greater chance at victory, directly evolving to level 5.
Vritra sighed and looked at Dark Knight: "Now go ahead and-"
Bob and Bobby were drenched in sweat, although imaginary, they were shaking in their positions.
"COUGH. M- Master, there is uhm something we would like to add..." Bob muttered, gathering his confidence and speaking nervously.
"What is it?" Vritra had a bad feeling in his heart as he glanced at Shitless, who showed a forefinger, indicating that this was the beginning.
"I- I also added one emblem of a planet..." Bob spoke in a mosquito-like voice that none could hear at the end.
But the starting words were enough to freeze everyone, even Divine looked on in bafflement.
"Hahaha, your sense of humour has become better, good job but this is not the time to joke." Vritra said, chuckling and shaking his head, going into denial.

"Master! M- M- Me too, I too... uh it's not my fault, I was just eh following Bob, he said to do it, but please don't punish him too much just beat him half to death." Bobby also decided to come clean.
Initially the two were unable to talk but now they could talk in normal human language and voices.
"Oh, brother-in-law, it was good knowing you." Divine suddenly felt sad, both his sisters were about to become widows at once.
What a sad day to be alive, he would rather spray insect-killing spray on himself.
Of course, his sisters would be safe.
"Bob, Bobby, Psyche..." with a small smile, Vritra looked at the three hard-working soul wraiths who had just fucked up the whole situation.
As the reality sank in, he suddenly felt like the number of soul wraiths was too high.
He looked at the proud Chimera, it did have every right to be proud, not doing anything was far better than fucking things up.
Dear Chimera, do you want to taste your brothers? Want to turn into a big ball?
Why would Vritra need the gods or other demi gods to harm him, when he was carrying such helpful loyal wraiths, truly too blessed he was.
Pride burst out of his eyes as he looked at the three entities.
After a few minutes had passed, Vritra finally got a hold of his emotions, and decided to forgive the three after all everyone makes mistakes.
And forgiveness is a virtue, they had helped him a lot in the past, now is not the time to fuss over this but to plan how to deal with the future problems.
GULP
Psyche silently tried to merge into the background, hoping to forever be forgotten and become one with the environment.
The sky is so beautiful, but why was the way ahead full of darkness?
"Knight and Hellmancer, here, take these three away and beat them until they remember the exact number of that planet." Vritra passed on the spatial page of the Dimensional Book.
"Masterrrrrrrrrrr, I wasn't even at faultttt..." Psyche screamed as he got dragged away by his two loving elder brothers.
"Fuck!!" Vritra almost crushed the insect flying before him, feeling so angry.
"Meow..."
"Ugh. D- Does that mean we have to participate in four different games at once?!" clutching her head with both hands, Yasmine exclaimed.
"Yes, four different games at once, competing with a total of 40 demi gods. From level 3 to 6, congrats!" Divine was so shocked that he actually, for the first time, spoke out loud.
But no one paid it any mind.
THUD
Shitless fell over on his butt, wiping the sweat from his bald head, so is it time to finally die?
Would his dreams be crushed? He would never be able to stomp on a god's head? Curse them, slap them, make them run like a dog?
Such small wishes would be buried now?
Shitless began to pray quickly, hoping it would work.
Onest sat down and began to create something with mud, they were all inside a Dimensional Book where the ground was just like Zoratian Planet.
"I should prepare my grave in advance, the tomb of the greatest thief of all time!"
"Our b- baby..." Yasmine touched her very slightly bulging belly over her clothes, worried about the future.
It's only been a bit over a month and a half since she got pregnant, she too didn't want to die.
"Meow..." Diana also muttered something but none could understand her concern.
"We were going to enter the games to escape from those powerful demi gods and now we are going directly to meet them?" Fiona felt a strong headache.
"Calm down, it might not be that bad, r- right?" Vritra said, glancing up at Divine, who was suddenly rotating around them at a high speed.
"No, it's very bad, you are dead meat Vritra. Even a thousand years of prayer wouldn't do anything." Divine said, glancing at Shitless.
Hearing that, everyone became even more worried, speaking at once.
Onest lay in his grave as he pulled the scared Shitless into the grave like a ghost.
It was a complete mess, Vritra looked up and didn't know what to say or do.
Why were the stars suddenly shining so brightly? Were they mocking him? Damn them!!

paragraphs: TIP TIP
Drops of blood dripped from the tip of a blade held in the trembling hands of a robber.
"I- I just asked... you to hand o- over the money, I- I didn't want to kill!"
CLANG
The knife fell to the ground into the growing pool of blood. Before him lay a corpse, its eyes empty and staring lifelessly at him.
The man wore a black outfit, a deep wound visible across his belly. Beside him, a bald guy cowered in fear.
The Baldy pushed himself backward while begging for his life, almost pissing his pants.
The robber finally came to his senses. He checked the pockets of his victim and found only a compass.
It was a dark alley, the surrounding tall buildings completely hiding the brutal scene from the eyes of others.
Throwing the compass away and picking up the knife again, he looked at the Baldy.
"Y- You have to die too, I don't want to get caught!!"
The robber suddenly charged forward, stabbing the knife toward the Baldy's neck.
Outside the dark alley, on the main bustling street, a man holding an umbrella looked at the scene for a few moments.
"Haa, there doesn't seem to be any anomaly here either. Sigh, do we need to change the region or something?"
After staring at the scene for a few more moments, he finally walked away.
WHISH
The knife stabbed toward the Baldy's neck, but instead of piercing through, it bent the moment it struck him.
"H- Huh? What's... happening?" the robber stumbled back, falling onto his butt.
"Ugh, what a great start we got the moment we arrived here."
The corpse suddenly sat up. The blood disappeared, and the wound was gone as well.
Pushing his hair back, he muttered, "It is fine now, come out."
Instantly, eight people walked through the wall.
"W- W- What?!!"
The robber was terrified. He wanted to run away, but his body wouldn't move.
"Tsk, what a disgrace to the name of thieves. So pathetic."
Onest spoke while picking up the compass.
Vritra got up. He took the compass and stared at it.
"Finally, the danger is gone. That was too sudden."
After passing through the portal, the group found themselves in this alley.
To begin the game, they decided to check the compass, which was supposed to be of great help.
But the moment they took it out, it began to show the highest-level threat. That was why they tried to hide quickly.
Yet at the last moment, that robber and the level 6 demi god appeared and saw Vritra and Baldy, and hence the whole scene played out.
The level 6 demi gods arrived there the fastest, while the others were still just arriving.
Soon, they might start to understand the situation, and even the gods would become aware of it.
"We need to move quickly, and as discussed, our goal is..."
After speaking, Vritra raised the compass.
It pointed to their south, and a golden crown appeared at the tip of the needle.
The town looked quite similar to Earth, with tall buildings and people rushing to their jobs.
But Vritra could tell it was far from Earth. There were strong people mixed among ordinary citizens.
The compass also showed them a map, though it wasn't very detailed, and according to it, this was a small town.
It was still daytime, so the only people they had to worry about were the level 6 demi gods.
They just had to act as normally as possible.
As long as those demi gods didn't think of them as abnormalities, they would remain safe.
"So, shall we get started?"
Vritra pointed toward a tall building in the distance with a signboard that read: Night Corp.
These games with high danger and small objectives would take less time.
So they had to do everything as quickly as possible.
"What about him?" Shitless asked, pointing toward the robber.
Vritra glanced at the robber, who was about to faint from fear, then spoke:
"Psyche, kill him and take over him."
A shadow flew out from under Vritra's feet, killing the robber instantly.
Then the man calmed down. He stood up and wiped the sweat off his forehead.
There were various scars on his face, but Psyche changed his appearance slightly.
"Master, it seems there aren't many level 6 demi gods in this town, and no one seems to have grasped the situation here yet," Maeve spoke while using the shadows to monitor the surroundings.
She was being extremely careful, not even going close to any demi gods, but those arrogant people didn't even try to hide their auras.
Of course, they would only understand the gravity of the situation once they found out about the mess.
"We have to be careful of the abnormalities as well. It wasn't stated that they would be weak. While others are searching for them, they might also be searching for their prey."
Vritra instructed them calmly.
While talking, the eleven people walked out of the alley.
Since their appearances were too eye-catching, they were using light camouflage to make themselves look ordinary.
The people walking in a hurry glanced at them only once before minding their own business.
"The crown bearer or the crown itself should be there. The level 3 demi gods will be easy to deal with. But even their game won't be so easy. There will definitely be people hunting them, sigh..."
Yennefer sighed while speaking.
They had to do everything while being careful of the players and all the other dangers.
This was really too much for them when they were only level 3 demi gods.
"Look, want to try that cotton candy?"
Yasmine pointed toward a shop, smiling as if the games didn't matter to her at all.
"Sure, let's go. You got any money?"
Turning back, Vritra looked at Psyche, who checked his pockets and handed over all the money he had.
Getting to the shop, Vritra purchased cotton candy for all eleven people.
He paid the money and took the cotton candy, but then he felt a tug on his sleeve.
Looking down, he saw a little girl wearing ragged and dirty clothes. One finger was in her mouth as she licked her lips.
"You want this?" Vritra asked, while internally remaining alert. Could this be one of the creatures here?
"Y- Yes..." she spoke in a low, fearful voice.
"Damnit, what are you doing here again? Get away before I beat you up!!"
The fat shopkeeper glared at her while picking up a stick.
"It's alright, I'll buy one for her."
Vritra handed over the money and gave her the cotton candy.
Then he turned and started walking with the others.
He was nervous and observing everything carefully.
Whether it was the shopkeeper, the cotton candy, or the little girl.
"Is she still following us?" Yennefer asked, glancing back at the little girl.
She silently kept following behind them like a lost puppy.
Frowning, Vritra suddenly stopped.
He stepped in front of a man who was looking at his watch.
"Wha- hey, what are you doing?"
The man paused abruptly, ready to fight Vritra.
"Are you a woman? And you better lie!"
Vritra glared at him while releasing a bit of his killing intent.
"Hieeek! I- wha? Y- Yes, I am a woman!"
The man was scared shitless, stumbling and falling backward.
{Sin Point Gained: Deceived +1}
'Sigh, this is great. It is still working perfectly.'
Vritra patted the man's shoulder and started walking again.
They had to get the crown first. Everything else could wait, and the compass didn't show any danger coming from that little girl.
Ignoring her, the group increased their pace, almost running toward the tall building with the signboard: Night Corp.
Thankfully, they didn't encounter any danger.
The other players must still be busy getting familiar with this place.
Walking into the building, they started climbing the stairs, quickly reaching the twentieth floor.
TIC
"The compass is pointing toward this office. The crown must be inside."
Vritra gestured for the others to stay where they were.
"Hubby, let us all barge inside. It could be dangerous," Yasmine spoke in a low voice.
"It's alright. If you feel something is wrong, you can enter."
Without giving them any chance to argue further, Vritra was already walking forward.
Vritra couldn't describe this feeling.
It was unlike anything he had ever felt before.
Not even in the presence of the gods or Evelyn.
Was this sort of pressure normal for a game meant for level 3 to level 6 demi gods?
What exactly was inside?
Gulping, he pushed open the door and walked inside.
The office was spacious and clean. There wasn't a single person in sight.
It looked like a completely normal office, except for the creepy feeling that was gnawing at Vritra's mind and soul.
There was a table where a few items were placed neatly, and behind it sat a chair with its back facing Vritra.
There was a signboard that read:
'Emp. Dracon.'
The compass buzzed.
He was very close to the crown.
"Uh, excuse me?"
Vritra called out.
He had initially planned to attack, but after coming here, he couldn't bring himself to do it.
There was no response.
Was there even a person there?
Clenching his fists, he started walking forward.
Although the pressure was undeniable, it wouldn't make him freeze.
Suddenly, just as he got close to the glass table, the chair turned and the person sitting on it became visible.
And it shocked Vritra.
He was seeing this person for the first time.
White hair, red eyes, and extremely handsome features.
His charm wasn't one bit lower than Vritra's own, maybe it was even higher.
"Uhm, who are you?" Vritra asked.
He could tell this person was very strong.
"Hello, Vritra. You might not recognize me yet, but we are friends... in a way."
The other person spoke, his aura undeniably heavy and strangely charming.
