Looking down, he saw a little girl wearing ragged and dirty clothes.
One finger was in her mouth as she licked her lips.
"You want this?" Vritra asked, while internally remaining alert.
Could this be one of the creatures here?
"Y- Yes..." she spoke in a low, fearful voice.
"Damnit, what are you doing here again?
Get away before I beat you up!!"
The fat shopkeeper glared at her while picking up a stick.
"It's alright, I'll buy one for her."
Vritra handed over the money and gave her the cotton candy.
Then he turned and started walking with the others.
He was nervous and observing everything carefully.
Whether it was the shopkeeper, the cotton candy, or the little girl.
"Is she still following us?" Yennefer asked, glancing back at the little girl.
She silently kept following behind them like a lost puppy.
Frowning, Vritra suddenly stopped.
He stepped in front of a man who was looking at his watch.
"Wha- hey, what are you doing?"
The man paused abruptly, ready to fight Vritra.
"Are you a woman?
And you better lie!"
Vritra glared at him while releasing a bit of his killing intent.
"Hieeek!
I- wha?
Y- Yes, I am a woman!"
The man was scared shitless, stumbling and falling backward.
{Sin Point Gained: Deceived +1}
'Sigh, this is great.
It is still working perfectly.'
Vritra patted the man's shoulder and started walking again.
They had to get the crown first.
Everything else could wait, and the compass didn't show any danger coming from that little girl.
Ignoring her, the group increased their pace, almost running toward the tall building with the signboard: Night Corp.
Thankfully, they didn't encounter any danger.
The other players must still be busy getting familiar with this place.
Walking into the building, they started climbing the stairs, quickly reaching the twentieth floor.
TIC
"The compass is pointing toward this office.
The crown must be inside."
Vritra gestured for the others to stay where they were.
"Hubby, let us all barge inside.
It could be dangerous," Yasmine spoke in a low voice.
"It's alright.
If you feel something is wrong, you can enter."
Without giving them any chance to argue further, Vritra was already walking forward.
Vritra couldn't describe this feeling.
It was unlike anything he had ever felt before.
Not even in the presence of the gods or Evelyn.
Was this sort of pressure normal for a game meant for level 3 to level 6 demi gods?
What exactly was inside?
Gulping, he pushed open the door and walked inside.
The office was spacious and clean.
There wasn't a single person in sight.
It looked like a completely normal office, except for the creepy feeling that was gnawing at Vritra's mind and soul.
There was a table where a few items were placed neatly, and behind it sat a chair with its back facing Vritra.
There was a signboard that read:
'Emp.
Dracon.'
The compass buzzed.
He was very close to the crown.
"Uh, excuse me?"
Vritra called out.
He had initially planned to attack, but after coming here, he couldn't bring himself to do it.
There was no response.
Was there even a person there?
Clenching his fists, he started walking forward.
Although the pressure was undeniable, it wouldn't make him freeze.
Suddenly, just as he got close to the glass table, the chair turned and the person sitting on it became visible.
And it shocked Vritra.
He was seeing this person for the first time.
White hair, red eyes, and extremely handsome features.
His charm wasn't one bit lower than Vritra's own, maybe it was even higher.
"Uhm, who are you?" Vritra asked.
He could tell this person was very strong.
"Hello, Vritra.
You might not recognize me yet, but we are friends... in a way."
The other person spoke, his aura undeniably heavy and strangely charming.

chapters.title: Chapter 830 Benefits of Death
paragraphs: "Dracon? Who are you?" Vritra asked, looking quizzically at the man before him.
He was sure he had never seen or heard of him, and yet this guy was seated here as if he had been waiting for him.
"Vritra, you don't know me yet, so don't think too hard about it. Anyway, I was passing by, so I thought I would meet a future friend." He smiled as a crown finally appeared in his hand.
"..." Vritra couldn't understand the meaning. Was this supposed to be an anomaly?
Or a ploy by the gods? Whatever the case might be, he could tell that defeating this guy was impossible.
So, Vritra didn't initiate a fight and simply asked, "Who are you?"
"Here, this is for you." The guy threw the crown to Vritra and said, "And I am Jayden. We will meet again soon, so don't die here."
He stood up and then started walking toward the door.
"Wait, is that it?" Vritra asked. He really couldn't make sense of anything.
Was this a trap?
"Would you rather fight me? We have already done all that, so there is not really a point. Also, there is a flag in this building too."
Without turning or stopping, he spoke, then opened the door and left.
Vritra was left standing inside the room in confusion, holding the crown and feeling certain that it was the real thing.
Remembering that his family was still outside, Vritra quickly walked out, unable to trust that shady guy.
Pushing open the door, Vritra found everyone waiting there for him.
"You found it!" Maeve said, looking at the golden crown.
"Where is that guy?" Vritra asked, glancing around, but there was no sign of Jayden.
"What guy? No one appeared here," Yasmine said, looking equally confused.
"You all didn't see anyone walk out of this door?" Vritra asked in exasperation.
"No, there was no one." This time, Fiona replied.
"Pitiful one, no one can hide from my cursed eyes, but there really was no one here," Shitless added.
Sighing, Vritra knew it was pointless to think any more about this matter. Maybe he would meet Jayden again in the future.
He was so strong that he could simply pass through such games, where even gods couldn't interfere once they had started?
"Yes, I got the crown." Vritra looked back at them and didn't explain further; now the question was who was going to wear the crown.
The wearer would be in danger but would also have more privileges, so he had to be careful.
Vritra looked around, and Shitless puffed out his chest proudly.
"I am ready to take over this danger-"
But Vritra interrupted him.
"You are too careless, so not you. Hmm, wifey, you should wear it." He looked at Yasmine and extended the crown toward her.
"Okay." She didn't question or refuse and gracefully accepted the crown as Vritra placed it on her head.
Instantly, a message flashed before the eyes of all fifty participants in the game.
[The Crown Bearer has appeared!]
[The country now has a ruler, and everyone must abide by their laws!]
But before Yasmine, many more messages flashed with far more information.
Vritra had chosen her because she was a good ruler, responsible, and still had Divine's protection.

"Uh... Hubby, it seems I can set one rule for the whole country once a day," Yasmine said, then continued, "And I have a certain level of authority over the people of this country, including all players, but controlling strong people would be a bit difficult for long."
There were many details that couldn't be explained briefly, but she quickly spoke about a pressing matter.
"As the ruler, everyone can see my location. So players might swarm in soon," she said nervously.
They couldn't fight higher-level demi gods, and if a battle broke out, the commotion would be too great.
"Hmm." Vritra nodded; he had expected something like that.
It was no big problem. On top of that, Yasmine had gained a very useful ability.
"First, set a rule quickly." Vritra then explained his idea to her.
In and outside the town, people busy with different tasks suddenly saw a glow.
Then a tiny dot appeared in their vision, pointing toward Yasmine's direction before the messages flashed.
Except for the level 3 demi gods, everyone else was confused.
Only the level 3 demi gods hurried forward to steal the crown.
But soon they came to their own conclusions; some believed it to be a flag, while others thought it was a calamity or an anomaly.
Whoever they were, they were already heading toward that building.
[The Ruler has announced a rule!]
[Entering buildings during the day is prohibited!]
This announcement made everyone pause, especially the level 4 demi gods; those who were already inside buildings didn't dare leave.
The others decided to get close to that building and wait for nightfall.
Back inside the tall building, Yasmine looked back at Vritra after making the announcement.
"Alright, for now, we are good." Vritra nodded, but the others still had many questions.
This could save them temporarily, but as soon as night fell, a lot of people would rush in.
They couldn't go outside either, so what was he planning?
"Wifey, can you see the directions of all the players or anything else?" he asked, as Vritra had some plans, but they would have to be constantly improvised based on the current situation.
"Hmm." Yasmine glanced around, turning in a full circle.

"I can indeed sense their general directions; I think I can find them," Yasmine replied, then added, "I can also vaguely sense the general directions of the abnormalities and the flags, and one is very close."
"Alright, then let's get our hands on that flag first. We can't leave the building yet, so we will chill here for a while."
Vritra spoke and started walking toward the lower floors, the others following him, though still unsure of his plans.
"Did you catch my disease? Why are you creating such suspense?" Divine asked as he appeared beside Vritra in his bug form.
'We are different. I will explain once I have secured a flag. I don't use my family like you do,' Vritra said, flicking the insect away.
Yasmine led them while sensing the presence of the flag. Upon reaching the ground floor, she pointed downward and said, "It is somewhere down there."
"Are there more floors underground?" Shitless scratched his head and asked.
"There are." A vertical eye opened on Vritra's forehead as he looked down; he could also see something blurry.
They were in a large hall, and many people were inside.
Even normal people couldn't enter any buildings for now, and they all looked respectfully at Yasmine.
"You! Come here and tell us which path leads underground." Yasmine gestured toward a woman.
"Y-Yes, please allow me to lead you." The woman hurriedly approached and bowed before gesturing toward the back area of the hall.
There was an elevator that was barely visible, and surprisingly, there were three floors underground.
"You can go back." Yasmine dismissed her, and the ten entered, pressing the number one button.

Vritra turned to face them all and began to speak, "As long as everyone sees the mark of your crown, we won't be able to progress peacefully. Those level 5 and level 6 demi gods will definitely come after us, along with others too."
"That is true, and it is impossible to stay hidden from them," Maeve added.
"Meow." Diana hummed in agreement.
Yasmine wanted to lock all the buildings for the whole day, but it was impossible to do so at night because of the 'Flag and Hide' game's settings.
This safety wouldn't remain for long.
"Thankfully, the flag is close to us. But first, who among us is accustomed to death?" Vritra asked.
"Me!" Yennefer raised her hand. "I stayed dead for several months."
"Uhm, I almost died too, if that counts," Yasmine added.
"..." Onest's lips stretched into a thin line. What sort of question was that even?
They were talking about death as if it were just some place they had visited.
"Hmm, I too have experienced it more than once before, so, Onest, my friend." Vritra suddenly turned, placing a hand on Onest's shoulder.
"Y-Yeah?" Onest suddenly felt as though something was stuck in his throat. He wanted to take a step back, but the elevator wasn't big enough.
'Heh, hahaha, muahahaha.' Shitless grinned madly but didn't let out a single sound, fearing he might end up replacing his comrade and taking on the mission.
"Have you ever experienced death?" Vritra asked, his smile seeming strangely evil to Onest.
"No, never. I am really bad at it. If I try, I might actually die. I think someone unkillable like Shitless is better suited for it," Onest spoke hurriedly.
"You know, there is a first time for everything in life. You should really give dying a try. You can't possibly understand how fun it is. Just for the love of the game, try it."
Vritra spoke as the elevator doors opened.
They found themselves in a dark basement; it wasn't even painted and had nothing in sight.
After taking a proper look around, they pressed the button for the second floor, and Vritra continued explaining the benefits of dying.
Onest was really starting to wonder if dying was actually that fun of an experience.
"Of course, you won't actually die, just like taking a short nap and waking up right after. Isn't that perfect? You will be stronger than Shitless after this," Vritra said as the doors opened again.
GRRRRRR
Strange drilling sounds echoed loudly from all around them, and then a surprising sight came into view.

chapters.title: Chapter 831 Dozers
paragraphs: Grrrrrrrrr
A loud whirring sound rang out as the doors to the elevator opened. This hall was even larger, covering a diameter of at least a couple of kilometres.
BOOM BOOM
GRRRRRRRR
Vritra didn't pay attention to the creatures or the sound. He quickly scanned the area but couldn't sense the flag.
"Yeah, it's probably down below," Yasmine mentioned as well.
"Let's go then, no need to pick a fight with these things. They are a challenge for Level 4 demigods, it won't be easy," Fiona spoke.
She loved to fight, but not idiotic fights with no gains.
Without getting out, they pressed the button and the doors closed, then the elevator continued down.
"So, hubby, what exactly is your plan with this... death planning?" Yasmine asked as they all turned toward Vritra, especially Onest.
He had indeed been influenced by Vritra's words, getting gaslighted into believing him.
"First of all, we need to remove the threats so we won't be chased constantly by them, and we do that by feigning the death of the crown bearer. It will be a little tough, though," Vritra replied.
Before long, the elevator reached the lowest floor and the doors opened.
It was perfectly lit, well furnished, clean, and looked to be some sort of parking area.
But there wasn't a single person in sight. The entire place was empty.
"It is here," Yasmine spoke. This place was equally as big as the last floor, with a lot of pillars marking the parking areas.
"Let's hurry up, it is already afternoon here," Teresa said. She had calibrated the clock to the local time.
The group carefully started walking. They didn't separate in this unknown place, staying on high alert.
"Is that it?" Onest pointed toward a barrel inside which a pole was visible.
A cloth was tied to the top of it. It was brown in colour and rather short compared to the entire pole.
Yasmine took the lead and held it, her eyes lighting up.
"Indeed, this is the flag."
After making sure, she picked it up and extended it toward Onest.
But just then...
GRRRRRRR
The same whirring sound began to ring out again, accompanied by loud vibrations from some machines and deep growls.
"They came down?" The ceiling broke with a loud boom and suddenly dozens of large objects fell down, creating deafening noises.
Dust flew in all directions, and strange gurgling noises made everyone's ears ache.
"Ughh, what the hell is this now?" Clutching their heads, the group of eleven remained inside the elevator.
SWISH
Hellmancer and Dark Knight appeared before them, along with Chimera, Bob, and Bobby.
"Go check it out," Vritra commanded. Psyche was in a human body and it would be a waste to let it die just yet.
The two spheres rolled forward, then the remaining three wraiths also flew out, disappearing into the shadows.
A strange and sinister laughing sound rang out as the rumbling grew louder. Within moments, Bob and Bobby died.
Then it was Chimera's turn. They died so quickly despite supposedly being Level 3 demigods.
As the dust settled and things became clear, Vritra was surprised by the sight.
There were over fifty large vehicles. They looked like tractors of some sort with dangerous rotating blade mechanisms at the front.
The blades spun menacingly, looking as if they could tear apart the world itself.
On top of each vehicle of destruction, or rather each dozer, one or two creatures sat.
They looked like the goblins Vritra had faced before in a labyrinth, but with body structures similar to humans.
Tall and burly bodies.

'...I had this doubt before, but the players are all Level 3 to 6 demigods, so if even the weakest fight seriously, the whole country will be doomed. How is the game going to continue like this?' Vritra questioned, not making any moves yet.
From the speed at which his three wraiths had been killed, it was obvious these were no weak dozers.
It was supposed to be a trap for Level 4 demigods after all.

"That is true, which is why the level of destruction will automatically be reduced. Even Level 6 demigods won't be able to destroy a building completely in a short time," Divine said, but quickly added, "That doesn't mean you all have been weakened, so you still have to be careful."
Nodding, Vritra turned to watch how long Dark Knight and Hellmancer would last against those things.
Compared to their sizes, those dozers were moving rather fast and none of them collided with one another.
Hellmancer cast several spells, but none could stop those machines or even affect the creatures sitting on them.
WHIRRRRRRR
Before Hellmancer could react, a dozer struck him from the side, smashing him against the rotating blades.
He exploded into a mass of smoke immediately.
On the other hand, Dark Knight held his sword and stood before an approaching dozer.
BANG
The rotating blades struck him, pushing Dark Knight back as sparks flew in all directions from his blade.
CRACK
After a few moments, his heavy sword began to crack under the force of the fast-moving dozer.
Dark Knight rotated in the air, turned into dark smoke, and flew directly toward the driver of the dozer.
'Oh, impressive.'
Among all his wraiths, Dark Knight was definitely the strongest, though Hellmancer might compete for that spot.
CLANG
Unfortunately, the blades struck the metallic structure at the side first, unable to cut through.
'What are these things made of?' Vritra was surprised but had no intention of fighting just yet.
Those dozers would be upon them quickly, and even the elevator wouldn't be safe since their escape route was the first thing those monsters had cut off.
"They are intelligent creatures," Yennefer spoke, wondering which of her elements would work best against them.
She was just thinking when suddenly her body began to turn into magma. Her hands melted first.
"What?"
Vritra, who had been watching the battle with full focus, was startled once again.
In this game, he was on edge at all times. They were facing people far stronger than them.
So only by using their brains could they stay ahead.
"Forbid!"
[Forbidden Activated]
Vritra immediately froze Yennefer, allowing her to quickly regain control of her body and revert.
"Yenni, I think it would be best if you stay back with wifey," Vritra said. Those creatures' main target was Yasmine.
So at least they had one advantage. While the creatures attacked the crown bearer, they could attack back.
"Hmm." Yennefer nodded. Her physique was malfunctioning, so it might backfire.
But it still didn't feel good to be excluded from such an important battle.
"Focus, we all have our roles here." Yasmine's stern voice brought her back to her senses and the empress nodded.
BOOM
Vritra was just waiting to see how they would deal with Dark Knight if he managed to avoid those rotating blades.
But instead of attacking him directly, they used something to blast him back, and then another dozer turned Dark Knight into minced meat.
Finally, it was their turn.
Vritra took the lead and ordered, "Onest, take the flag and just run. Do your best not to get caught."
"Okay!"
Onest took the flag from Yasmine and now the target had changed. He started running at full speed.
Taking a deep breath, Yennefer took out the Time Staff, having decided to assist them from the back.
Teresa also pulled out several treasures while Diana drew the blue knife.
That knife could inflict injuries without even making contact. Wasn't that perfect for this situation?
Maeve also had a good treasure, that Needle of Darkness. It too could kill from a distance.
Vritra slowed his pace as the two women launched attacks at the same time.
The blue knife glowed brightly, then Diana swung it, a flash of light streaking through the air.

The goblin-like creature couldn't dodge it and its head was severed, but shockingly, before the head could even fall off, countless worms wriggled inside its neck and head, pulling everything back together.
In a moment, it was back to normal.
Then the dark needle blasted another goblin's head to pieces, yet in the next moment, more worms wriggled out from its neck and a new head grew back.
"What the fuck is that regeneration ability?!" Onest felt goosebumps rise all over his body. Was he supposed to run from these monsters?
Thankfully, he didn't have to hold the flag at all times, as it transformed into a tattoo.
GRRRRRR
A dozer came so fast that Onest almost got cut into tiny pieces, but his auto-dodge skill saved his life at the last moment.
He quickly created thousands of clones to hide himself.
'Tch, that is useless. I have to find another way to kill these things.'
Vritra's body flashed as he disappeared.
In the next moment, he appeared before a dozer.
It was time to put his physique to the test.
Even Dark Knight's sword couldn't last.
CLANG
The sharp rotating blades struck Vritra's hand, trying to rip it to shreds, but they were unable to do so immediately.
'Not bad.'
Vritra's feet skidded across the floor, but he slowed the dozer down greatly.
GRAAAA
The large goblin let out a shocked sound as the speed of the dozer decreased.
How could such a puny creature stop this vehicle?
Vritra could sense other dozers coming to attack him. He waited and soon felt the blades cutting into his skin.
'I wonder how Forbidden will work here.'
Vritra thought for a moment, but since there were so many dozers, setting a broader rule would be better.
"Forbid: Nothing can rotate!"
WHIRRR-
Suddenly, they all came to a halt.
Not even the tyres could rotate.
But before they could rejoice, all the dozers suddenly underwent a transformation.

sentences.text: Grrrrrrrrr
A loud whirring sound rang out as the doors to the elevator opened.
This hall was even larger, covering a diameter of at least a couple of kilometres.
BOOM BOOM
GRRRRRRRR
Vritra didn't pay attention to the creatures or the sound.
He quickly scanned the area but couldn't sense the flag.
"Yeah, it's probably down below," Yasmine mentioned as well.
"Let's go then, no need to pick a fight with these things.
They are a challenge for Level 4 demigods, it won't be easy," Fiona spoke.
She loved to fight, but not idiotic fights with no gains.
Without getting out, they pressed the button and the doors closed, then the elevator continued down.
"So, hubby, what exactly is your plan with this... death planning?" Yasmine asked as they all turned toward Vritra, especially Onest.
He had indeed been influenced by Vritra's words, getting gaslighted into believing him.
"First of all, we need to remove the threats so we won't be chased constantly by them, and we do that by feigning the death of the crown bearer.
It will be a little tough, though," Vritra replied.
Before long, the elevator reached the lowest floor and the doors opened.
It was perfectly lit, well furnished, clean, and looked to be some sort of parking area.
But there wasn't a single person in sight.
The entire place was empty.
"It is here," Yasmine spoke.
This place was equally as big as the last floor, with a lot of pillars marking the parking areas.
"Let's hurry up, it is already afternoon here," Teresa said.
She had calibrated the clock to the local time.
The group carefully started walking.
They didn't separate in this unknown place, staying on high alert.
"Is that it?" Onest pointed toward a barrel inside which a pole was visible.
A cloth was tied to the top of it.
It was brown in colour and rather short compared to the entire pole.
Yasmine took the lead and held it, her eyes lighting up.
"Indeed, this is the flag."
After making sure, she picked it up and extended it toward Onest.
But just then...
GRRRRRRR
The same whirring sound began to ring out again, accompanied by loud vibrations from some machines and deep growls.
"They came down?" The ceiling broke with a loud boom and suddenly dozens of large objects fell down, creating deafening noises.
Dust flew in all directions, and strange gurgling noises made everyone's ears ache.
"Ughh, what the hell is this now?" Clutching their heads, the group of eleven remained inside the elevator.
SWISH
Hellmancer and Dark Knight appeared before them, along with Chimera, Bob, and Bobby.
"Go check it out," Vritra commanded.
Psyche was in a human body and it would be a waste to let it die just yet.
The two spheres rolled forward, then the remaining three wraiths also flew out, disappearing into the shadows.
A strange and sinister laughing sound rang out as the rumbling grew louder.
Within moments, Bob and Bobby died.
Then it was Chimera's turn.
They died so quickly despite supposedly being Level 3 demigods.
As the dust settled and things became clear, Vritra was surprised by the sight.
There were over fifty large vehicles.
They looked like tractors of some sort with dangerous rotating blade mechanisms at the front.
The blades spun menacingly, looking as if they could tear apart the world itself.
On top of each vehicle of destruction, or rather each dozer, one or two creatures sat.
They looked like the goblins Vritra had faced before in a labyrinth, but with body structures similar to humans.
Tall and burly bodies.
'...I had this doubt before, but the players are all Level 3 to 6 demigods, so if even the weakest fight seriously, the whole country will be doomed.
How is the game going to continue like this?' Vritra questioned, not making any moves yet.
From the speed at which his three wraiths had been killed, it was obvious these were no weak dozers.
It was supposed to be a trap for Level 4 demigods after all.
"That is true, which is why the level of destruction will automatically be reduced.
Even Level 6 demigods won't be able to destroy a building completely in a short time," Divine said, but quickly added, "That doesn't mean you all have been weakened, so you still have to be careful."
Nodding, Vritra turned to watch how long Dark Knight and Hellmancer would last against those things.
Compared to their sizes, those dozers were moving rather fast and none of them collided with one another.
Hellmancer cast several spells, but none could stop those machines or even affect the creatures sitting on them.
WHIRRRRRRR
Before Hellmancer could react, a dozer struck him from the side, smashing him against the rotating blades.
He exploded into a mass of smoke immediately.
On the other hand, Dark Knight held his sword and stood before an approaching dozer.
BANG
The rotating blades struck him, pushing Dark Knight back as sparks flew in all directions from his blade.
CRACK
After a few moments, his heavy sword began to crack under the force of the fast-moving dozer.
Dark Knight rotated in the air, turned into dark smoke, and flew directly toward the driver of the dozer.
'Oh, impressive.'
Among all his wraiths, Dark Knight was definitely the strongest, though Hellmancer might compete for that spot.
CLANG
Unfortunately, the blades struck the metallic structure at the side first, unable to cut through.
'What are these things made of?' Vritra was surprised but had no intention of fighting just yet.
Those dozers would be upon them quickly, and even the elevator wouldn't be safe since their escape route was the first thing those monsters had cut off.
"They are intelligent creatures," Yennefer spoke, wondering which of her elements would work best against them.
She was just thinking when suddenly her body began to turn into magma.
Her hands melted first.
"What?"
Vritra, who had been watching the battle with full focus, was startled once again.
In this game, he was on edge at all times.
They were facing people far stronger than them.
So only by using their brains could they stay ahead.
"Forbid!"
[Forbidden Activated]
Vritra immediately froze Yennefer, allowing her to quickly regain control of her body and revert.
"Yenni, I think it would be best if you stay back with wifey," Vritra said.
Those creatures' main target was Yasmine.
So at least they had one advantage.
While the creatures attacked the crown bearer, they could attack back.
"Hmm." Yennefer nodded.
Her physique was malfunctioning, so it might backfire.
But it still didn't feel good to be excluded from such an important battle.
"Focus, we all have our roles here." Yasmine's stern voice brought her back to her senses and the empress nodded.
BOOM
Vritra was just waiting to see how they would deal with Dark Knight if he managed to avoid those rotating blades.
But instead of attacking him directly, they used something to blast him back, and then another dozer turned Dark Knight into minced meat.
Finally, it was their turn.
Vritra took the lead and ordered, "Onest, take the flag and just run.
Do your best not to get caught."
"Okay!"
Onest took the flag from Yasmine and now the target had changed.
He started running at full speed.
Taking a deep breath, Yennefer took out the Time Staff, having decided to assist them from the back.
Teresa also pulled out several treasures while Diana drew the blue knife.
That knife could inflict injuries without even making contact.
Wasn't that perfect for this situation?
Maeve also had a good treasure, that Needle of Darkness.
It too could kill from a distance.
Vritra slowed his pace as the two women launched attacks at the same time.
The blue knife glowed brightly, then Diana swung it, a flash of light streaking through the air.

The goblin-like creature couldn't dodge it and its head was severed, but shockingly, before the head could even fall off, countless worms wriggled inside its neck and head, pulling everything back together.
In a moment, it was back to normal.
Then the dark needle blasted another goblin's head to pieces, yet in the next moment, more worms wriggled out from its neck and a new head grew back.
"What the fuck is that regeneration ability?!" Onest felt goosebumps rise all over his body.
Was he supposed to run from these monsters?
Thankfully, he didn't have to hold the flag at all times, as it transformed into a tattoo.
GRRRRRR
A dozer came so fast that Onest almost got cut into tiny pieces, but his auto-dodge skill saved his life at the last moment.
He quickly created thousands of clones to hide himself.
'Tch, that is useless.
I have to find another way to kill these things.'
Vritra's body flashed as he disappeared.
In the next moment, he appeared before a dozer.
It was time to put his physique to the test.
Even Dark Knight's sword couldn't last.
CLANG
The sharp rotating blades struck Vritra's hand, trying to rip it to shreds, but they were unable to do so immediately.
'Not bad.'
Vritra's feet skidded across the floor, but he slowed the dozer down greatly.
GRAAAA

How could such a puny creature stop this vehicle?

chapters.title: Chapter 832 The Training by Divine
paragraphs: The moment Vritra used Forbidden to stop all the spinning, the dozers skidded and crashed.
But suddenly, as if they had been prepared for such situations from the very beginning, the dozers transformed.
GRRRRRRR
The whirring started again, the sharp blades moving even faster, but they no longer rotated.
And the dozers began to move even faster, their tyres replaced by something that could easily glide across the floor.
"It is useless to target those dozers, no matter what method you use, they will keep moving. They are made like that," Divine spoke.
Vritra could use Forbidden to directly stop a few dozers, but there were still so many of them.
'I guess so, then I should target the ones controlling them.' Vritra looked at the goblins, but they also seemed to be protected.
"Uwaaaaah!!"
Onest was running at full speed, barely managing to avoid death several times. He was really, truly terrified.
Shitless wanted to laugh, but the situation didn't allow it since he too could only run.
"Darling, what are we supposed to do? It doesn't seem like it will be easy to stop these things," Fiona asked. She had even used the Undying Mythic Halo.
It could indeed damage those things, but before reaching the goblins, the attacks were stopped by the dozers.
And it would take even more time to destroy those vehicles. By that time, they would all be dead.
"Back off, all of you except Onest. I am going to try something," Vritra said.
They didn't try to be brave and quickly moved back.
"S-Save meeeeeee!!"
Onest screamed as the speed of those dozers kept increasing. His clothes were already in tatters.
And soon enough, those blades would cut into his body as well.
His skill was barely keeping him alive, and the clones weren't much help.
"Just keep running," Vritra said.
Since this place was locked in a way to keep the damage limited, it didn't decrease their strength, but the laws here had been strengthened, placing a limit on their abilities.
In simple terms, if Vritra used his full-power punch against anyone, that creature would still receive the same amount of damage.
But the entire building and surrounding area wouldn't be blasted to pieces.
So, it was time to use a rather dangerous skill that he definitely couldn't use outside.
He had used it only once before and died.
Taking a deep breath, he glanced at the bug flying beside him.
Divine didn't say anything.
Taking his silence as approval, Vritra placed the responsibility on Divine and began.
[Titan Fall Activated!]
The moment this skill was activated, the atmosphere inside the large hall changed.
Vritra's body turned gloomy and dark, the surrounding space buzzing strangely.
The laws of the planet, which had been greatly strengthened by the gods for this game, began to shudder.
Streams of destructive, concentrated energy began to flow out of his body.
After the upgrade, his body had already evolved to become much stronger. It was equal to or even above most Level 4 demigods.
And in this state, being of the Titan race, the effect became even greater as his strength rose dramatically.
In this form, Vritra wasn't really afraid of these creatures.
Instead, he was afraid of this skill itself.
"It will be fine, just try not to die or you might go out of control again," Divine said, his tone serious as he began guiding Vritra.
Even for himself, a real Titan would be too difficult to handle, since once this skill was activated, their strength would just keep increasing.
Until everything they deemed a target was destroyed.
Until nothing around them was left.
'But he is a Titan now, so the situation is already a lot better than the last time.'
Divine thought as he studied Vritra carefully.
He had studied the Titans very closely.
In the space where the Titans had been thrown to eat each other and bring about mutual destruction.
In the end, only one Titan remained.
The strongest of them all.
It could be said that it was the leader of the Titans.
But among those creatures, there were no such bonds.
They simply continued devouring and growing stronger.
Yet now, that strongest Titan had gotten a new start, just as Divine had promised.
After devouring all the other Titans, the King Titan developed a feeling of rage toward those who had locked him there.
So Divine had to be careful.
If Vritra ended up causing too much of a disturbance, everything would be lost.
Though he also didn't want to stop him from exploring his Titan side.
The earlier he did this, the better.

"Focus on your body, each atom; your mind, every sensation; your soul, every ripple. Every part of you can bring extreme disasters. Just your soul... no, even your thoughts would be enough to kill them all once you tap into the true potential of your Titan race. But for now, we are going to focus on your physical strength."
Divine spoke, and only his voice remained inside Vritra's mind.
Back then, Divine hadn't personally witnessed the battle between the Titans and all their enemies.
But he had seen a memory where just the heartbeat of a Titan had severely injured several higher beings.
It was the King Titan.
And that was the moment the world realized just how dangerous that race truly was.
After devouring all of its kind and the space it had been locked in, it gave Divine a chance to begin his plans.
The King Titan's strength had increased to a level that even Divine at his peak could not defeat.
Maybe not even a hundred of him could.
But their enemies were also incredibly powerful.
"Shall we start?" Divine asked, staring not at the goblins but at Vritra, wondering how long he could stay in control.
'Yes.'
Vritra replied, his body consisting only of darkness, as if a piece of space itself had been cut away.
"Abandon all senses. Just stay focused on yourself or you might lose control," Divine said, sighing in relief.
Vritra didn't question him and instead isolated himself, no longer able to see or hear the dozers.
It had become more of a training session than a battle.
And Vritra wasn't really worried about his safety.

"Good, perfect. Now, control the strength in your arms. No, just controlling the strength in your fists is enough. Sense the danger, sense the energy of everything around you, and use it to create a detailed image."
Divine said.
Surely it would take some time to achieve this.
He himself had needed an entire day...
'Done.'
Divine: "..."
"Wait, are you sure you did it right? You didn't just peek, did you? It is more complex than..."
Divine spoke doubtfully.
No, he simply didn't want to believe this was possible.
'Yes, I can see everything. There are seven dozers heading toward me. The first one has two goblins wearing yellow hats...'
Vritra explained while continuously focusing on his body.
The space around his fists became more distorted, the dark energy seeming to burn anything it touched.
"Yes, yes, you did. But how? Wait... sigh, forget it."
Divine suddenly remembered that Vritra had been different from normal humans from the beginning.
Whether it was his body or mind, they far surpassed everyone else.
After all, he had been created in a lab in a way.
Divine shook his insect-like head and continued the training.
"Alright, don't use too much strength. Try to control yourself. And try killing one in the most efficient way possible. It is up to you how you do it."
He said after finally calming himself down.
All of his earlier enthusiasm was gone.
'And here I was proud that I developed this skill in a day.'
It wasn't a Titan skill, but it allowed one to fight effectively in most situations.
'Alright.'
Vritra nodded.
His body moved across the space, appearing directly before a goblin and startling it.
Like before with Dark Knight, something blasted outward, trying to create distance.
But the forceful energy wasn't able to move Vritra at all.
Vritra suddenly grabbed the goblin by the throat.
Then a colourless flame burst forth and consumed it.
Its soul was instantly burned away, disappearing completely.
"Hmm, good, good. If there is no soul, then what can the body do?"
Divine hummed approvingly before his tone shifted.
"But they won't die so easily."
No sooner had Divine said that than the goblin began to thrash and scream, unable to free itself.
Following Divine's advice, Vritra didn't want to use too much strength.
He glanced around and soon found something suitable.
Jumping forward, he landed directly in front of one of the rapidly moving blades.
KIIRRIICCCKKK
The goblin screamed in terror as Vritra pushed it forward into the blades.
WHIIRRRRRRR
Blood and flesh splattered everywhere, raining down on Vritra, but it was completely destroyed by the dark energy surrounding him.
Even the worms inside were shredded by the blades.
The goblin's head was the first part to be destroyed.
The scene was horrifying as the skull cracked apart and the brain matter was ground into pieces.
Vritra didn't stop and continued pushing the struggling body deeper into the blades.
The others screamed upon witnessing that horrifying scene.
All the goblins rushed toward him, but it took only a moment for the entire body of the goblin to be destroyed.
"And it is done! Not bad. Using their own weapons to kill them. I guess you can use the same method on the rest of them. Make it quick."
Divine said, impressed by Vritra's level of control.
Instead of manually killing all of them, Vritra concentrated and created dozens of arms from the dark energy.
Divine hesitated but decided not to stop him.
Vritra felt a headache forming.
Controlling everything at once, he almost felt like losing control.
All the dozers rushed toward him simultaneously.
The blades had transformed into red, and the goblins were no longer holding back either.

chapters.title: Chapter 833 Are you Anomalies?
paragraphs: The blades of all the dozers turned red, working at full power.
Vritra could sense the danger emanating from those vehicles, but it wasn't something for him to worry about.
The hands made of energy rushed toward the goblins.
BOOM BOOM
The creatures constantly tried to push the hands away, destroying them, yet within moments their throats were tightly clutched by those very hands.
They all cried out and struggled, but Vritra gave them no time as he pushed them into the blades, turning their bodies into minced meat.
It was similar to a wheat-cutting machine, but far more dangerous.
All the goblins died by their own weapons.
Now, with the drivers gone, the vehicles went mad, running in random directions and crashing into everything around them.

"Good, now the main task is to return to your normal form without going berserk. If you can control this skill, it will be a great help in the future," Divine muttered, ready to take action if Vritra failed.
Vritra ignored everything around him, even blocking out Divine's voice as all thoughts disappeared.
His body trembled, almost exploding with madness, but Vritra did his best to remain in control.
"Hmmmm, just think about Yasmine, your kid, your wives... maybe that would help," Divine added, his voice still sounding within Vritra's mind.
"H-Hurry up! I can't take this anymore!!" Onest and Shitless screamed, while the group of women had already moved toward the elevator.
Hoo...
Vritra abandoned all the energy, pulling it back and letting it disperse into the surrounding space.
It took over a minute, but finally the dreadful aura began to subside.
"He succeeded!" Divine exclaimed. That was a really difficult task.
Divine released some soothing energy to help Vritra, even suppressing his current state.
Only then did Vritra finally manage to return to his normal self, and he looked down at his hands.
"I-I really used it, HUFF HUFF... that was so intense. One moment more and I would have lost myself," he muttered.
"Yes, so be careful when you use it in the future. In fact, avoid using it when I am not around," Divine said, reminding him.
"Anyway, it is time to leave. I don't think this place can handle this any longer."
Only then did Vritra remember that the battle was not completely over, and he took a glance around.
All the dozers were crashing around wildly, some into one another and some into the walls, their blades still glowing red.
The building was trembling, but the walls didn't break, and the dozers were starting to shake violently.
Vritra stomped his foot and used teleportation, appearing in front of Shitless and then Onest before bringing them back into the elevator.
"Let's go." Wiping the sweat from his forehead, Vritra spoke.
"I really thought I was about to die... I don't want to die, it is so scary!!" Onest suddenly spoke, facing Vritra.
Who rolled his eyes, and here came another round of manipulation.
By the time they arrived on the first floor, Onest had calmed down and was already nodding.
"And that is exactly why you should try it once," Vritra finished his lecture.
"Looks like there is still some time before they arrive. What sort of preparations do we need to make?" Vanessa turned to face her son and asked.
They hadn't been in this game for long, and it was already becoming dangerously complicated.

"Through Onest's death, we need to hide the exact location of the crown and make them believe that the other side has obtained it. Soon, they will all learn about this mess and understand the rules," Vritra began as they walked out of the elevator and headed toward the cafeteria.
Taking seats around a round table, they began to talk.
Of course, they didn't order anything, the compass wouldn't inform them about every danger.

"We still shouldn't face the Level 5 or Level 6 demigods, and even I am not sure if I can win against a group of Level 4 demigods, so let's play it safe for now," Vritra said before going further into the plan.
"U-Um, I am hungry..."
Vritra felt a tug on his sleeve and, upon looking down, found it was the same girl from before.
When did she get here?
Wait, did she enter the building with them or arrive later?
All of them had completely forgotten about her, yet her sudden appearance made them uneasy.
"Hey, are you really hungry?" Vritra asked.
"Y-Yes," the girl, whose face was covered in dirt, nodded.
"Do you want to eat him?" Vritra pointed toward Shitless, who almost fell off his seat.
"No!" the girl replied while making a face.
Upon seeing no messages appear, Vritra calmed down a little. Maybe it was because they were all tense that they were remaining so on edge.
"Alright, go sit there, I will ask them to give you some food," Vritra said.
The girl nodded and walked away obediently.
"Psyche, go ahead."
Then they returned to discussing their main plan.
Vritra explained the plan. Of course, to make it work perfectly, they needed to check a few things first.
After everyone in the group understood the plan, they began to prepare.
Despite everything, Vritra was still very suspicious of that girl, so he used the Mythic Halo to create an illusion.
Since the Level 6 demigods were looking for anomalies, he was being extremely careful not to appear strange.
Even their appearances were made ordinary.
"Are you all ready?" Vritra asked, ready to start the preparations.
"Yes!" they all nodded.
All except Onest.
"C-Can't someone else do my job?" Onest asked, looking at Psyche.
"Right, let's just use Psyche. Isn't he the perfect candidate? He won't even die, and we don't have to lose the flag."
"Of course, Psyche is also going to die, but we need one more volunteer..." Vritra spoke.
"But I did not volunteer..." Onest replied, only to be cut off.
"This is a special kind of volunteering. The chosen-one volunteering," Vritra added.
"But that's not volunteering. Sigh... is there really no other way?" Onest resigned himself to his fate and asked pitifully.
He still didn't want to die despite Vritra's motivational speech earlier.
"Don't worry, you are sort of a backup. Psyche is the one who dies first. We might not even need you, but you still have to be prepared," Vritra said.
He could have done it himself.
But who knew what happened after dying? Maybe he would be teleported away or have a buffer period before he could rejoin the game.
Taking all that into consideration, Vritra obviously couldn't do it himself, otherwise everyone else would be left in danger.
"Fine, I will do as planned," Onest nodded.
If it was for the family, then it was alright.
At least that was what he kept telling himself.
SLURP
The eleven were startled once again as the little girl walked up to them and licked the candy Psyche had just bought for her.
She had already eaten her fill.
"What is it now?" Vritra had helped her before, but he was starting to get irritated.
He would have already sent her away with teleportation.
But he couldn't act strangely in public.
Her lips and tongue had turned red.
She looked up at them curiously and asked:
"Are you all anomalies?"
All of them were shocked, so their hunch had been right.
This was no normal little girl.
But then why hadn't the compass given any signal, or the sin messages shown anything?

chapters.title: Chapter 834 Deceiving
paragraphs: There were many questions, but for now dealing with this situation was more important.
"Are you all anomalies?" After asking the question, the little girl returned to licking her candy.
There was silence for just a moment.
Vritra chuckled and patted her head. "Haha, where did you hear such a big word? Anomalies? But you shouldn't say things like that, some adults won't like it, okay?"
His response was natural, though Vritra wondered if this was a Level 6 demigod searching for anomalies.
There was no other explanation.
"This girl is cute, isn't she? I wonder where she heard that." Vanessa spoke in a gentle tone.
No one else commented, merely smiling and looking at her. They didn't want to overreact.
When one tries to act normal, the more abnormal each action seems. Even just smiling feels forced.
"Where is your house? Or your parents?" Vritra asked, while Divine flew up and spoke in a thoughtful tone.
"I believe she is just a normal girl from this planet, but maybe she is being controlled by a Level 6 demigod."
'Yeah, that is possible. Still, even if she isn't dangerous, we have to hide our identities. Who knows where that Level 6 demigod is.'
"I don't know. Are you not anomalies?" the girl asked again.
"Sigh, what is your name?" Vritra asked, a faint smile on his face.
"Anne," she replied.

"So Anne, why would you think we are anomalies? Wait, I think you don't know its meaning. Anomaly means abnormal. Do we look abnormal to you?" Vritra said, but didn't give her time to reply. He didn't want to let that demigod control the direction of the conversation.

"Are we abnormal since we gave you food? Or because we chatted with you unlike others? Kiddo, not everyone is like that. There are good adults too. Well, you probably won't understand all this, but you shouldn't stop having faith in people."
Vritra said all that, but to himself it was complete nonsense.
Good people?
There were barely any left, especially in the bigger schemes of things.
Evelyn was different, maybe only toward Vritra, but he doubted most other powerful people even saw the weak as living beings.
'Divine is the perfect example of that,' Vritra thought.
"Ugh, why drag me into this? I didn't even say anything." Divine huffed, rolling his eyes.
"Hmm." The girl nodded, though she still looked confused.
On the other end, the woman named Anne, who was controlling the girl, sighed.
She had been searching for anomalies for a long time.
Anne truly felt she had gotten lucky this time. She had been certain there was one or more anomalies hidden within this group.
But now it seemed all her suspicions had been pointless.
She could only continue observing other people.
"Haha."
They all relaxed as the girl turned and began to walk away.
Vritra started talking about random things, the others also began to act naturally, and so did Diana...
She nodded and spoke:
"Meow."
The little girl's steps came to a sudden halt.
That cute meow was so random amidst their conversation.
She turned and looked directly at Diana, her lips curling strangely and her eyes widening more than they should.
The goddess's heartbeat increased.
She had forgotten about that damned bracelet.
She was merely replying normally, but her voice had come out as a meow.
Wasn't that the perfect example of an anomaly?
They all cursed internally.
How had they forgotten about it?
"Did you say something?" The little girl's tone became very strange as she took a step toward Diana.
"Whoa, what a way to mess things up. Bravo." Divine shook his head, wondering how they would get out of this.
Was a battle inevitable?
If that was the case, then their entire plan would be useless.
Running through possibilities rapidly, Yasmine was the first to come up with a solution.
She had been in many tense situations and could think clearly under pressure.
With a burst of confidence and a smile on her face, she spoke:
"Meow."
Everyone looked at Yasmine.
'Wait... are there two anomalies here?' Anne wondered.
Although the Crown Bearer had set a rule that no one could enter the building during the day, there were always loopholes.
And Anne had the perfect loophole.
She could use this girl's body to come here, though of course the girl would end up dead.
And the reason for her suspicion?
There were no pets such as dogs or cats on this planet.
So none of the natives should be aware of them.
The Level 6 demigods had arrived in the game before anyone else and had already done their research.
Only after learning what was normal here could they identify anomalies.
'Not to mention, that crown or whatever it is, is also somewhere in this building,' she thought.
Anne could only see a golden dot from far away.
Only after coming here had she been able to sense the crown properly.
"Meow!" Fiona chimed in, pointing a finger upward and nodding as if saying, 'You are right.'
"Meow meow." Maeve shook her head, seemingly pointing something out.
"Meow?" Vanessa joined in, looking confused.
"Meow meow." Shitless hurriedly added, though his meow didn't sound cute at all.
"What's happening?" Anne was genuinely confused now.
Were they all anomalies?
Had they gathered in the same place?
She could tell these were different people, not one person controlling multiple bodies.
"Meow meow!" Onest smacked Shitless on the shoulder, scolding him.
"Meow." Vritra stopped their fight, pulling Shitless back.
Anne was sweating by this point.
She couldn't understand anything.
"Meow." Yennefer added with a thoughtful expression.
"Meow." Teresa took a deep breath and did her part.
She wasn't as quick to react as her sister, but she had understood the situation quickly enough.
'One, two, three... ten!! So all ten anomalies are here?'
Anne became excited.
How could all ten anomalies be so easy to find and so weak?
Wasn't this game far too easy?
They could become Level 7 demigods just like that.
But just then...
"M-Meow."
Psyche, who was sitting farther away, raised his hand and spoke as if asking a question.
"Meow?" Vritra turned to face him, waiting for the question.
"Ughhh."
Anne was practically pulling her hair out now.
What the hell was happening here?
How had all of them suddenly transformed into cats?
There couldn't possibly be eleven anomalies...
'I must be wrong. Maybe it is some custom of this place...'
Anne was so annoyed that she didn't want to hear another meow from them.
Turning around, she quickly walked away.
The whole group heaved a long sigh of relief, wiping the sweat from their foreheads.
"We almost got caught..." Maeve slumped back in her seat, but Diana immediately smacked her on the head.
"Ouch."
Maeve held her head and looked at Diana, who was glaring at her.

"W-What? Why are you hitting me? It wasn't my idea to make that bet, nor did I put that bracelet on you. I only defeated you at the end. How is that my fault?" Maeve rubbed her head, pouting and feeling wronged.
"O-Oh, sorry. It's my fault. I shouldn't have done something like this before such a dangerous event." Teresa apologized and quickly stood up.
She removed the bracelet and put it away.

chapters.title: Chapter 835 An Easy Trap
paragraphs: "Haa, finally I can speak normally." Diana felt much better.
Vritra massaged his temples. They had almost fucked up over this. How had they all overlooked something so obvious?
Diana had almost become an anomaly.
"There are no pets like cats or dogs here. In fact, no one keeps pets on this planet," Divine added.
"Wait, we might have overlooked it, but there is no way you wouldn't know this." Vritra suddenly looked at Divine.
"Oh haha, yeah, I knew it. I thought it would be fun-"
BANG
Vritra took two plates and squished the bug between them.
'When will you ever be serious? Our lives are literally on the line here. Why are you still joking?' Vritra asked, though he also blamed himself for not thinking of this sooner.
He had been too focused on dealing with the players and had completely overlooked that bet.
"Oh come on, do you really think any of you can die with me here? Even if you can't win the game, I can at least keep you alive." Divine spoke with absolute confidence.
'Yeah, but winning this game is also very important. It is our fault too, but in the future can you inform us if you do know something?' Vritra asked, noticing the looks on everyone's faces.
Except for Shitless and Onest, everyone was feeling guilty.
Especially Vanessa, Teresa, and Diana.

"Fine, I will. Also, that little girl has already left this building, but there are at least five others like her who might be being controlled," Divine said. He would prefer not to interfere too much.
He believed in the saying: what doesn't kill you makes you stronger.
'Thanks, we will be careful.' Vritra nodded. He could understand Divine's thoughts too.
And so he didn't linger on the blame game.

"Okay, listen everyone. This will be our first and last mistake. We have to be absolutely careful here. Our faces have already been seen, so we will have to change identities soon. Let's do that after tonight's plan. If everything goes according to plan, things will become a bit easier." He said, patting Diana's head instead of blaming her.
It wasn't the time for that.
Time passed quickly, and the sky began to darken.
Vritra and the others moved throughout the building, making preparations.
He could sense the constant gazes of the people Divine had pointed out. They really were Anne.
Thankfully, those Level 6 demigods couldn't kill people mindlessly. That was the only reason Anne hadn't attacked yet.
Soon, it was almost night and everyone left their buildings.
[The Night is approaching, try your best to hide!]
A message flashed before everyone.
Everyone except the Level 4 demigods was surprised, unable to understand the meaning.
But it wasn't long before they began to understand things.
They found each other and didn't attack immediately.
One Level 6 demigod killed one of the Level 4 demigods, thinking he was an anomaly, and received a penalty.
For several hours, he would be unable to use any of his energy.
The punishment was severe.
And so, one of the Level 4 demigods was killed before he could even get close to Night Corp.
Many players were also located in other towns.
There were two Level 6 demigods in this town.
One Level 5 and several Level 3 and Level 4 demigods, and all of them stood outside Night Corp.
As the day faded and night descended, the ruler's law finally ended.
A heavy fog began to cover everything.
The streets.
The people.
All of it.
It was time for the hiding game.
"How can there be several games happening all at once?" Anne, one of the Level 6 demigods, asked while looking at her companion.
"Whatever the reason might be, we will find the answer in there." The man with the red moustache and bald head spoke.
He was wearing a doctor's outfit.
And it was him who had killed one of the Level 4 demigods after mistaking him for an anomaly.
The man had been speaking very strangely after all.
But after receiving the punishment, they found out it was actually true.
The games had somehow become mixed together.
And now there were Level 3 to Level 6 demigods participating.
The punishment had been so severe because he had already killed a few people before as well.
It was the same man who had appeared when Vritra pretended to be killed.
Anne and Red Moustache looked at one another and then at the other players.
All ten of the Level 3 demigods were present there, while only four of the Level 4 demigods remained, one having died not long before.
"Tch, could it be related to that news?" Anne thought for a moment before speaking in confusion.
"Oh right, I have also heard of that, m-ma'am. The event in which all the gods were heavily punished when a group of ten broke into a game." The Level 5 demigod spoke.
The man looked very tame now.
He had been quite full of himself earlier but didn't even dare look at them directly anymore.
Anne could kill him with a snap of her fingers.
Whether she received punishment or not didn't matter.
But his life certainly did.
"Hmm. It could be them. Those weaklings dare to mess with our game now!" Anne was full of rage.
She couldn't help but remember those eleven people.
Could they be them?
And if so, what about the eleventh one?
"U-Uhm, we shouldn't be standing outside right now. Things are going to get dangerous. We need to hide inside the buildings." One of the Level 4 demigods spoke.
"Right, let's go inside. We will deal with this later, but first we have to kill those bastards!!" Red Moustache roared.
Even if he couldn't use his energy, his physical strength alone was enough.
Without wasting any time, the group of seventeen walked into Night Corp.
All the people of this planet seemed to have already disappeared, or perhaps they had simply returned to their homes.
The surroundings and all the buildings were completely empty.

'Flag and Hide, that is our game. It didn't say we would be safe once we entered a building. Whatever is trying to hunt us will continue searching for us.' The Level 4 demigod thought, still saddened by the loss of his friend.
The seventeen couldn't find anyone on the first floor.
Anne couldn't even use those people as puppets since they had disappeared too.
"Let's go up. The golden dot is up there." Anne took the lead as they searched each floor and continued climbing.
Soon they arrived in front of an office.
The sign on the board read:
'Emp. Dracon'
"I think they are inside." Anne whispered.
She doubted that killing these people would give her any penalties even if they weren't anomalies.
Still, she gestured for the Level 5 demigod to go first.
The man gulped and nodded.
He grabbed the doorknob and slowly turned it before peeking inside.
There was a man leaning back against the table as if he had been waiting for them.
"There is someone inside," he whispered.
Frowning, Red Moustache kicked him in the backside and threw him into the room.
"KIAAAAAA!"
The man let out a terrified scream.
He hadn't always been like this, but after meeting those two monsters, he had become quite meek and fearful.
"Who are you!!" he shouted while trying to regain his balance.

sentences.text: "Haa, finally I can speak normally." Diana felt much better.

They had almost fucked up over this.
How had they all overlooked something so obvious?
Diana had almost become an anomaly.

chapters.title: Chapter 836 Sacrifice
paragraphs: "Heh, shouldn't that be my question? You have just barged into my room." The man smirked and took a long puff of his cigarette.
Then he blew the smoke toward the frightened man's face.
Anne walked inside, and the others followed. Soon, the man found himself facing seventeen powerhouses.
"Do you recognize him?" Red Moustache asked, not attacking immediately.
"Hmm, I don't think I remember him." Anne spoke uncertainly. He seemed a little familiar to her, but also greatly different.
"A handsome guy like me only remains in the heart, not in the brain." The man spoke while touching his crown.
"T-This is it!!" The Level 3 demigods all pointed a finger at the crown.
They looked around and found no other glow, and they could even read its description.
"We will take that, don't worry." Anne spoke.
Of course, she intended to take it for herself.
It was such a good item.
"Now, now, aren't you getting ahead of yourself? You don't think you can defeat me, do you?" the man spoke.
It was Psyche, who had changed his appearance, while Onest was hidden nearby as a backup.
Despite knowing he wouldn't really die thanks to the flag, his heart was still beating like war drums.
"Ugh, this is why I hate weaklings. They just don't know their place. Are you going to do it, or should I take care of him?" Red Moustache asked.
He was acting brave, but he was afraid of making another mistake and receiving an even heavier punishment.
The Level 4 demigods were the most frightened, hoping nothing would enter the building.
"P-Please hurry up, we have to hide quickly." One of them urged.
"Tch, stay quiet. I will deal with him right away." Anne replied in annoyance.
She didn't think the monsters that were supposed to hunt Level 4 demigods could do anything to her.
She could easily defeat them too.
Still, Anne took a step forward as her hand mutated and grew longer, her fingers slashing toward Psyche's neck.
The wraith moved back, barely saving its body.
"Whoa, I like wild ladies, but can we hold back on the foreplay for some time later? You see, I don't like getting scratched by unvaccinated pets."
These words, of course, were given by Vritra.
He was also hidden in this very building along with his wives and Onest.
If things went south, he wouldn't risk Onest's life.
"You damned pest!" Anne hated it whenever someone called her that because of her skill.
Dozens of arms grew out of the ground and even from Psyche's own body, attacking him from all directions.
Psyche did his best, putting up a fight, but his body was too weak and the opponent was far too strong.
In just a few moments, his body was chopped apart piece by piece, giving him a gruesome death.
CLANG
The crown fell to the ground as Anne cut his body into tiny pieces, scattering them all over the floor in utter rage.
Psyche safely returned to Vritra, having completed its task.
The other wraiths remained hidden in the shadows, waiting for their master's command.
The crown glowed faintly.
It looked so enticing, yet none dared to even approach it.
Except Anne, who was currently the strongest person in the room.
'Tch, if I hadn't killed that bastard, I could have gotten this crown. Once my strength returns, I will kill this pet bitch.' Red Moustache thought.
The Level 3 demigods glanced at one another.
It was their game, and they needed the crown.
But they didn't dare make a sound.
She could kill them easily, and even if it gave her a penalty, she could simply toss them out right now and be done with it.
Anne picked up the crown, but just as she was about to place it on her head, she frowned.
"Something is wrong..."
Her hands paused, the crown almost touching her head.
TIC TIC
There was a faint sound and then...
BOOOOM!!
A terrifying explosion shook the building.
Everyone was blasted backward.
It was a bomb they had found among Zihong's treasures.
That was why it was so terrifying.
But surprisingly, the room itself wasn't destroyed.
Even the glass remained intact.
The table and chair were pushed backward, but that was all.
Meanwhile, the players received the full brunt of the explosion.
The Level 3 and Level 4 demigods had it the worst, the former almost losing their lives.
Even the Level 5 demigods were injured, though the Level 6 demigods weren't affected nearly as much.
"Damnit!! I knew this was a trap! Where the fuck are you hiding?!" Anne roared in rage.
Finally, she was able to see a golden glow.
So this was where the real crown was.
This person had truly planned things out well.
But too bad.
His strength was simply too low.
Anne rushed forward and struck a cupboard, her arm smashing through the door and hitting something hidden inside.
"Ughhh." Onest groaned from within before rushing out in a hurry.
They had hoped to use the explosion either to throw these people out of the building or to attract something dangerous.
But neither seemed to have happened.
One of the Level 4 demigods walked toward the window and glanced outside.
The fog was rushing into the building.
"You damned pet, do you think I would be scared of you?!" Onest roared.
He was wearing the crown, which was, of course, a fake.
"R-Run!! We have to run!!" The Level 4 demigod was terrified.
That thing was coming.
It had been attracted by the explosion!!
"..." Onest gritted his teeth and rushed toward the window.
The front of the building was made entirely of glass.
So he could jump out from almost anywhere.
That was exactly the plan.
To bring these overconfident jerks outside.
But just as Onest got close to the window, he felt something move inside his chest.
COUGH COUGH
His eyes turned red as he coughed up blood.
His body possessed Auto Dodge, but he couldn't dodge an attack like that.
His heart was gripped by a grotesque arm that had appeared inside his chest out of nowhere and crushed it.
Then more arms began growing throughout his body, destroying him from the inside.
It was so damn painful.
He could almost see death itself.
But Onest forced a smile as he gathered every bit of energy he had left and muttered:
"Die, you pet..."
His body instantly burst into hundreds of clones, completely filling the office.
There wasn't even enough space left to move a finger.
The glass began to crack as all the players found themselves trapped.
"FUCK!"
Both Red Moustache and Anne shouted in rage while turning dozens of clones into minced meat.
Once again, the Level 3 demigods had it the roughest.
"Ughhhh... H-Help us, please..." They couldn't free themselves and deeply regretted coming here with those two psychos and walking straight into such an obvious trap.
The original body of Onest continued struggling, trying to stay alive long enough to drag all these players into the fog with him.
He kept creating more and more clones as endless pain flooded his senses.
For the first time, he truly understood what Vritra had gone through several times before.

chapters.title: Chapter 837 A Experience To Die For
paragraphs: Dying certainly isn't easy, but now that Onest was already on the verge of dying, he felt like doing anything to protect his family.
Vritra and the others felt bad, if possible Vritra didn't want to use the backup, but there really wasn't much choice.
BOOM BOOM
More and more bodies exploded, but because of the world's rules limiting the level of destruction, they were unable to kill all the clones at once.
Anne did her best to quickly kill Onest, pouring more energy into destroying him.
His organs had become twisted, getting torn apart, bones cracking and skin bursting open.
She didn't know how he was even managing this, but that guy, even as death was about to engulf him, didn't stop.
"Damnit!! Stop this, you madman!!" Anne screamed, her body slowly getting pushed towards the cracking window.
The clones held tightly onto the players and finally...
CRACK CRACK
The glass shattered and dozens of clones fell into the fog from such a high floor.
A few Level 3 demigods also fell down, Onest was determined to bring them all down with himself.
He just had to stay alive until then.
'A bit more, a little...'
But then a hand grew on his head and tore into his brain.
All thoughts were cut off, Onest didn't immediately die, but the pain disappeared and what remained was pure and unbending determination.
All the clones screamed at once, creating a shuddering effect as they all rushed towards Anne.
She kept killing them, but their numbers were pushing her out, Red Moustache was also falling, but he was farther away from Anne.
"Aaaaaaaah!"
A Level 4 demigod fell, screaming in terror.
It was certain death for them.
The screams disappeared the moment he got swallowed by the fog.
Anne wasn't afraid of the fog, she just needed to get that crown, and it was on Onest's original body, as she had seen before.
It was definitely the real thing, she could feel it.
But this was the illusion created by the Misty Essence, Vritra couldn't use it at full power as it would reveal them, but he had very slightly altered their thoughts.
With a grave expression, Vritra watched as the almost dead Onest jumped out of the building and Anne, while screaming, followed behind him.
"Give that to me, you damned bug!!" she screamed, not worried about the fog, and finally got a hold of it.
The moment she got it, she killed Onest with a slash of her hand.
The mark of the flag glowed and then his body broke into tiny particles, disappearing completely.
But there was a smile on his bloodied and bruised face, a raw, mocking smile directed at Anne.
A couple of Level 3 demigods still remained in the building, one Level 4 and the Level 5 also managed to stay there.
As Onest's focus was mainly on the Level 6 ones, unfortunately Red Moustache also managed to survive.
He was close to the window and could see the unbelievably terrifying creature that rose from the fog.
It made him shiver, the monster attacked Anne right away, cutting off and devouring one of her arms.
Finally seeing the true horror, a form so grotesque that it made her insides churn, Anne was terrified.
She understood the meaning behind that mocking smile, so this was their plan, she was truly afraid.
These monsters, weren't they supposed to only hunt Level 4 demigods? Why were they so horrifying?
Her face was full of fear and pain as the distorted creature tore her arm away, eating it.
The sight of watching it eat her arm almost made her vomit, but her body burst with energy as she tried to escape.
Then she disappeared, her fate unknown.
Back in the office, the remaining five of the original seventeen all looked just as fearful, Red Moustache shivered.
He took several steps back but heard a loud scream from behind.
"RAAAARRRRRRRRRRR!!"
The startled five turned back and saw a metallic bald man rushing in their direction. As the strongest, Red Moustache knew for a fact that he would be the next target.
Gritting his teeth and tightening his muscles, he braced for the impact.
BANG
But the bull-like charging man struck the Level 5 demigod not far away, changing direction at the very last moment.
"Eh?" the frightened Level 5 was finally able to relax, but suddenly felt as if a mountain had crashed into him.
He coughed blood and his body was thrown back at such a high speed that he didn't even have the time to do anything.
Not to mention the fog was climbing onto the building, he screamed and was soon swallowed by it.
"Haha! That was perfect!!" Shitless patted his shoulder, barely stopping himself from falling.
Then he glanced to the side at the four baffled people who looked back at him in utter shock.
"Pfftt, hahahaha!" Shitless burst out laughing, shouting, "What is that moustache? Did someone shit on your face? Is that poop?"
"You bastard!!"
Shitless had touched his soft spot, filling Red Moustache with killing intent.
This moustache was his pride, even without his energy, he could still kill these guys.
BOOOM
But before he could launch an attack, there was a powerful explosion just beside them, and the two Level 3 demigods were also blasted outside.
The monsters in the fog were having a feast, those players were torn apart and eaten by them.
The screams lasted only a few moments before the body parts of those players ended up in the monsters' bellies.
In the office, now only one Level 4 and one Level 6 demigod remained.
Both were terrified, Red Moustache still had a fight left in him, but the Level 4 demigod didn't want to fight.
He knelt and began to beg, but knew his fate was sealed, how could those people trust him?
He just didn't want to die like that, not after coming so far.
On the other hand, Red Moustache walked away from the window quickly, he could kill them easily but still had to be careful.
Just as he got ready to fight the disrespectful baldie, the other guy laughed and ran deeper into the building.
Vritra, who had finally moved out of the hiding spot, walked towards the office.
First, he observed and sensed that Onest had returned to the lowest floor of the building where they had gotten the flag.
All the dozers had exploded earlier, and that place was far safer, and it seemed he wasn't injured either.
'Thankfully, it works fine.'
It was a gamble, but Vritra was ready to take any risk to save Onest if he ended up outside.
"And who are you?" Red Moustache turned to face Vritra, pulling the Level 4 demigod up, they had to fight together.
"I am here to kill you, are you both ready?" Vritra asked, twisting his wrist as a cracking sound rang out.
"Haha. With just you? Or have you got more of those traps set up here for me?" Red Moustache asked, he wasn't being careless despite his confidence.
Anne was stupid, if she had known how dangerous it was outside, they wouldn't have managed to throw her out there.
They won't succeed with him anyway.
