A few Level 3 demigods also fell down, Onest was determined to bring them all down with himself.
He just had to stay alive until then.
'A bit more, a little...'
But then a hand grew on his head and tore into his brain.
All thoughts were cut off, Onest didn't immediately die, but the pain disappeared and what remained was pure and unbending determination.
All the clones screamed at once, creating a shuddering effect as they all rushed towards Anne.
She kept killing them, but their numbers were pushing her out, Red Moustache was also falling, but he was farther away from Anne.
"Aaaaaaaah!"
A Level 4 demigod fell, screaming in terror.
It was certain death for them.
The screams disappeared the moment he got swallowed by the fog.
Anne wasn't afraid of the fog, she just needed to get that crown, and it was on Onest's original body, as she had seen before.
It was definitely the real thing, she could feel it.
But this was the illusion created by the Misty Essence, Vritra couldn't use it at full power as it would reveal them, but he had very slightly altered their thoughts.
With a grave expression, Vritra watched as the almost dead Onest jumped out of the building and Anne, while screaming, followed behind him.
"Give that to me, you damned bug!!" she screamed, not worried about the fog, and finally got a hold of it.
The moment she got it, she killed Onest with a slash of her hand.
The mark of the flag glowed and then his body broke into tiny particles, disappearing completely.
But there was a smile on his bloodied and bruised face, a raw, mocking smile directed at Anne.
A couple of Level 3 demigods still remained in the building, one Level 4 and the Level 5 also managed to stay there.
As Onest's focus was mainly on the Level 6 ones, unfortunately Red Moustache also managed to survive.
He was close to the window and could see the unbelievably terrifying creature that rose from the fog.
It made him shiver, the monster attacked Anne right away, cutting off and devouring one of her arms.
Finally seeing the true horror, a form so grotesque that it made her insides churn, Anne was terrified.
She understood the meaning behind that mocking smile, so this was their plan, she was truly afraid.
These monsters, weren't they supposed to only hunt Level 4 demigods?
Why were they so horrifying?
Her face was full of fear and pain as the distorted creature tore her arm away, eating it.
The sight of watching it eat her arm almost made her vomit, but her body burst with energy as she tried to escape.
Then she disappeared, her fate unknown.
Back in the office, the remaining five of the original seventeen all looked just as fearful, Red Moustache shivered.
He took several steps back but heard a loud scream from behind.
"RAAAARRRRRRRRRRR!!"
The startled five turned back and saw a metallic bald man rushing in their direction.
As the strongest, Red Moustache knew for a fact that he would be the next target.
Gritting his teeth and tightening his muscles, he braced for the impact.
BANG
But the bull-like charging man struck the Level 5 demigod not far away, changing direction at the very last moment.
"Eh?" the frightened Level 5 was finally able to relax, but suddenly felt as if a mountain had crashed into him.
He coughed blood and his body was thrown back at such a high speed that he didn't even have the time to do anything.
Not to mention the fog was climbing onto the building, he screamed and was soon swallowed by it.
"Haha!
That was perfect!!" Shitless patted his shoulder, barely stopping himself from falling.
Then he glanced to the side at the four baffled people who looked back at him in utter shock.
"Pfftt, hahahaha!" Shitless burst out laughing, shouting, "What is that moustache?
Did someone shit on your face?
Is that poop?"
"You bastard!!"
Shitless had touched his soft spot, filling Red Moustache with killing intent.
This moustache was his pride, even without his energy, he could still kill these guys.
BOOOM
But before he could launch an attack, there was a powerful explosion just beside them, and the two Level 3 demigods were also blasted outside.
The monsters in the fog were having a feast, those players were torn apart and eaten by them.
The screams lasted only a few moments before the body parts of those players ended up in the monsters' bellies.
In the office, now only one Level 4 and one Level 6 demigod remained.
Both were terrified, Red Moustache still had a fight left in him, but the Level 4 demigod didn't want to fight.
He knelt and began to beg, but knew his fate was sealed, how could those people trust him?
He just didn't want to die like that, not after coming so far.
On the other hand, Red Moustache walked away from the window quickly, he could kill them easily but still had to be careful.
Just as he got ready to fight the disrespectful baldie, the other guy laughed and ran deeper into the building.
Vritra, who had finally moved out of the hiding spot, walked towards the office.
First, he observed and sensed that Onest had returned to the lowest floor of the building where they had gotten the flag.
All the dozers had exploded earlier, and that place was far safer, and it seemed he wasn't injured either.
'Thankfully, it works fine.'
It was a gamble, but Vritra was ready to take any risk to save Onest if he ended up outside.
"And who are you?" Red Moustache turned to face Vritra, pulling the Level 4 demigod up, they had to fight together.
"I am here to kill you, are you both ready?" Vritra asked, twisting his wrist as a cracking sound rang out.
"Haha.
With just you?
Or have you got more of those traps set up here for me?" Red Moustache asked, he wasn't being careless despite his confidence.
Anne was stupid, if she had known how dangerous it was outside, they wouldn't have managed to throw her out there.
They won't succeed with him anyway.

chapters.title: Chapter 838 The Demise of Red Moustache
paragraphs: "P- Please spare me, I don't want to die, I will be your s- slave, please let me go..." the Level 4 demigod began to beg, not getting off his knees.
"Fuck, get lost!!" annoyed, Red Moustache tossed him outside himself, this guy was too useless and would only hinder his fighting.
He then glanced cautiously at the metallic man but found that the baldie had already run back.
Now only one guy remained in front of him, who looked rather ordinary.
"You are weak, I wonder what's giving you the confidence..." Red Moustache muttered, he was feeling a bit nervous.
There could be more traps anywhere, he had to be ready for everything.
"Haha. Aren't you too scared? I am merely at Level 3... oh wait, was it because your big sis died?" Vritra asked, the corners of his lips turning up mockingly.
He continued to walk forward and stopped inside the office, facing the Level 6 demigod.
Honestly, he knew there was no chance of victory unless he was ready to sacrifice himself by using Titan Fall.
That skill was still too unstable.
But of course, that wasn't in his plans. And no one knew if Anne had really died, Vritra knew there was always a chance that she might have survived.
So, killing this guy was very important.
"Forbid: Agility!"
[Forbidden Activated!]
Just as Vritra made his move, Red Moustache was about to pounce but found that his speed had become non-existent.
He couldn't move.
'What is happening? My... body is stuck? Ughhh!! He is clearly only a Level 3...'
Red Moustache used every bit of his strength, but it was of no use.
Even his physical strength couldn't break the Forbidden ability.
Vritra too didn't have much time, that fog and the monsters inside it would enter the building at any moment.
He mustered all his strength, gathering a large amount of energy, and stomped forward, rushing towards the frozen enemy.
BOOOM!!
Red Moustache's body skidded back, but despite being unable to move, his defence and resilience were still extremely high.
Such a powerful punch failed to make him fall out of the building, as he continued to struggle.
BOOOM! BOOOM! BOOOM!
Relentlessly, Vritra rained down heavy attacks, each blow producing a loud explosive noise.
Soul Wraiths also appeared, helping him.
The other women joined in as well, releasing various kinds of attacks.
Yasmine stopped behind Vritra and spoke, "Hubby, wait a moment."
BOOOM!
Another punch landed on his chest, pushing the powerful demigod back a little.
The crown on Yasmine's head glowed, she pointed a finger at the enemy as Vritra moved aside.
Then, in an authoritative tone, she ordered, "Jump out!"
The Forbidden was cancelled for a moment, and much to his horror, Red Moustache's body moved on its own.
It took two steps back towards the broken window before he finally regained control of his body.
KRIIRRRIIRRRRR
GRRRRRRRRRR
Strange noises began to come from outside, there were at least ten monsters within that fog, and it was climbing up the building.
[Forbidden Activated!]
"Alright, that's enough, let's go back."
Vritra quickly froze him again and ran with the others towards the elevator.
They got inside and quickly pressed the button that would lead them to the lowest floor, where Onest was waiting.
'Nooooooooo...'
"Aaaaaaaaaah!"
A few seconds after the elevator was gone, Red Moustache finally regained control of his body.
He sprinted forward, his heart filled with dread and his eyes wide and bloodshot.
"Get out of there!! Aggghhhhhh! I don't want to dieeeeeee!!!" he screamed.
There was nowhere to go except the elevator.
He banged on the doors and tried to forcefully pry them open, but it was already too late.
His back was torn open, then his legs were ripped away, and amidst the heart-wrenching cries, Red Moustache disappeared into the fog.
The underground floor was fairly well lit, the area was filled with the destroyed remains of the dozers.
The blood of the goblins still painted the floor.
Onest revived and reappeared there, letting out a scream as he felt pain all over his body.
But he soon realized that everything was over, he was fine and alive once again, and there were no longer hands crawling inside his body.
He slowly slid down against the wall, his torn clothes had resurrected along with him, and he was back in peak condition.
Soon after, there was a faint sound from the elevator, alerting the mentally exhausted Onest.
With half-lidded eyes, he stood up and took a defensive stance.
But he relaxed as the elevator opened, revealing the nine people.
He sat back down and closed his eyes, he definitely wouldn't want to experience something like that ever again.
"Are you feeling okay?" Vritra asked, sitting beside Onest.
"Yeah, just a killing pain in my head and a feeling as if dozens of hands are still crawling in my gut." Onest said, looking at them and feeling relieved that none of them were injured.
"Here, this will help you." Diana took out a strange-looking pill and handed it to Onest.
"What is this?" he asked, observing it carefully.
"It is poison, just in case you liked dying too much and want to try it again..." Vritra was just in the middle of speaking,
when Onest threw the pill away, startled.
He seemed to have developed PTSD just from hearing the word "dying."
First it was his marriage, and now death.
The poor guy was really having the worst experiences of them all.
Seeing his comical reaction, they all couldn't help but laugh.
"Chill, it's just a healing pill, do you think Pitiful One would feed you poison?" Shitless shook his head, catching the pill before popping it into his mouth to taste it.
"Mmm. Sweet and nice... GULP!"
"Wait!! It really was poison!!" Diana exclaimed with a baffled expression.
Shitless: "..."
BLEGH COUGH COUGH
BLEGH
Shitless turned around and a fountain shot out from his mouth as he began to vomit, looking completely terrified.

Vritra shook his head before speaking in a solemn tone, "Enough of the jokes. Onest, thank you. You did a great job earlier, thanks to you we managed to kill so many players. Though I'm still not sure about Anne."
It was a pity though, if he could get his hands on those corpses, his Soul Wraiths would grow tremendously.
"There is still some time before twelve, then wifey can create another law for the country." Vritra said.
"Yeah, the second law should be to keep those creatures out of the buildings at night, right?" Teresa asked, and Vritra nodded.
If any other person had taken that crown, this would have been the very first law they created to increase their chances of survival.
But those players were just as dangerous, if not even more dangerous, for their group.
"Let's hope those things don't come down here, or we won't have any escape route." Maeve bit her finger while looking towards the elevator.
The group remained silent for a bit.
Onest had already taken the medicine and was feeling much better now.
Shitless, on the other hand, was feeling sick after vomiting too much.
They were far from done, aside from the players, there was still a lot left to accomplish.
"Now that we have got the crown, we need to collect the flags, kill the calamities, and also catch the anomalies..." Yennefer spoke, unfurling her fingers one by one.
"Any bright ideas?" Vanessa looked around, and everyone's gaze paused on Vritra.
With him around, they had all put their minds on autopilot and simply did whatever he said, after all, thinking was much tougher than dying.

chapters.title: Chapter 839 Bull Dog
paragraphs: There were many questions, but for now, dealing with this situation was more important.
"It would be great if we can get the flags, we would have more lives that way." Vritra mumbled to himself.
As for the anomalies, he wasn't really sure. They could either be very powerful or have extreme hiding abilities.
The calamities too would be hard to kill with their current strength, so of course they would have to borrow the strength of the other players.
"Wifey, there should be one calamity in this town, can you find its location?" Vritra turned to Yasmine.
"Hmm... Yes, there is a faint glow in that direction, that must be the calamity that needs several level 5 demi gods to fight together." Yasmine answered.
"Yeah, that makes sense. Anyway, the level 4 ones must have divided into two groups, the five here had all died while the other group should be in another area."
Of course, no one knew how many of those people had ended up dying to the fog, they didn't know anything about it after all.
The level 6 ones must be in groups of two, but what about the level 5 ones then?
"We will have to use the level 6 demi gods, it would be easier that way. But first, our goal now is to collect the flags." Vritra added.
Their flag was gone and had been teleported to a random part of the town.
"I can't tell its exact location unless we are close, but I can sense its general direction." Yasmine said.
"Should I use the shadows to search for it?" Maeve asked, but Vritra shook his head.
"No, we don't know much about those fog monsters. They are dangerous, so it's better not to take unnecessary risks."
As the group chatted calmly, thankfully the fog didn't seep underground.
Time ticked by as they continued planning, trying to thoroughly account for every danger.
Anne was the biggest danger now. If she was alive, she already knew their faces.
"Time to change our appearances then." Vritra said, and they did so together using the Appearance Glyph.
It could even affect their heights and weights. The others all chose ordinary appearances, all except Shitless.
"What the hell is this? You Baldy, are you planning to woo a woman or two?" Onest asked in exasperation.
"Huhu. Jealous of my charms, are we?" Shitless chuckled, proudly raising his head all the way up.
"It is fine, the level 6 demi gods will think of him as an anomaly and kill him, just that." Vritra said, as if it were a trivial matter.
Shitless jolted, imagining such a possibility. After sighing, he reluctantly decided to lower his charm.
"Wait, I think it is time for you to truly shine, Sir Shitless." Vritra interrupted him, and upon hearing the title, everyone knew what was coming.
"H- Huh? What?" Shitless looked horrified, but after a moment transformed into Shit... Sonia.
Soon, it was past midnight and the next day began.
"Should I create that law now? That the fog monsters can't enter the buildings?" Yasmine asked. They were all resting.
Onest had gone to sleep in one corner and Shitless in another, leaving the eight of them alone.
"Not yet, let a few more players die first." The more players died, the easier things would become for them.
Yasmine shrugged, closed her eyes, and cuddled against Vritra, lying on his right side.
As the sun rose, announcing a beautiful morning.
In the second town, a group of people hid inside the sewage, holding their breaths.
They were completely submerged in the waste, not daring to make even the slightest sound.
Afraid that the fog would appear again and tear them apart.
[The Night has ended! You have survived!]
Only upon seeing this message did the group finally lift their heads out and inhale deeply.
Only to regret it after smelling the unbearable stench.
"COUGH COUGH. Ughh, the smell is so shit!" a man complained, his blue moustache covered with filth.
He pulled another short man out, whose head had been completely submerged in sewage and worse.
The two level 6 demi gods finally stood up, having felt utterly miserable.
They had spent hours lying in that sewage because they hadn't been able to find any other place to hide.

"Ooof. I hate this game, what the fuck is wrong now? First that golden glow and now this? What even was that fog?" the shorty shouted in annoyance, his face resembling that of a bulldog, with cheeks hanging low.
"Something has gone terribly wrong with the game, and I think... COUGH COUGH... we can find the answer through them." The blue-moustached man spoke while trying to spit something out.
The two pulled the people who were still hiding fearfully in the wastewater.
There were four more of them, all level 4 demi gods.
"Who are you guys? You don't seem to be from this town, nor do you look like anomalies?" Bulldog asked, scratching his arms until his skin bled.
"COUGH COUGH. Ughh, so disgusting, I must have eaten something wrong." The four of them looked utterly miserable.
Seeing them made the two feel a little better.
"S- Sir! Let's first get out of here before we talk, we will a- answer all your questions." The four quickly bowed toward the two.
"Haa. Fine, I don't want to stay here another moment anyway."
Quickly, the group left the sewage and climbed onto the road.
The people walking there all looked disgusted upon seeing them and hurried away.
They quickly found a place to wash themselves, and after bathing until the smell was finally gone, they gathered once again.
"Now, tell me what exactly is happening here?" Blue Moustache asked. He wondered whether his older brother was fine.

"S- Sir, we entered to play our own game, which is Flag and Hide. That fog is a part of our game, it seems there is some problem and several games have become mixed together." One of them answered quickly.
The two level 6 demi gods glanced at one another, appearing doubtful.
Then they looked back at them.
"You are not lying, right? What else do you know?" Bulldog asked with a snarl.

"S- Sir, please believe us. We have seen one level 5 demi god too. We have already lost one member of our group because of the fog, there is nothing we can do to prove..." He was still speaking when Blue Moustache interrupted him.
"They are telling the truth. So not only level 4 and 6, but even level 5? So your game consists of the flag and that fog, what about that golden glow?" Bulldog asked.
"Uh... It might be the game of the level 5 demi gods, we are not sure either. Should we all go there and check?" one of them asked fearfully.
"Yes, we will be going there right away. We also need to find a good place to hide."
Thus, the group headed toward the first city, but upon getting close, they were left utterly confused.
The golden glow hadn't disappeared, but now there were too many golden glows, all looking exactly the same.
"It seems someone has tampered with it. Let's search and eliminate all the enemies, my brother should be here as well." Blue Moustache muttered.
"And Anne too, hehe. I should propose to her again."
"Haa. What a peaceful night, this was better than I expected." Rubbing her eyes, Maeve woke up.
"You stupid fox, move away." Frowning, Diana pushed the demoness away.
Maeve had a habit of rolling around while sleeping, and she would kick the others. One of her feet was pressing against Diana's waist.
"Ah, haha. Sorry. Now that I think about it, do you hate me since I am a demoness and you are a goddess?" Maeve asked, stretching her arms.
She hadn't talked all that much with Diana before. Maeve hadn't realized it, but maybe the goddess hated her?
"Of course not, you fool, I'm not petty like that. That empress might hate you more." Diana said as she got up too. She was never going to sleep anywhere near this fox again.
Upon hearing that, Maeve looked toward Yennefer, who had just woken up too.
"Do you too...?"
"Of course I do, and I do it with passion." Yennefer said, turning away.
"Uh..." Maeve was at a loss for words. Wait, doesn't that make her the most hated in the group?
Previously, Fiona didn't like Teresa, but now they were good friends, like real sisters even.
There wasn't any real hatred between anyone, or so Maeve had believed previously.
"W- Who else hates me?" Maeve looked tearful as she gazed at the others.
Her eyes met Fiona's, who simply shrugged.
"I... don't really care."
"Ughh..." The poor demoness received critical damage, her poor little heart suffering badly.
The scene made Vritra laugh, he would never be bored with all his wives around.
Patting her head, he muttered, "I love you though."
Maeve's pout instantly changed into a happy smile as she jumped and snuggled into Vritra's arms.
"Hehe. That's enough for me." While hugging him, she looked back and then playfully stuck her tongue out at them.
After relaxing and playing around a little longer, the group began to get ready.
Soon the group moved through the elevator, arriving on the first floor.
"Everything looks so normal, even the damage from the previous night is gone." Looking around, Teresa spoke, even the broken window had been repaired.
"More players will be arriving here soon, we have to get started before that." Vritra looked behind at Shit... Sonia and smiled.

They are dangerous, so it's better not to take unnecessary risks."
As the group chatted calmly, thankfully the fog didn't seep underground.
Time ticked by as they continued planning, trying to thoroughly account for every danger.
Anne was the biggest danger now.
If she was alive, she already knew their faces.
"Time to change our appearances then." Vritra said, and they did so together using the Appearance Glyph.
It could even affect their heights and weights.
The others all chose ordinary appearances, all except Shitless.
"What the hell is this?
You Baldy, are you planning to woo a woman or two?" Onest asked in exasperation.
"Huhu.
Jealous of my charms, are we?" Shitless chuckled, proudly raising his head all the way up.
"It is fine, the level 6 demi gods will think of him as an anomaly and kill him, just that." Vritra said, as if it were a trivial matter.
Shitless jolted, imagining such a possibility.
After sighing, he reluctantly decided to lower his charm.
"Wait, I think it is time for you to truly shine, Sir Shitless." Vritra interrupted him, and upon hearing the title, everyone knew what was coming.
"H- Huh?
What?" Shitless looked horrified, but after a moment transformed into Shit...
Sonia.
Soon, it was past midnight and the next day began.
"Should I create that law now?
That the fog monsters can't enter the buildings?" Yasmine asked.
They were all resting.
Onest had gone to sleep in one corner and Shitless in another, leaving the eight of them alone.
"Not yet, let a few more players die first." The more players died, the easier things would become for them.
Yasmine shrugged, closed her eyes, and cuddled against Vritra, lying on his right side.
As the sun rose, announcing a beautiful morning.
In the second town, a group of people hid inside the sewage, holding their breaths.
They were completely submerged in the waste, not daring to make even the slightest sound.
Afraid that the fog would appear again and tear them apart.
[The Night has ended!
You have survived!]
Only upon seeing this message did the group finally lift their heads out and inhale deeply.
Only to regret it after smelling the unbearable stench.
"COUGH COUGH.
Ughh, the smell is so shit!" a man complained, his blue moustache covered with filth.
He pulled another short man out, whose head had been completely submerged in sewage and worse.
The two level 6 demi gods finally stood up, having felt utterly miserable.
They had spent hours lying in that sewage because they hadn't been able to find any other place to hide.
"Ooof.
I hate this game, what the fuck is wrong now?
First that golden glow and now this?
What even was that fog?" the shorty shouted in annoyance, his face resembling that of a bulldog, with cheeks hanging low.
"Something has gone terribly wrong with the game, and I think...
COUGH COUGH... we can find the answer through them." The blue-moustached man spoke while trying to spit something out.
The two pulled the people who were still hiding fearfully in the wastewater.
There were four more of them, all level 4 demi gods.
"Who are you guys?
You don't seem to be from this town, nor do you look like anomalies?" Bulldog asked, scratching his arms until his skin bled.
"COUGH COUGH.
Ughh, so disgusting, I must have eaten something wrong." The four of them looked utterly miserable.
Seeing them made the two feel a little better.
"S- Sir!
Let's first get out of here before we talk, we will a- answer all your questions." The four quickly bowed toward the two.
"Haa.
Fine, I don't want to stay here another moment anyway."
Quickly, the group left the sewage and climbed onto the road.
The people walking there all looked disgusted upon seeing them and hurried away.
They quickly found a place to wash themselves, and after bathing until the smell was finally gone, they gathered once again.
"Now, tell me what exactly is happening here?" Blue Moustache asked.
He wondered whether his older brother was fine.
"S- Sir, we entered to play our own game, which is Flag and Hide.
That fog is a part of our game, it seems there is some problem and several games have become mixed together." One of them answered quickly.
The two level 6 demi gods glanced at one another, appearing doubtful.
Then they looked back at them.
"You are not lying, right?
What else do you know?" Bulldog asked with a snarl.
"S- Sir, please believe us.
We have seen one level 5 demi god too.
We have already lost one member of our group because of the fog, there is nothing we can do to prove..." He was still speaking when Blue Moustache interrupted him.
"They are telling the truth.
So not only level 4 and 6, but even level 5?
So your game consists of the flag and that fog, what about that golden glow?" Bulldog asked.
It might be the game of the level 5 demi gods, we are not sure either.
Should we all go there and check?" one of them asked fearfully.
"Yes, we will be going there right away.
We also need to find a good place to hide."
Thus, the group headed toward the first city, but upon getting close, they were left utterly confused.
The golden glow hadn't disappeared, but now there were too many golden glows, all looking exactly the same.
"It seems someone has tampered with it.
Let's search and eliminate all the enemies, my brother should be here as well." Blue Moustache muttered.
"And Anne too, hehe.
I should propose to her again."
"Haa.
What a peaceful night, this was better than I expected." Rubbing her eyes, Maeve woke up.
"You stupid fox, move away." Frowning, Diana pushed the demoness away.
Maeve had a habit of rolling around while sleeping, and she would kick the others.
One of her feet was pressing against Diana's waist.
"Ah, haha.
Sorry.
Now that I think about it, do you hate me since I am a demoness and you are a goddess?" Maeve asked, stretching her arms.
She hadn't talked all that much with Diana before.
Maeve hadn't realized it, but maybe the goddess hated her?
"Of course not, you fool, I'm not petty like that.
That empress might hate you more." Diana said as she got up too.
She was never going to sleep anywhere near this fox again.
Upon hearing that, Maeve looked toward Yennefer, who had just woken up too.
"Do you too...?"
"Of course I do, and I do it with passion." Yennefer said, turning away.
"Uh..." Maeve was at a loss for words.
Wait, doesn't that make her the most hated in the group?
Previously, Fiona didn't like Teresa, but now they were good friends, like real sisters even.
There wasn't any real hatred between anyone, or so Maeve had believed previously.
"W- Who else hates me?" Maeve looked tearful as she gazed at the others.
Her eyes met Fiona's, who simply shrugged.
"I... don't really care."
"Ughh..." The poor demoness received critical damage, her poor little heart suffering badly.
The scene made Vritra laugh, he would never be bored with all his wives around.
Patting her head, he muttered, "I love you though."
Maeve's pout instantly changed into a happy smile as she jumped and snuggled into Vritra's arms.
"Hehe.
That's enough for me." While hugging him, she looked back and then playfully stuck her tongue out at them.
After relaxing and playing around a little longer, the group began to get ready.
Soon the group moved through the elevator, arriving on the first floor.
"Everything looks so normal, even the damage from the previous night is gone." Looking around, Teresa spoke, even the broken window had been repaired.
"More players will be arriving here soon, we have to get started before that." Vritra looked behind at Shit...
Sonia and smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 840 The Lizard Anomaly!
paragraphs: "You remember the script, right? Don't make any mistakes, we don't even have a flag." He reminded.
"C- Can't we let this mugger do it? He clearly is better at remembering the script." Shitless asked, looking pitiful.
"No, let's go and see if we can get the flag before those people arrive."
And thus, they began to walk in the direction Yasmine pointed, disappearing into the crowd while not looking any different.
"The flag seems to be in that building and it doesn't seem like there is anyone inside." Yasmine spoke after walking for nearly an hour.
Even while walking, they were extremely careful, making sure that Anne was not around.
But her ability to turn anyone into a puppet was very annoying. Still, finding their group now would be a bit more difficult.
Previously there were three men, but now there were only two.
"Let's go in." Onest took the lead, he didn't feel as meek as before, and his fighting spirit had become far stronger.
"Night Corp...? Again?" Vritra read the sign and was surprised.
First he checked and found that this place had underground floors too, were these some sort of safe spaces in the town?
"The flag again seemed to be underground." Yasmine interrupted.
Getting into the elevator, the group moved directly to the lowest floor and found the flag in exactly the same spot as before.
Onest took out the flag and again, over fifty dozers fell from the floor above.
"Here we go again." Vritra sighed, here it was, another training session.
"Let's go, bring out the big guns!!" Divine also appeared, rubbing his palms, or rather his insect-like hands.
BOOOOOOM BOOOOOOOM
It took less time than before, the group got into the elevator quickly as the dozers exploded violently.
The walls shook, but the building as a whole wasn't affected.
"We got the flag, what are we going to do now?" Onest asked, holding the normal-looking flag.
"Let's meet the level 6 demi gods now, two or more must already be here. And Shitless, take the flag, still be careful." Vritra said, his tone solemn.
"Sigh... fine..." Shitless took the flag, which then transformed into a tattoo on his arm.
The group walked out of Night Corp, now they had to find the players, which was rather easy.
Instead of going anywhere in search, Vritra snapped a finger, creating a big illusory ship.
It flew in the sky, all the people on the ground were startled, some fell, some ran away.
While Vritra's group quickly hid, the large ship continued to fly around, and it would be visible even from far away.
"W- What's that?" a level 4 demi god pointed up at the sky and shouted.
"Whoa! An anomaly?!!" Bulldog looked up with shining eyes, without waiting he flew in its direction.
"Sigh. Follow along." Blue Moustache had no choice but to stop the search for his brother and that golden light for now.
WHOOSH
The group arrived close to the flying ghost ship, there were many skeletons dancing on its top while singing something.
♪ Clap it for the man who pulled out late ♪
♪ Grind for the birth your mom should hate ♪
♪ Bend like you're proud of the mess they made ♪
♪ You're a group project with no A-grade ♪
"What are they singing?!"
Without waiting any longer, Bulldog launched an attack at the anomaly, so it wouldn't escape.
BOOM
There was a loud sonic boom, but all he hit was empty air and nothing else.
Then the ship disappeared, and the sky cleared up.
"What is going on? It wasn't an anomaly?" Blue Moustache couldn't understand anything.
They all landed on the ground, there was something happening with this town, and it was now making them all feel uneasy.
"S- Should we leave this place?" one of the level 4 demi gods asked.
"No, my brother is here, until I have-" Blue Moustache was, however, interrupted as a melodious female voice sounded.
"Welcome to the town of illusions, dear players."
The group turned and saw a beautiful blonde woman, she stood with her hands clasped, and a calm look on her face.
"Who the hell are you now?" Bulldog readied his claws, about to strike.

"Hello players, I am an NPC and I am here to help the players. I was supposed to be a beacon of light for the level 3 demi gods, unfortunately all of them passed away the previous night. You all can call me Sonia." The blonde woman spoke.
"Huh? There were level 3 demi gods here too? Just what in the fucking gods' name is happening here? What a mess!" Blue Moustache rubbed his head.

"Yes, from level 3 to level 6, all of you have entered this planet to complete your respective games. Now, if you tell me what help you need-" Sonia was speaking when one of the level 4 demi gods felt that something was strange.
He was sensing something but couldn't tell what, just then he caught a glimpse of a tattoo on her arm, but it was hidden away beneath her sleeve.
"What is that?!" He moved forward and tried pulling her sleeve up.
"Hmph. How rude!"
SLAP
Shitless was startled, he slapped the man hard, pulling his arm back.
"Tsk. You lecher, you are even attacking her?" Bulldog looked at him with a look of disgust.
"Help us find the anomalies." Blue Moustache ignored them and asked the important question, it would be great if he could find them before the others.
"That is easy, please follow behind me." Shitless then turned, but remembered that he couldn't fly.
Thankfully, he had received a potion from Diana in advance. He directly brought the potion to his mouth, gulping it down.
WHOOSH
The group flew at high speed. Bulldog and Blue Moustache still had doubts, but it wouldn't hurt to check.
Vritra and the others were hidden, following silently.
'Looks like we will be done with these games faster than we expected. These two don't seem to be the brightest ones in their group.' Vritra thought, using Misty Essence to hide themselves.
Yasmine was giving directions to Shitless, who was leading the group of six.
ROOAAARRRRRR
Suddenly, there was an ear-piercing roar that shook the land and the sky.
Hidden between a circular group of buildings was a large dome, and inside it was something terrifying.
"There really is something! Let's go and check." Bulldog didn't wait and rushed in like before, he just liked to attack directly.
BANG
He landed, creating a small crater on the ground.
He then ran straight into the dome, which was far more spacious inside, almost like a city.
"This... What a big lizard!" Bulldog paused as the others walked in, seeing the large creature.
It was over a hundred feet tall, with long limbs and a head like a... dog.
'Let's start the work!' Vritra snapped his fingers, he was the only one who entered along with Shitless, while the others all hid outside.
[You have found an anomaly!]
[The Lizzard Lord!]
[Clear it to proceed!]
"It really is an anomaly, so this Sonia wasn't lying. Haha, great, now we can easily find all the anomalies." Blue Moustache laughed.
"Yeah, now it would be easier to find all the anomalies. We have to protect her." Bulldog nodded, getting ready for the battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 841 The Idiotic Demi Gods
paragraphs: Sonia stood back as the two level 6 demi gods charged forward, rushing towards the dog-faced lizard.
Its strength was certainly above level 5, but the two wouldn't even have to go all out in this fight.
The dome was filled with the noise of explosions as the battle began.
Vritra, who was hidden in the background, used the Misty Essence Mythic Halo.
And stopped the original messages, showing them fake messages instead, making them think that this really was an anomaly.
When this was in fact a calamity, a part of the level 5 demi gods' game.
'They are very strong, it would be nearly impossible to fight them openly.' Vritra thought to himself while watching.
The calamities could be taken care of like this, but finding anomalies would be tough.
And even tougher would be dealing with these players, so he would have to make plans in advance.
"Haha! This guy is weaker than I expected." Bulldog laughed as he delivered a powerful punch to the lizard's belly.
"Focus, there may even be traps, stay careful until this thing is defeated." Blue Moustache shouted back, cutting off one arm of the lizard only for it to grow back quickly.
'Wifey still hasn't set a law for today, we can just hide in the Night Corp so it would be a waste to use it on the fog monsters.' Vritra thought.
But what law would benefit them in the long run?
The others couldn't enter any building during the day anyway, so how could they restrict them even more?
While Vritra was deep in thought, the two demi gods fought the calamity and before their combined power.
It couldn't last for long.
The lizard's healing ability gave out pretty soon and then it was blasted apart, torn into hundreds of pieces.
A monster which would have taken several level 5 demi gods a long time to defeat, was beaten just like that.
[You have cleared an anomaly!]
[Nine Anomalies remain!]
The moment the lizard monster died, two messages popped up before them.
"Yes! So we are the first ones to kill an anomaly!! If we keep at it, then we can quickly kill the others too." Bulldog was so happy that he began to jump.

"Haha, I wonder if the others would get the notification of our kill. Let's first find my brother and Anne, then we can continue the hunt with this pretty lady." Blue Moustache looked back at Sonia, as if she were some great treasure.
While Sonia stood with a stiff smile on her face, her hands clasped in front of her belly, feeling dread internally.
"Can you also find the l- location of the flags?" one of the level 4 demi gods hurriedly asked, but was pushed aside by Blue Moustache, who questioned:
"Can you find my brother's location?"
"I am sorry, but I can't help with that. But from what I can sense, no other players seem to still be in this town." Shit... Sonia replied in a calm tone.
"Huh? Did they leave this town already? But why would they leave without killing the anomaly? Or were they unable to find it?"
The two demi gods wondered, the thought of them having died didn't even cross their minds.
If they could survive, then those two definitely could.
"Should we go check another town then? Town 2? Maybe we will meet them somewhere on the way." Bulldog said, just thinking of Anne made him drool.
"Yes, I think so too. Sonia, are you ready to leave?" Turning to her, he asked.
"I..." Shitless, while crying internally, glanced back.
According to the plan, Shitless already held the flag so if he were to die, he would be resurrected.
And so he was supposed to go ahead by himself.
While using this time, Vritra and the others would find and eliminate the anomaly before moving to Town 2.
And doing the same there.
Shitless would just have to delay them a bit, and wait for the group to arrive.
"Y- Yes, let's go, but I would need a little rest before I can use my ability again, please be understanding." Sonia said, remembering the first day he had taken this form.
What a cursed day.
All just to make that prince fall for her, and since then, how many times had he gone through this?
"Haha! That's alright, this is already far better than looking for anomalies on our own." Blue Moustache laughed happily, unknowingly having fallen into the trap.
And thus, they left the dome and slowly began to move back towards Town 2.
'Hoo, thankfully no other players came, or it might have gotten a bit troublesome.' Vritra thought as they all reappeared.
"Will he be okay?" Yasmine asked, she had already given the directions towards the next calamity.
"Yeah, he is Divine's pet, how can anything happen to him?" Vritra said, then he added, "More than that, how do we go about finding the anomalies?"
The laws didn't affect the normal people of this planet, they could still freely enter any buildings.
While the players could not, so were the anomalies also affected?
He asked the same question to Yasmine, to which she replied:
"Since they are a part of the game, they have to follow the laws too."
"That is great then." The corners of Vritra's lips rose, as he finally thought of the new law.
"Then wifeys, shall we start the anomaly hunt?"
In another town, the players who had survived the fog monsters wanted to go in search of that glow as well.
But they were more cautious after seeing so many glows appear out of nowhere, they didn't just jump in like those two idiots.
Right as they were contemplating their next move and trying to find out more about the unknown changes, a message flashed before their eyes.
[A new law has been announced by the Ruler!]
[During the day, any person with their eyes open has to constantly clap!]
[If you break the law, you shall be punished with penalties.]
The moment these messages flashed, everyone was stunned.
What the hell was going on? What sort of fucked-up rules were these? What crazy person was setting them up?
Either the players quickly closed their eyes or had to clap constantly, they couldn't understand it but had to be careful.
Even Shitless was not spared, since he was moving away from them.
He needed to be around Yasmine for her to remove the law for a specific person, while Shitless was no longer affected by the previous law.
And so, Shitless, Bulldog, Blue Moustache and the four level 4 demi gods all had to clap as they flew.
"Now it should be easier to find the anomaly and it would also restrict the players." Vritra muttered as Yasmine finished setting up the law.
"That's such a great idea, hahaha, that Baldy must be going crazy while clapping." Onest laughed.
The women all felt that it was a really good idea, killing several birds with one stone.
Vritra then took out the compass which further narrowed down the direction of their search.
"Let's go then!" Fiona said, taking Vritra's hand, as they started walking.
There were no players in that town, so no clapping could be seen or heard, until they got close to a building.
"I can hear a faint sound, I think it's coming from inside there." Maeve spoke, controlling the shadows to peek inside.
The group stopped in front of it and waited, soon Maeve exclaimed:
"I saw it, the anomaly! It is in there, I just saw a person clapping rapidly."
"Let's go then, be careful. We aren't sure of its strength yet, let's kill it as quickly as possible."
Taking the lead, Vritra moved forward calmly.
Instead of moving in a group, they entered one by one, walking towards the place Maeve instructed.
Soon, Vritra stopped in front of a desk on the third floor, the man was clapping while trying to write something.
"Hello." Vritra spoke.
"..." The man looked up, but didn't say anything, just continued clapping.
Vritra stared at the man and wondered how this guy was an anomaly? He seemed pretty normal.
"Do you know where I can find someone named Onest?" he questioned.
"Hmm." After thinking for a moment, he shook his head, still not saying anything.
CLAP CLAP
Vritra took out the compass and moved around the guy, it was pointing straight at him and soon began to glow.
'It is indeed him!'
"I am telling you, this is who I am searching for-" Vritra leaned against the desk, as if to show a photo.
But Goop suddenly transformed into a sharp sword as Vritra slashed horizontally at the anomaly's neck.
WHOOSH
The movement was so sudden and quick that the anomaly was too late to react.
The blade cut into its body, as blood spluttered and the head was almost torn off.
RAAAAAAAAAAARRRRR
He finally let out a scream, his mouth opening into a large circular shape, long sharp teeth covering it.
And bugs and worms could be seen crawling around inside.
It jumped back, barely managing to save its life, but got attacked from all directions instantly.
Shadows, flames and all sorts of attacks were launched at the same time.
Within moments, the body of the anomaly was blasted to pieces, as insects crawled in all directions.
"Kill them all, it is trying to escape!" Vritra shouted, striking down all the tiny creatures.
The other people in the building were all startled, running away.
Before long, they managed to kill all the creatures and the first anomaly was slain.
[You have cleared an anomaly!]

The dome was filled with the noise of explosions as the battle began.
Vritra, who was hidden in the background, used the Misty Essence Mythic Halo.
And stopped the original messages, showing them fake messages instead, making them think that this really was an anomaly.
When this was in fact a calamity, a part of the level 5 demi gods' game.
'They are very strong, it would be nearly impossible to fight them openly.' Vritra thought to himself while watching.
The calamities could be taken care of like this, but finding anomalies would be tough.
And even tougher would be dealing with these players, so he would have to make plans in advance.
"Haha!
This guy is weaker than I expected." Bulldog laughed as he delivered a powerful punch to the lizard's belly.
"Focus, there may even be traps, stay careful until this thing is defeated." Blue Moustache shouted back, cutting off one arm of the lizard only for it to grow back quickly.
'Wifey still hasn't set a law for today, we can just hide in the Night Corp so it would be a waste to use it on the fog monsters.' Vritra thought.
But what law would benefit them in the long run?
The others couldn't enter any building during the day anyway, so how could they restrict them even more?
While Vritra was deep in thought, the two demi gods fought the calamity and before their combined power.
It couldn't last for long.
The lizard's healing ability gave out pretty soon and then it was blasted apart, torn into hundreds of pieces.
A monster which would have taken several level 5 demi gods a long time to defeat, was beaten just like that.
[You have cleared an anomaly!]
[Nine Anomalies remain!]
The moment the lizard monster died, two messages popped up before them.
"Yes!
So we are the first ones to kill an anomaly!!
If we keep at it, then we can quickly kill the others too." Bulldog was so happy that he began to jump.
"Haha, I wonder if the others would get the notification of our kill.
Let's first find my brother and Anne, then we can continue the hunt with this pretty lady." Blue Moustache looked back at Sonia, as if she were some great treasure.
While Sonia stood with a stiff smile on her face, her hands clasped in front of her belly, feeling dread internally.
"Can you also find the l- location of the flags?" one of the level 4 demi gods hurriedly asked, but was pushed aside by Blue Moustache, who questioned:
"Can you find my brother's location?"
"I am sorry, but I can't help with that.
But from what I can sense, no other players seem to still be in this town." Shit...
Sonia replied in a calm tone.
"Huh?
Did they leave this town already?
But why would they leave without killing the anomaly?
Or were they unable to find it?"
The two demi gods wondered, the thought of them having died didn't even cross their minds.
If they could survive, then those two definitely could.
"Should we go check another town then?
Town 2?
Maybe we will meet them somewhere on the way." Bulldog said, just thinking of Anne made him drool.
"Yes, I think so too.
Sonia, are you ready to leave?" Turning to her, he asked.
"I..." Shitless, while crying internally, glanced back.
According to the plan, Shitless already held the flag so if he were to die, he would be resurrected.
And so he was supposed to go ahead by himself.
While using this time, Vritra and the others would find and eliminate the anomaly before moving to Town 2.
And doing the same there.
Shitless would just have to delay them a bit, and wait for the group to arrive.
"Y- Yes, let's go, but I would need a little rest before I can use my ability again, please be understanding." Sonia said, remembering the first day he had taken this form.
What a cursed day.
All just to make that prince fall for her, and since then, how many times had he gone through this?
"Haha!
That's alright, this is already far better than looking for anomalies on our own." Blue Moustache laughed happily, unknowingly having fallen into the trap.
And thus, they left the dome and slowly began to move back towards Town 2.
'Hoo, thankfully no other players came, or it might have gotten a bit troublesome.' Vritra thought as they all reappeared.
"Will he be okay?" Yasmine asked, she had already given the directions towards the next calamity.
"Yeah, he is Divine's pet, how can anything happen to him?" Vritra said, then he added, "More than that, how do we go about finding the anomalies?"
The laws didn't affect the normal people of this planet, they could still freely enter any buildings.
While the players could not, so were the anomalies also affected?
He asked the same question to Yasmine, to which she replied:
"Since they are a part of the game, they have to follow the laws too."
"That is great then." The corners of Vritra's lips rose, as he finally thought of the new law.
"Then wifeys, shall we start the anomaly hunt?"
In another town, the players who had survived the fog monsters wanted to go in search of that glow as well.
But they were more cautious after seeing so many glows appear out of nowhere, they didn't just jump in like those two idiots.
Right as they were contemplating their next move and trying to find out more about the unknown changes, a message flashed before their eyes.
[A new law has been announced by the Ruler!]
[During the day, any person with their eyes open has to constantly clap!]
[If you break the law, you shall be punished with penalties.]
The moment these messages flashed, everyone was stunned.
What the hell was going on?
What sort of fucked-up rules were these?
What crazy person was setting them up?
Either the players quickly closed their eyes or had to clap constantly, they couldn't understand it but had to be careful.
Even Shitless was not spared, since he was moving away from them.
He needed to be around Yasmine for her to remove the law for a specific person, while Shitless was no longer affected by the previous law.
And so, Shitless, Bulldog, Blue Moustache and the four level 4 demi gods all had to clap as they flew.
"Now it should be easier to find the anomaly and it would also restrict the players." Vritra muttered as Yasmine finished setting up the law.
"That's such a great idea, hahaha, that Baldy must be going crazy while clapping." Onest laughed.
The women all felt that it was a really good idea, killing several birds with one stone.
Vritra then took out the compass which further narrowed down the direction of their search.
"Let's go then!" Fiona said, taking Vritra's hand, as they started walking.
There were no players in that town, so no clapping could be seen or heard, until they got close to a building.
"I can hear a faint sound, I think it's coming from inside there." Maeve spoke, controlling the shadows to peek inside.
The group stopped in front of it and waited, soon Maeve exclaimed:
"I saw it, the anomaly!
It is in there, I just saw a person clapping rapidly."
"Let's go then, be careful.
We aren't sure of its strength yet, let's kill it as quickly as possible."
Taking the lead, Vritra moved forward calmly.
Instead of moving in a group, they entered one by one, walking towards the place Maeve instructed.
Soon, Vritra stopped in front of a desk on the third floor, the man was clapping while trying to write something.
"Hello." Vritra spoke.
"..." The man looked up, but didn't say anything, just continued clapping.
Vritra stared at the man and wondered how this guy was an anomaly?
He seemed pretty normal.
"Do you know where I can find someone named Onest?" he questioned.
"Hmm." After thinking for a moment, he shook his head, still not saying anything.
CLAP CLAP
Vritra took out the compass and moved around the guy, it was pointing straight at him and soon began to glow.
'It is indeed him!'
"I am telling you, this is who I am searching for-" Vritra leaned against the desk, as if to show a photo.
But Goop suddenly transformed into a sharp sword as Vritra slashed horizontally at the anomaly's neck.
WHOOSH
The movement was so sudden and quick that the anomaly was too late to react.
The blade cut into its body, as blood spluttered and the head was almost torn off.
RAAAAAAAAAAARRRRR
He finally let out a scream, his mouth opening into a large circular shape, long sharp teeth covering it.
And bugs and worms could be seen crawling around inside.
It jumped back, barely managing to save its life, but got attacked from all directions instantly.
Shadows, flames and all sorts of attacks were launched at the same time.
Within moments, the body of the anomaly was blasted to pieces, as insects crawled in all directions.
"Kill them all, it is trying to escape!" Vritra shouted, striking down all the tiny creatures.
The other people in the building were all startled, running away.
Before long, they managed to kill all the creatures and the first anomaly was slain.
[You have cleared an anomaly!]

chapters.title: Chapter 842 One handed Lady
paragraphs: [You have cleared an anomaly!]
Vritra slumped back against the table as the message flashed before him, thankfully the anomaly wasn't at the level 6 demi god level.
The main difficulty was actually finding one, it would be nearly impossible to locate an anomaly.
When the person is sitting inside one of the countless buildings, the only way to recognize them would be when they opened their mouth.
But because of the rules of the different games, it had become much easier for Vritra's group to find them.
"That's one down!" Vanessa exclaimed, pulling back the attacking cloth she had just used.
"Honestly, finding them is nearly impossible, even if a person watches over every single person all the time." Maeve pulled back the Needle of Darkness, sitting beside Vritra.
"Are we gonna go straight to the next town now?" Diana asked, holding the glowing blue knife.
Vritra nodded, glancing out of the window, not much time had passed yet.
"We need to get close to Shitless quickly, but first, I wonder if Anne is still alive. If she is, we have to deal with her as soon as possible." He replied.
The last time, they had almost pushed her to her death since it was a trap, but the same trick wouldn't work again.

"Yes, she can inform the others. Maybe she is dead, or maybe she is already out of the town. Even if we find her, how are we supposed to kill her? The fog won't be enough to kill her now." Yennefer pondered, the difference in strength was just too much.
Vritra stared at the empress's face, then a smile appeared on his own as he got yet another good idea.
"I have a plan, but first we need to find her location." Taking out the compass, Vritra stood up then spoke to Teresa:
"I need you to send a message to Sonia."
The beautiful goth nodded, taking out a treasure she had created that allowed her to discreetly send messages to anyone in the group.

'Husband has barely fought in this game, except against those dozers. Since the beginning he has been making use of others, making them do whatever he wants, and that too in such a natural way.' Teresa thought.
It was both terrifying and awesome, she was certainly getting to learn new things.
KNOCK KNOCK
"Miss Sonia, are your powers ready yet?" Bulldog knocked on the door of the room in which Sonia was staying.
It hadn't been long since they decided to stay somewhere, but only Shitless could enter the building.
The others couldn't, which made them further believe that this was a supreme powerhouse sent by the gods to help them.
"Not yet, I need a little longer, just wait a few more minutes..." Inside the small house they had rented, Shitless was sweating.
Thankfully this house was his safe haven, but he couldn't keep up the act for long.
When are they going to get here?
Just then he felt a buzz and took out a bead from his inventory, as a message with some instructions appeared before him.
The six men were waiting outside in anticipation, the level 4 demi gods still waiting to receive help from this woman.
Waiting all the while, constantly clapping or needing to close their eyes to stop clapping.
"Uwaaah!!" Just then a scream sounded from inside, alerting the six. They wanted to rush inside, but couldn't.
"W- What's wrong, Miss Sonia?" Blue Moustache asked, trying to open the door but not breaking it.
"O- Oh, it's nothing worrying. I just... HUFF... had a v- vision, I saw the location... HUFF HUFF... of a flag in the previous town." Sonia's out-of-breath voice sounded.
"Flag?! Where is it? Please help us too, Miss Sonia!" The level 4 demi gods all bowed deeply.
"Hmph. You shouldn't be wasting your magic on these people, our game is far more important. Are you feeling alright?" Bulldog asked, glaring at the four.

"Y- Yes, I am fine. This came as a vision so it didn't consume any magic, don't worry. Here, this is the location of the flag. If you want to get it, you have to act quickly before its location changes." From under the door, a slip of paper was pushed out.
One of the level 4 demi gods picked it up and read the address, all four of them instantly became happy.
"Thank you very much, Miss Sonia, we will never forget this help and repay you in the future." They all shouted at once.
Then they nervously looked at the two level 6 demi gods, hoping to get their permission.
"Just scram." Bulldog shooed them away.
"Thank you." After bowing, the four quickly flew away, finally they could also complete their game.
On the way, they discussed the strange changes in the games, especially since they couldn't do so before.
"Do you think these changes are related to those ten that got the gods thrown in jail?" one asked.
"Most probably, I can't think of any other way the gods could mess them up this badly. Four games were pushed together." Another added.
"If we find and kill them, do you think we would be rewarded by the gods?" the third asked, greed flashing in his eyes.
"Meh, let's find the flags first. If we do find them, then killing those people shouldn't be a problem, they were only level 3, no?"
While chatting, the group flew for a while and soon arrived in Town 1.
They followed the directions written on the paper and soon found themselves walking into a slum-like area.
"The flag is here? But if it's inside a house, we can only take it at night."
"And we have to hide from those fog monsters too, sigh, what a shitty situation."

"Hehe, it might be so, but at least the gods sent that beautiful angel to help us. I wonder if I can start a family with her. Can I take her back with me? I can play another game and just exchange my reward for her." One guy muttered with a lovesick expression.
"Don't even think about it, she is your sister-in-law, don't you dare have any wrong thoughts. Haa, she is mine."
While walking through the slum area, they began to argue.
"But where is the flag?" Looking down, one saw House No. 55 written there, but the houses in this slum area didn't have numbers.
Did Sonia make a mistake?
"They are here!" Vritra spotted the group of four, they were also clapping constantly.
"Anne really is alive, how did that woman survive against the fog?" Yennefer exclaimed in shock.
They were hidden, but with the help of the compass they were able to find her.
One of her arms was missing, but she was still clapping, tapping over her thigh with her right hand.
There were many wounds on her body which were healing very slowly, but there was a look of rage on her face.
Well, anyone in her place would be angry. Despite being so powerful, she had been tricked and had almost ended up dead.
But those people must be thinking that she was dead and would become careless, she would surely hunt them all down.
Kill them all and make them suffer even more.
At first Anne wanted to leave the town and get help, but she couldn't really trust others. What if they tried to take advantage of her weakened state?
So she simply hid in this slum area, away from everyone.
Once she fully recovered, she would kill every single one of them.
Just as she was blending in with the normal people, her gaze landed on four people.
It was them!!
Those four weaklings who had dared to trick her, and here they were enjoying their time.
There were three men and one woman, so they had divided into different teams?
A cruel smile slowly appeared on Anne's face, but she contemplated whether it would be worth attacking them in her current condition.
They were only level 3, but what if they had more tricks prepared?
But just then she heard them speak:
"Haha! Did you see the dumbass look on her face? That arrogant bitch must be in the belly of those creatures by now." Onest asked.
"Ugh, ugly bitch, why mention her? Do you know what she said before dying?" the bald one asked.
"What?" Vritra shrugged.
Shitless chuckled then began to act.
"Ahhh! Aghhhh! Uwaaah! Save me! Kiyaaaaaaa!"
"Hahaha! Stop it, that's too funny."
"But what a pity, if I had faced her again, I would have beaten her up with my own hands. Truly a pity she died so early, or I would have made her feel a pain-"
But his speech was cut off as a one-armed woman walked in front of them with a faint smile.
"What sort of pain? Can you say that again?" she asked, looking very calm.
"Y- You?!! How are you here? Didn't you die?" the four all looked terrified.
"Didn't you all want to kill me? And you Baldy, how did I act while dying? How will you act when I rip that shiny bald head off?" Anne asked softly.
The four level 4 demi gods stared at the one-armed woman in front of them in confusion, she was muttering strange things to a completely different group.
"Uh... Hey, one-handed woman, can you move aside?" one of them said.
But she just kept muttering something strange, not listening to them at all.
"Ugh. She is wasting our time, let me throw her away." Another groaned and stepped forward to push her aside.
Anne saw Shitless coming closer to attack her, she smiled as her fingers turned into claws.
Even if she killed these four, she wouldn't receive any penalty.

chapters.title: Chapter 843 The Penalties
paragraphs: "You dumb woman, what are you staring at? Get out of our way!" Onest shouted while taking a step back.
"Haha, look at her condition, she won't be able to catch up to us, just wait and watch."
Shitless laughed mockingly, then turned, pointing his butt towards Anne and challenged her while slapping it. "Catch me if you can, you green octo!"
Anne became so angry at those remarks that her body trembled with rage.
She thought these guys would be shaking in fear upon seeing her again, but instead they were mocking her.
How dare they!
She completely lost it, going berserk as she lunged towards these weaklings who simply didn't know what they should and shouldn't say.
Her fist, which had already transformed into a deadly claw, rained down towards that bald head.
On the other side, the four clueless players couldn't understand what was wrong with this one-handed woman.
They just wanted to leave, but she kept talking to herself and getting in their way.
One of them got annoyed and decided to push her aside, but the moment he got close.
She attacked!
The man was startled and tried to dodge while blocking, but she was far too fast.
BANG
Her sharp claws struck his head, making it explode like a watermelon.
But that wasn't enough to quench her anger, with the same hand she began launching rapid attacks.
The four men couldn't react at all, despite her injuries she was still a level 6 demi god.
Rapid messages flashed before her eyes.
As the first man died by her hand, a message appeared that was completely blocked off by Vritra.
[You have killed an unrelated person!]
[Any more meaningless kills will bring penalties upon you unless an anomaly is removed first!]
Vritra used the Misty Essence to completely control this battle scene.
'If they kill one wrong person, they would be warned. But killing a second would give them a penalty, yet if they kill an anomaly first, they can kill one more person and receive another warning.'
Vritra thought, Divine had told him exactly what messages she was receiving.
But unable to see anything, like a madwoman, Anne kept killing.
[You have killed an unrelated person!]
[You have received a penalty!]
[Your mana has been locked!]
Another series of messages flashed as Anne killed the person who appeared to be Onest.
She didn't pause for even a moment, next targeting the woman, she would kill Vritra at the end, after making him watch the others die.
"Tell me where the rest of you are and I might just spare you." Her face was completely twisted, even while speaking she targeted the remaining one.
[You have killed an unrelated person!]
[You have received a penalty!]
[Your physical strength has been locked!]
[Any more unrelated deaths will lead to an extreme penalty!]
But Anne wasn't one to stop, she grinned and looked at her last target.
Then with one final strike, right before her strength was completely locked, she tore apart the final person.
Killing the last of the level 4 demi gods.
And just like that, the level 3 and level 4 demi gods had been completely wiped out.
Leaving only the level 5 and level 6 demi gods.
[You have received a strict punishment!]
[You will be removed from the game and thrown into prison for an undecided period of time.]
Finally she regained her senses, Anne was completely covered in blood.
As the Misty Essence stopped its magic, she finally saw the mess around her.
"Yo, how are you feeling?" Vritra called out from not too far away, a faint smile on his lips.
"Y- You... how are you still alive? I just k- killed you!!" she was completely flabbergasted.
{Sin Points Gained: Baffled +1, +1, +1...}
The message kept flashing, showing just how shocked she really was.
"Ah, that? It was a little trick of ours. Oh right, did you see the messages? I think something important was flashing before you while you were busy carrying out that slaughter."
Hearing those words from that blue-haired woman, Anne glanced away.
And upon seeing the messages, she was even more shocked, then enraged.
She had been tricked yet again, Anne had always been careful, but with strength and wealth comes a certain level of arrogance.
And no matter what, it is always present.
She had looked down on these people first and ended up falling into the trap, or maybe even if she had taken them seriously.
The result would have been the same?
It was too absurd, completely unbelievable.
"I am going to kill you all!! How dare you do this to me!" Anne rushed forward as her body began to fade away.
But by the time she got closer, Anne had almost completely disappeared.
"Get lost, you are weak." Vritra spoke as the smile completely disappeared from his face, looking at her with empty eyes.
She let out an unwilling scream before disappearing completely.
And just like that, two of the level 6 demi gods had been taken care of.

"No, it wasn't really. There are still a lot of level 5 and level 6 demi gods left, and things could go terribly wrong with just one mistake." Diana spoke, staying composed.
But they were all happy at this achievement.
"Should we go eat something here? Now that the anomaly is gone, things shouldn't be dangerous." Fiona suggested.
"Yeah, we can. Things have been so tense from the moment we arrived here, it would be great to have a small break." Vanessa agreed too.
"Let's go then, hmm... are we forgetting something?" Yasmine wondered, scratching her cheek.
"No we aren't, let's go and eat first then we will continue!" Onest quickly added, and started moving out of the slum area.
"..." Vritra wordlessly followed behind them, while thinking about how to deal with the remaining players and challenges.
"W- Wait, what about my pet?" Divine spoke from behind, but the poor bug's voice was buried beneath Onest's laughter.
On the other side, Shitless kept delaying the two demi gods, crying inside the house like a helpless lady.
"This, that, these five too, and this drink for ten." Fiona took the menu and placed the order.
It was a high-end restaurant, and thanks to Misty Essence they were led to one of the best rooms.
The Misty Essence Mythic Halo was truly shining in this place, without it Vritra would have been in so much trouble.
Yasmine had been right, even if it was at the lowest rank since it didn't really possess any offensive capability.
It was still one of the best Mythic Halos, with countless capabilities.
Especially when the user was weaker and needed to create large-scale chaos.

But then he felt maybe he shouldn't have asked that, what if one person wanted two drinks?
Wouldn't they get offended since people nowadays got offended so quickly?

"What do you mean, there are ten of u..."
As she looked back and counted, she only saw nine people.
Someone was missing...
"Oh wait, Shitless went to the next town. He was supposed to wait for us, oops." Maeve spoke.
That evil monk was mostly lost in his own evil ideas or busy fighting with Onest, so he always disappeared into the background for them.
The focus of the women was mostly on Vritra and now also on the dangers.
So they forgot after the brief moment of relief.
Vritra too had a lot on his mind, and he wasn't really worried about Shitless's safety so he usually didn't keep track of him.
"But Onest, didn't you remember about him?" Yennefer turned her head and asked.
"Ah haha, oh right, Shitless. He must be fine. It slipped my mind too." He looked away and whistled.
He definitely remembered, they all thought at once.
They were certainly each other's biggest haters, always looking forward to each other's misfortune.
"Uh, let's quickly eat now that we are already here, we will be there soon." Vritra said, what could even kill that monk?
But he wondered just why Divine had chosen such a pet. He truly was one of a kind.
Soon the food arrived and they all began eating, it was hot and delicious, all of them completely new dishes.
They didn't waste any time chatting and quickly finished their food.
But it still took nearly thirty minutes before they were all done, Onest took the longest to eat, he was for some reason especially hungry.
"Hoo, I am so full, how about we take a nap before going to-" Onest was suggesting while rubbing his full belly.
"No, let's go, we can't waste time like this." Vritra interrupted, and so Onest had no choice but to give in.
The ten, after paying up, left the restaurant, the manager was very happy since they spent so much, even leaving a massive tip behind.
But the illusion would last only a little longer.
The group then wasted no time and hurriedly flew towards Town 2, easily finding Shitless's location.
BANG BANG
"Miss Sonia, are you still not ready? How much longer do you exactly need?" Bulldog asked, there was no annoyance in his voice.
"J- Just a few more minutes, I am almost done." Shitless sobbed, burying his face into the pillow.
Did they abandon him? Was he going to stay inside this house forever?
Should he just transform back into his original form and leave discreetly? But the problem was, the house was small and no one else was inside it.
They had rented the entire house.
Just then he received another message.
