chapters.title: Chapter 844 The Great Battle
paragraphs: "D- Damnit, Miss Sonia, hasn't it already been too long? How much more time do you need?!" Blue Moustache began to shout as well.
"Open the door and come out, even if your pow-"
The two demi gods had veins popping all over their foreheads by now.
BANG
The door suddenly opened, and from inside walked out a calm and collected Sonia.
With a smile on her face, she looked at the two men and spoke, "Can you stop barking for a moment, you dogs?"
The two paused for a moment before glaring at her.
"What?!"
"Haha, I meant Bulldog. Anyway, it is time to head off."
Without giving them any time to reply, she started flying away.
Shitless internally cursed Onest and decided to take his revenge later, since he was the one behind Vritra arriving late.
Going ahead, their plan was the same as before.
Vritra and the others hid and followed behind the three figures.
Before long, they arrived at another dome where another calamity was present.
The two demi gods killed the calamity and received the message, while Vritra remained there to control the scene with Misty Essence.
Meanwhile, the group of women separated to search for the second anomaly.
It was already getting late, so after dealing with it they would have to quickly hide from the fog monsters.
Soon after, Vritra received the message that his wives had found the anomaly.
Since his work here was done, he teleported away, soon arriving beside them.
And this anomaly was even harder to catch, it was an infant with an extra eye on its back.
After confirming it, all of them attacked at once, giving it no chance to escape.
[You have eliminated an anomaly!]
[Anomalies: 2/10]
"Let's go rest for now, this is already a good pace. We will search for the flag in the morning." Vritra said, and they found a Night Corp building.
They headed straight to the lowest floor and rested comfortably.
Shitless also hid inside one such building, quickly changing his appearance after blending into the crowd.
Telling those two that she would appear once again in the morning.
Blue Moustache and Bulldog both had no choice but to go hide in the sewer, they wondered if those level 4 demi gods would be back.
And just like that, night arrived and fog covered everything.
Roars of monsters could be heard, leaving most of the players baffled and afraid.
The whole area was crowded, millions of people had gathered.
The news of the battle between the Garissa and Asura families had spread far and wide.
Even the Vespera family was involved.
At the highest seats sat Adam, Fader, Evelyn and Zengis from the higher beings' side.
Zengis being Armin's father.
There were also a few top figures from the Asura race and a few others seated away from them.
Everyone seemed interested in this fight.
"My daughter, are you comfortable with your seat? Do you want me to ask for a better one?" Fader asked, holding a glass of wine in both hands.
"No." Evelyn glanced around.
There were so many demi gods here, even a lot of gods, and these were like bugs to the likes of higher beings and the others.
If her family or the others were to find out that her man was just a level 3 demi god, and even had seven wives, one of whom was even pregnant.
No matter how much she thought about it, she couldn't think of a way to make her family agree to it.
Forgetting the danger for a moment, this sort of relationship just seemed impossible.
But Evelyn was hellbent on being with Vritra, no matter the cost, he had already travelled so far.
From a human of Earth to a demi god, just a little more time and he would stand at a position that no one could shake.
She just needed to buy herself enough time.
'I wonder how his game is going, it became such a mess. Divine is with him but I am really worried.'
Originally Divine was not going to go with them, but because of the sudden change, he had to.
The game had become too dangerous.
But if she saw how Vritra was progressing, she might laugh to tears.
"Ughh, these demi gods are so noisy, should I wipe out a few to make them quiet down?" Adam frowned, looking at the large number of demi gods.
"Now now, Father, that's not how we should be acting. Even if they are bugs, it wouldn't suit our image to do that, would it?" Fader asked.
"Sigh."
Hearing this just made Evelyn even more worried.
Every time they mentioned a demi god, she felt they were talking about Vritra.
And when they finally came to know about him, even if he grew stronger, they would still care about his origins.
This was just giving her a headache.
"My fiancée, are you here to cheer for me?"
Breaking Evelyn's chain of thoughts, Armin, who floated above the battle arena, spoke with his arms behind his back and a smile on his face.
Evelyn merely glanced at him and didn't even acknowledge his presence, instead looking down at something else.
'Ughh... This woman... just you wait, I will break you if I have to, but I am going to change you, no matter what.'
A dangerous light passed through Armin's eyes as he glared at Evelyn.
"A- Armin, I am here for you, please look at me!!"
"Wow, he looks so handsome, I am so jealous. It should have been me!"
All of Armin's fangirls were going crazy, shouting towards him, to which Armin simply smiled and waved his hand.
BOOM
The whole arena seemed to shake as a person with bright red skin and whitish tattoos jumped to the centre.
He was bare-chested and stood over eight feet tall, an intense heat brimming around him while his muscles bulged.
This burly man was the son of the Asura Empress, the challenger for Evelyn's hand in marriage.
"Armin, are you scared?" His lips stretched into a grotesque smile as he stared at Armin with killing intent.

"Heh, scared of just you? Well, I might be a bit... if you bring out the whole Asura race, but still... I'd win!" Armin chuckled, directly insulting the entire Asura race and even the Empress herself.
But Len, the Asura Prince, didn't get angry.
He had been through enough battles to not lose his mind over something like this.
Not one to waste time on words, he didn't retort and simply laughed.
"We will see about that by the end of this battle, and I will be the one to marry her."
"Hah, look at this red pig, even a mirror would get scared of you. And you want to marry her?" Armin shook his head while feeling annoyed.
No matter what, he wouldn't let Evelyn marry anyone else, even if he had to sacrifice himself to kill this Len.
"What hot-blooded young men, but let's not bring my daughter's name into this? You understand?" Fader, who was going to be the referee of the match.
Simply looked at the two and both of them felt chills run through their bodies.
"Haa, isn't this a little too late for that? You shouldn't have made me a prize for your own benefit in the first place." Evelyn complained, especially glaring at her grandfather.
Adam was far worse, he wouldn't hesitate even once before using her like this.

"Haha, don't worry, nothing is set in stone, you know. Maybe if someone better arrives, you can choose him... hmm, but too bad, I can't find anyone better. Do you know anyone like that?" Fader looked at his daughter after asking.
"How would I? If I did, I wouldn't be stuck with your shitty arrangements." Evelyn replied, her eyes narrowing.
'Haa... She really can stay calm in every situation, truly my daughter.' Fader laughed and didn't continue the matter.
Instead, he flew up and stopped above the arena, looking at all the important figures.
"Armin, don't you dare splash dirt over my great name!" Zengis spoke in a strict tone before adding,
"You aren't my only son and I won't tolerate failures that ruin my great name, Zengis!"
"Y- Yes, Sir Zengis. I will do my best... no, I will definitely win." Armin said, already used to his father by now.
"Len, just don't kill him." The Asura Empress, who sat behind a curtain, spoke, her voice sounding groggy.
Everyone wondered if she was really sleeping at a time like this.
Or was it a strategy to make Armin lose confidence? Before the actual battle, there were mind games that could influence the result.
Fader yawned and after taking a sip of wine, spoke in a voice loud enough to reverberate throughout the massive arena.
"Since all the preparations are done, let's not waste any more time. Are you both ready?" He glanced down at the two.
Armin and Len stood opposite one another, serious looks on their faces.
"Yes." Both replied.
Len tightened the gloves around his wrists while Armin took out a hand fan with ugly eye patterns on it.
"Let the battle begin!!"
The whole arena erupted with roars as people screamed at the top of their lungs.
The vibrations travelled through their bodies.
Armin and Len remained still for a brief moment before shooting forward.
Len swung his arm, the force nearly cracking space as loud booming sounds rang out.
Armin kept his left hand behind his back while swinging the fan with his right, trying to block the punch.
BOOOOM
The moment the fist and fan came into contact, the fan was blasted to pieces, unable to stop the punch for even a moment.
The powerful blow continued onward, piercing through Armin's chest before blasting his head off.
The headless body trembled for a moment before collapsing.

Before the actual battle, there were mind games that could influence the result.
Fader yawned and after taking a sip of wine, spoke in a voice loud enough to reverberate throughout the massive arena.
"Since all the preparations are done, let's not waste any more time.
Are you both ready?" He glanced down at the two.
Armin and Len stood opposite one another, serious looks on their faces.
"Yes." Both replied.
Len tightened the gloves around his wrists while Armin took out a hand fan with ugly eye patterns on it.
"Let the battle begin!!"
The whole arena erupted with roars as people screamed at the top of their lungs.
The vibrations travelled through their bodies.
Armin and Len remained still for a brief moment before shooting forward.
Len swung his arm, the force nearly cracking space as loud booming sounds rang out.
Armin kept his left hand behind his back while swinging the fan with his right, trying to block the punch.
BOOOOM
The moment the fist and fan came into contact, the fan was blasted to pieces, unable to stop the punch for even a moment.
The powerful blow continued onward, piercing through Armin's chest before blasting his head off.
The headless body trembled for a moment before collapsing.

chapters.title: Chapter 845 Exposed
paragraphs: "Where is it?"
"W- Wait, let me charge my powers..."
It was the dawn of the next day, and Shitless was once again stuck inside a building.
They had already travelled to Town 3, there might still be other level 6 or level 5 demi gods alive.
So Shitless revealed a big secret to Blue Moustache and Bulldog.
"The ones who kill the most anomalies will get a special reward from the gods, so unless you want to benefit others, let's hide and quickly clear everything."
It is in most creatures' nature to be greedy.
So, using their greed, Shitless made sure they wouldn't reveal their great secret to anyone else.
Instead, they would secretly travel through all the towns and clear the anomalies.
Therefore, Blue Moustache and Bulldog didn't search for anyone and even remained hidden.
Waiting for Sonia's powers to recharge.
In Town 2, Vritra had already cleared two anomalies, and two calamities had been killed.
They searched for the second flag, which was rather easy to find thanks to Yasmine and the compass.
"And we are done with two towns, let's head to the next one." Vritra spoke. Instead of flying, they decided to take a taxi.
The cars here looked completely different from those on Earth and moved a little slower.
They didn't want to waste any more time in this game than necessary, quickly making their way toward Town 3.
"We still need to be careful of the level 6 demi gods. I wonder how many are still alive." Yennefer wondered out loud.
But with their strength, barely any of them should have died.
At least two were already dead.
"Darling, should we use the same method we used against Anne on the other level 6 demi gods? At least we can take care of those two idiots." Fiona asked as she sat facing Vritra.

"Yeah, it can certainly work against them, but against the others, I'm not so sure. There should still be some level 5 demi gods alive." Vritra replied. More than strength, brains were being used in this game.

"There is a berserk gas I found in Zihong's treasures, he probably planned to use it against Husband. It would make a person go mad with rage, to the point they would even start hurting themselves." Teresa suddenly spoke before adding,
"But using it is a little dangerous. Even we could be affected, and I'm not sure how large an area it would cover."
"Then let's put it aside for now. We will only use it if there is no other choice. Anything else useful in there?" Vritra asked.
"No, only that gas can work against level 6 demi gods, nothing else." Teresa shrugged.
The vehicle continued moving forward, and before long they entered the third town.
"My powers are back! Now stop grovelling and follow me!"
With each passing day, Sonia's attitude became more arrogant.
Only while her powers were recharging did she remain humble.
The same process played out once again.
Sonia guided the two demi gods to the calamity, with Vritra using Misty Essence to control the scene while the women went to search for the anomaly.
Once they found it and Vritra arrived, all of them attacked together and killed it.
Though these creatures were extremely sneaky, one tiny mistake and they would disappear without a trace.
Just like that, the game returned to easy mode for Vritra and the others.
Thanks to the two foolish powerhouses, they were able to sweep through one town after another.
Killing the calamity, then the anomaly, and finally obtaining the flag before moving on.
Town 3, Town 4... one after another they cleared them all.
On the fifth day, they had already reached Town 9.
Thankfully, none of the other players had discovered them yet, though Vritra did find a few of them using the compass.
Avoiding them completely.
Yasmine didn't set any further laws. She experimented and discovered that the number of unused laws could actually be carried over.
So now she could still create five more laws.
"You pests, what are you waiting for? Go and tear it apart! Heh, can't even do one job properly, you dogs!"
Standing behind them, Sonia pointed toward an eagle-like anomaly while cursing.
The two demi gods had grown used to her behaviour by now, though they were still quite annoyed. They wanted to kill her, but she might be related to the gods.
So they could only endure it.
"Huh? Someone is approaching!" Vritra, who was hidden, suddenly exclaimed, and only Sonia heard his voice.
"W- What? Is it a player? Level 5 or 6?" Shitless hurriedly turned around, staring toward the entrance in bewilderment.
"H- Hey, someone is coming!" Sonia quickly shouted toward the two fighting demi gods.
"Ughh, who is it?" Bulldog growled.
"Heh, does it matter now? We have already killed eight anomalies, nine if we count this one too. We are already going to get that godly treasure, let them come and witness our greatness."
Soon, a limping frog-like person walked inside. His skin was green, and fist-sized bumps covered his entire body.
"Froggy? Haha, I knew you would be alive, but where is your brother?" Blue Moustache asked without stopping his assault.
Froggy slowly looked around before focusing his gaze on them.
"What's going on here? Why are you fighting that thing?"
Seeing Froggy's expression, Vritra had a bad feeling.
Things had been going too smoothly.
And now a problem had appeared.
'Looks like I'll have to depend on Misty Essence yet again. I hope it works.'
He quickly created different illusions for both sides.
"What do you mean? It's an anomaly, so of course we have to kill it." Bulldog replied while delivering a powerful attack to the eagle's head.
"Oh haha, you beat me to it. How many anomalies have you cleared?" Froggy asked, or rather, the illusion the two of them were seeing asked.
"Hahaha, we have already killed nine anomalies. Can you believe it? All thanks to the support given by the gods."
On the other hand, Vritra created a completely different illusion for Froggy.
"That is not even an anomaly, so why are you fighting it?"
'How does this guy know?' Vritra wondered while remaining hidden beneath Misty Essence.
"Yeah, we know that. We're just repaying a favour. Someone helped us, so we're doing the same for them." Blue Moustache replied with a laugh.
Froggy stared at the illusion.
Then his gaze shifted toward Sonia, who stood there like a statue with a stiff smile.
Finally, his eyes turned toward Vritra's direction, almost giving him goosebumps.
'He... can see me?'
Instantly, Vritra felt a violent buzz from the compass in his pocket.
It was the strongest danger signal yet.
'He really saw me!'
Vritra could immediately tell there was something unusual about Froggy's eyes.
He really could partially see through Misty Essence.
How was that even possible?
But this wasn't the time to think about it.
Without hesitation, he sprinted toward Shitless, disappearing.
Froggy didn't move as Vritra grabbed Sonia's shoulder and teleported away.
The illusion collapsed, but the two demi gods continued fighting, noticing nothing unusual.
After one final powerful attack, they finally killed the eagle-like anomaly, tearing it into thousands of pieces.
Messages immediately appeared before their eyes, but neither of them bothered reading them.
Bulldog laughed and walked toward Froggy, already preparing to brag.
"So, how many anomalies did you clear? Let me guess... zero? Kukukuku! We just killed the ninth! So how about calling me Big D-"
Bulldog stopped midway.
A trembling hand had landed on his shoulder.
"What's the matter?" He looked back.
"L- Look at the messages. This is strange. Something is very wrong!"
Bulldog sighed and lazily glanced at the notifications.
What could possibly be wrong? Weren't they always the same?
[You have killed a calamity!]
[Calamities: 9/10]
"W- What? Calamity? Shouldn't it say anomaly? What... happened? Oh right, Sonia! What is the meaning of this... huh? Where is she?" Bulldog roared, only to discover the woman had vanished.
"Gi gigigigigi!"
Froggy burst into laughter.
Holding his stomach, he rolled around on the ground.
"T- This bastard... what is happening?" The two felt their minds go blank as reality slowly began sinking in, though neither wanted to accept it.

"They made complete fools out of you. Gigi! Did you not see that man? Well, he was hidden extremely well, so I doubt you noticed him. And that woman... no, it was actually a bald man, you idiots." Froggy wiped away tears of laughter.
Then he began explaining.
While hiding from the fog monsters, he had found a gift sent by the gods.
In such high-level games, the gods could send gifts to anyone they believed was performing exceptionally well.
Of course, there were limits. They couldn't send anything too overpowered.
And the gods, who had long ago discovered the chaos inside the game, were filled with rage.
Yet they couldn't directly enter or interfere with it and could only watch as Vritra's group rampaged through everything.
They were so close to victory.
So they decided to neutralize Vritra's greatest support.
It was a talisman that allowed Froggy to receive information directly from the gods while also letting him slightly see through Misty Essence.
But the effect was still too weak, otherwise he would have caught them much earlier.
Then Bulldog shared everything that had happened, proudly explaining how they had been "killing anomalies" all this time.
The two suddenly felt like complete clowns.
"Ughh, I'm going to kill them! RAAARRRRRRR!" Bulldog roared.
"Gigigi! Of course we have to kill them. Only the tenth town remains now, and they will surely go there. Once they appear, all the remaining level 5 and level 6 demi gods will slaughter them!"

chapters.title: Chapter 846 So Much Confusion
paragraphs: "What do you mean?" Bull Dog asked, he was still fuming, so he didn't listen properly.

"Aside from the three of us, there are four level 6 demi gods still alive. And six level 5 demi gods, so together, all of us will hunt them down." Froggie explained with a cruel expression on his face.
"Uh... how much is that?" Bull Dog tried to count on his fingers, but he only had eight.
"That's thirteen." Blue Moustache answered, then looked forward and asked: "So what's the plan? And did you meet my brother too?"
Froggie rolled his big eyes, how can they be so stupid? How did they even make it this far?
Oh right, by depending mostly on others and brute force.
"There are thirteen of us, we will start the hunt in the tenth town. With this talisman, finding them will be very easy." Froggie spoke with confidence.
It was already past evening, so they could only postpone the hunt until tomorrow as the sky was about to start darkening.
"Uh... what are the chances of us catching them?" Blue Moustache asked, then remembered Froggie hadn't answered the question about his brother.
"100%, there is no way they can escape the moment they enter the tenth town." Froggie replied with arrogance in his tone.
And thus, the two idiots and a frog began to make plans.
The night passed rather quietly, they had already gotten used to the fog monsters and could stay hidden perfectly.
While hidden in the sewage, Blue Moustache once again asked about his brother's whereabouts.
And Bull Dog was curious about Anne.
"One of us died because of the fog monsters, it was only thanks to him that I managed to survive and was lucky enough to receive this temporary gift from the gods." Froggie solemnly explained.
Then he added: "As for them, they both are already dead. And I am sure those people are behind it. Both your brother and Anne have died."
Hearing this news, both demi gods were so shocked that ripples spread through the filthy sewage water.
"IMPOSSIBLE!!" both shouted at once, jumping to their feet.
"Shh, calm down, if those monsters find us, we will die without ever avenging them." Froggie was startled, trying to calm the two.
Gritting their teeth and with both pairs of eyes turning red from rage, they crouched back down again.

"There is no way those weaklings could kill my brother, he is very strong. And Anne was with him too, she is smart and powerful, there is no way I would believe that." Blue Moustache wanted to roar in anger but could only whisper.

"They both really are dead, I have already checked on the remaining players. And I cannot find either of them, but maybe there is something else, we will only know once the game ends." Froggie decided to give them a little vague hope.
"My Anne, t- there is no way she would die. She... she promised to take me out on a walk... we... agghhh I am going to kill those bastards!! RAA-"
This time, Froggie and Blue Moustache were both frightened by the roar, forcefully pushing Bull Dog back down to muffle his voice.
And just like that, another restless night passed before the fog monsters finally disappeared.
Right as the sun started to rise, thirteen figures quickly gathered in the tenth town.
Froggie was the leader, and the rest were simply following his commands.
Exactly twelve people stood before him, all waiting for their orders.
Since he had been given the treasure by the gods themselves, even the proud level 6 demi gods didn't object.

"Those people have three objectives. Collecting the flags, which is easy for them. Killing the anomalies, which is also not too difficult and they have already killed most of them. And finally, the calamity, which is nearly impossible for their group." Froggie spoke, his voice loud and clear.
It was understandable, they were only level 3 demi gods, so they couldn't possibly defeat something stronger than the peak of level 5.
After a brief pause, Froggie continued: "They will definitely have to enter this town, the final one! And this will become our hunting ground, they will enter... but they won't leave alive!"
Bull Dog and the others let out furious roars, flames of vengeance dancing within their eyes.

"Now, I will assign all of you to different positions throughout this town. No matter what happens, don't move from your position. And even if you find them, don't kill them, just try to capture them after sending me a signal."
"You understand, right? Those people can easily trick all of you." Froggie spoke especially to Blue Moustache and Bull Dog.
"Yeah, we won't kill them and will just capture them alive." The two nodded obediently.
But there was no way they would actually do that, one had lost his brother and the other had lost his lover, so they would kill Vritra's group the moment they appeared.
"That's all. I will convey more information to you all later, now get to your positions." After speaking, Froggie quickly threw a map and some sort of device toward everyone.
Each map had a location marked on it, it was the map of the tenth town.
"Huh? What is it?" they all looked at the devices in confusion.
"It is something I will use to contact all of you. You just need to press this button and nothing else." After giving some brief instructions,
they all dispersed, completely focused on their task.
Whether level 5 or level 6, they all wanted to kill those intruders who had ruined everything.
All of them were certain they would have completed their games successfully and advanced to the next level.
But now, so many had died.
"Are you all in position?" Froggie asked after a few minutes, holding the mobile-like device.
"Oh, it really works just by pressing this button, I will take a few back home. Ah, yes, we are in position." Bull Dog muttered, momentarily forgetting about Anne.
But then he put away the device and got back to work.
Not even a fly would be allowed to pass through now.
Time slowly continued to pass as Froggie used his eyes to continuously scan every corner of the town.
He was surprised that those people still hadn't arrived, did they get scared?
But no matter what, they would eventually have to enter the tenth town or they would remain trapped inside the game.
And the moment they set foot here, they were dead.
Just like that, four hours had passed, yet there were still no signs of any of them.
"Are they not here? What if they used some trick to sneak in?" someone asked.
"There is no possibility of that, the moment they arrive in this town, I will know." Froggie replied with complete confidence.
They waited and waited, growing more impatient with every passing minute.
But they all believed that Vritra's group had been frightened by them. And it was only logical, after all, how could they possibly face so many level 5 and even level 6 demi gods?
It would be suicide to face even a single one of them.
But sooner or later they were bound to-
Just as they all waited in anticipation, a few messages suddenly flashed before everyone's eyes, completely startling them.
[Congratulations! All flags have been captured!]
[The Crown remains protected!]
[Two tasks have been completed!]
They were all completely flabbergasted, and instantly a flurry of messages bombarded Froggie.
"You damn frog bastard, didn't you say you would notice them the moment they entered? What the fuck is happening now?"
"What? Cat got your tongue? They had already captured all the flags, and you still couldn't track them? Even after getting the gods' gift?"
"Yeah, this embarrassment might as well go and crucify his own ass after acting like our leader!! Don't let me catch you, you are dead meat, Froggie!"
"Hah, look at this. Level 6? I would rather eat shit than level up into someone like him, he is just retar-"
Even the level 5 demi gods were shouting at him with unbelievably foul language.
Froggie was already feeling confused, he couldn't understand a single thing.
How had they entered, searched around, and even found the flags?
There was no way the talisman had stopped working, he looked around and could clearly see the locations of all his teammates.
Then what had happened?
He had clearly overlooked something.
And these damn demi gods just kept shouting at him, so he simply cut the call and began thinking everything through once again.
Not noticing that the call had already disconnected, they continued cursing Froggie relentlessly.
Soon, even more messages popped up.
[Congratulations! All anomalies have been cleared!]
[The Crown remains protected!]
[All flags have been captured!]
[Three tasks have been completed!]
Seeing these messages, they were even more baffled.
Now only the calamity remained. If they could kill it, then the game would truly be over!!
For a few moments, they all fell silent and noticed that the device was no longer connected to Froggie.
Just how was this possible?
They had been patrolling all over the town and hadn't seen any of them.
Did they change their appearances?
Froggie was the one who was the most confused.
He was smarter than the other level 6 demi gods and also possessed the treasure.
So how was this even possible?
He received another call and unconsciously answered it.
Only to be greeted by another round of curses, the level 5 demi gods were even more relentless this time, going completely unhinged.
They even cursed Froggie's parents and children who weren't even born yet.
"But just how did they..." Suddenly Froggie's eyes widened as he thought of something.
"I- It couldn't be... don't tell me they..."

Both your brother and Anne have died."
Hearing this news, both demi gods were so shocked that ripples spread through the filthy sewage water.
"IMPOSSIBLE!!" both shouted at once, jumping to their feet.
"Shh, calm down, if those monsters find us, we will die without ever avenging them." Froggie was startled, trying to calm the two.
Gritting their teeth and with both pairs of eyes turning red from rage, they crouched back down again.
"There is no way those weaklings could kill my brother, he is very strong.
And Anne was with him too, she is smart and powerful, there is no way I would believe that." Blue Moustache wanted to roar in anger but could only whisper.
"They both really are dead, I have already checked on the remaining players.
And I cannot find either of them, but maybe there is something else, we will only know once the game ends." Froggie decided to give them a little vague hope.
"My Anne, t- there is no way she would die.
She... she promised to take me out on a walk... we... agghhh I am going to kill those bastards!!
RAA-"
This time, Froggie and Blue Moustache were both frightened by the roar, forcefully pushing Bull Dog back down to muffle his voice.
And just like that, another restless night passed before the fog monsters finally disappeared.
Right as the sun started to rise, thirteen figures quickly gathered in the tenth town.
Froggie was the leader, and the rest were simply following his commands.
Exactly twelve people stood before him, all waiting for their orders.
Since he had been given the treasure by the gods themselves, even the proud level 6 demi gods didn't object.
"Those people have three objectives.
Collecting the flags, which is easy for them.
Killing the anomalies, which is also not too difficult and they have already killed most of them.
And finally, the calamity, which is nearly impossible for their group." Froggie spoke, his voice loud and clear.
It was understandable, they were only level 3 demi gods, so they couldn't possibly defeat something stronger than the peak of level 5.
After a brief pause, Froggie continued: "They will definitely have to enter this town, the final one!
And this will become our hunting ground, they will enter... but they won't leave alive!"
Bull Dog and the others let out furious roars, flames of vengeance dancing within their eyes.
"Now, I will assign all of you to different positions throughout this town.
No matter what happens, don't move from your position.
And even if you find them, don't kill them, just try to capture them after sending me a signal."
"You understand, right?
Those people can easily trick all of you." Froggie spoke especially to Blue Moustache and Bull Dog.
"Yeah, we won't kill them and will just capture them alive." The two nodded obediently.
But there was no way they would actually do that, one had lost his brother and the other had lost his lover, so they would kill Vritra's group the moment they appeared.
"That's all.
I will convey more information to you all later, now get to your positions." After speaking, Froggie quickly threw a map and some sort of device toward everyone.
Each map had a location marked on it, it was the map of the tenth town.
"Huh?
What is it?" they all looked at the devices in confusion.
"It is something I will use to contact all of you.
You just need to press this button and nothing else." After giving some brief instructions,
they all dispersed, completely focused on their task.
Whether level 5 or level 6, they all wanted to kill those intruders who had ruined everything.
All of them were certain they would have completed their games successfully and advanced to the next level.
But now, so many had died.
"Are you all in position?" Froggie asked after a few minutes, holding the mobile-like device.
"Oh, it really works just by pressing this button, I will take a few back home.
Ah, yes, we are in position." Bull Dog muttered, momentarily forgetting about Anne.
But then he put away the device and got back to work.
Not even a fly would be allowed to pass through now.
Time slowly continued to pass as Froggie used his eyes to continuously scan every corner of the town.
He was surprised that those people still hadn't arrived, did they get scared?
But no matter what, they would eventually have to enter the tenth town or they would remain trapped inside the game.
And the moment they set foot here, they were dead.
Just like that, four hours had passed, yet there were still no signs of any of them.
"Are they not here?
What if they used some trick to sneak in?" someone asked.
"There is no possibility of that, the moment they arrive in this town, I will know." Froggie replied with complete confidence.
They waited and waited, growing more impatient with every passing minute.
But they all believed that Vritra's group had been frightened by them.
And it was only logical, after all, how could they possibly face so many level 5 and even level 6 demi gods?
It would be suicide to face even a single one of them.
But sooner or later they were bound to-
Just as they all waited in anticipation, a few messages suddenly flashed before everyone's eyes, completely startling them.
[Congratulations!
All flags have been captured!]
[The Crown remains protected!]
[Two tasks have been completed!]
They were all completely flabbergasted, and instantly a flurry of messages bombarded Froggie.
"You damn frog bastard, didn't you say you would notice them the moment they entered?
What the fuck is happening now?"
"What?
Cat got your tongue?
They had already captured all the flags, and you still couldn't track them?
Even after getting the gods' gift?"
"Yeah, this embarrassment might as well go and crucify his own ass after acting like our leader!!
Don't let me catch you, you are dead meat, Froggie!"
"Hah, look at this.
Level 6?
I would rather eat shit than level up into someone like him, he is just retar-"
Even the level 5 demi gods were shouting at him with unbelievably foul language.
Froggie was already feeling confused, he couldn't understand a single thing.
How had they entered, searched around, and even found the flags?
There was no way the talisman had stopped working, he looked around and could clearly see the locations of all his teammates.
Then what had happened?
He had clearly overlooked something.
And these damn demi gods just kept shouting at him, so he simply cut the call and began thinking everything through once again.
Not noticing that the call had already disconnected, they continued cursing Froggie relentlessly.
Soon, even more messages popped up.
[Congratulations!
All anomalies have been cleared!]
[The Crown remains protected!]
[All flags have been captured!]
[Three tasks have been completed!]
Seeing these messages, they were even more baffled.
Now only the calamity remained.
If they could kill it, then the game would truly be over!!
For a few moments, they all fell silent and noticed that the device was no longer connected to Froggie.
Just how was this possible?
They had been patrolling all over the town and hadn't seen any of them.
Did they change their appearances?
Froggie was the one who was the most confused.
He was smarter than the other level 6 demi gods and also possessed the treasure.
So how was this even possible?
He received another call and unconsciously answered it.
Only to be greeted by another round of curses, the level 5 demi gods were even more relentless this time, going completely unhinged.
They even cursed Froggie's parents and children who weren't even born yet.
"But just how did they..." Suddenly Froggie's eyes widened as he thought of something.
"I- It couldn't be... don't tell me they..."

chapters.title: Chapter 847 Another Trick?
paragraphs: "I- It couldn't be... don't tell me they..." Froggy's eyes widened in shock as he thought of a possibility.
Instantly, he cut the call and reconnected, stopping the others from cursing.
"You level 5 wastrels, say another word and I will chop you all up!!" Froggy warned, then added:
"And both of you, Bull Dog and Blue Moustache, you have been fooled for days by those people. What right do you have to criticize me?"
Then, calming himself, he ordered everyone to quickly gather at his location.
Within a few minutes, everyone was standing around Froggy.
The level 5 demi gods were frightened and stood behind the level 6 ones, only peeking out occasionally.
"We don't have time for this, you both step forward. I have a question for you." Froggy looked at the two idiotic demi gods who were glaring at him.
"Yeah? What is it? Don't tell me you are trying to push the blame for your incompetence onto us?" Bull Dog asked.
If this guy was so bad, then maybe Anne was still alive. Maybe he simply wasn't able to find her, with her abilities, there was no way she would die.
By controlling the normal people of this town, she could easily fool anyone.
"Just answer one question." Froggy's lips twitched upon hearing them, without giving them any time, he asked:
"What were the towns you have already cleared? And by that I mean killing the calamities."
Both Blue Moustache and Bull Dog looked at him as if they were looking at an idiot.
"Of course from town 1 to 9, only town 10 was left. And one question is over, now kneel and beg for our forgiveness." Blue Moustache answered.
He too thought that his brother might still be alive, this guy was simply too useless.
"Are you sure it was towns 1 to 9? He didn't actually bring you to the tenth town first, did he?" Froggy pressed on.
"Hah! You think we are stupid like you? Of course we cleared towns 1 to 9, period!" Bull Dog retorted, convinced Froggy was simply trying to shift the blame.
Froggy sighed and slapped his forehead, those guys had once again fooled them all.
Did they really think this far ahead? Planning everything in advance?

"Here is what I think... they already made you clear the tenth town, and only one of the other towns is still missing. And since the flags and anomalies have already been cleared, now only one calamity remains and the game will be over." Froggy explained in the simplest terms possible.
Hearing those words, everyone looked shaken, especially the two idiots.
They had been fooled to this extent?
And they had spent hours standing in this town like complete idiots, waiting.
Both felt so angry, on top of killing Blue Moustache's brother and Anne, those people were unbelievably evil.
"I am going to kill them all!!!" the two shouted at once.
"Calm down, the remaining calamity... I doubt they can kill it on their own, so they will definitely want to use us to kill it." Froggy was now taking that group far more seriously.
Their strength was low, but their planning was top-notch. One mistake and they would fall into another one of their tricks.

"First of all, we will stay close together. They can't do anything to us that way, and I will see through their tricks. Now we will move from town to town and find them." Froggy quickly came up with a new plan.
And thus, they began to move together, flying at full speed through the sky.
Leaving town 10, they soon arrived in town 9, but after searching everywhere, they couldn't find them.
Then they moved to town 8 and still were unable to find them.
Then town 7, yet the result was exactly the same.
As town after town passed, Bull Dog and Blue Moustache were left wondering, since when had they actually started?
How did those people even think of such a situation in advance?
By the time they started searching town 6, it was already evening and the sky was beginning to darken.
And so, Froggy decided to end the search for the day after checking town 5.
They were still moving together as a group, making it almost impossible for them to fall into another trap.
Just as they got closer to town 5 and were about to end the search...
Froggy and the others saw a familiar person.
The others couldn't recognize her immediately, but Blue Moustache and Bull Dog definitely could.
It was none other than Shit... Sonia.
She stood there with a faint smile.
Right before the boundary of the fifth town, she stood there looking exactly the same as before.
"T- That bastard, he is still pretending!!"
Both Blue Moustache and Bull Dog, who had been fooled for days, couldn't hold themselves back anymore.
They both sprinted toward her, killing intent bursting from their bodies after being toyed with until the very end.
"W- Wait!" Froggy shouted loudly.
Remembering that the other side could very well be using another cheap trick, the two stopped, wondering whether this was fake.
They didn't want to receive penalties for nothing.
"Is she a person from this planet? Can't we kill her? Is this another trick?" Bull Dog quickly asked, stopping only a short distance away.
Their bodies were literally overflowing with killing intent.
Froggy stared at Shitless, she certainly wasn't a person from this planet, so killing her would be fine, but something still felt strange.
"Uh... there is no problem with killing her, but-"
And that was all those two needed to hear.
They wasted not even a single second before sprinting again.
But right before they could reach her, Sonia jumped backward, landing inside the territory of the fifth town.
Then her appearance changed into that of the bald guy, Shitless.
He turned around, pointed his butt toward them, slapped it provocatively, and then ran deeper into the town.
Seeing that gesture, the two demi gods almost exploded with rage as they charged after him.
'Something is wrong again...' Froggy had an extremely bad feeling in his heart.
He started running after them while trying to stop the two, but they refused to listen.
Blue Moustache and Bull Dog, while trying to kill Shitless, entered the fifth town, while the other demi gods followed behind Froggy.
But right at that moment, a message appeared before all of them.
[A new law has been created!]
[Crossing from one town to another is from now on prohibited during the evening!]
Any law could be created as long as it didn't directly or indirectly stop the progress of a game completely.
And all the laws created so far clearly satisfied that condition.
BANG
Froggy and the others smashed into a transparent barrier separating the towns, completely unable to cross into the fifth town.
But the two idiotic demi gods continued their chase as if they hadn't even seen the message.
"STOOOPPPPPP!!" Froggy roared, but it was completely useless.
Just then, the handsome blue-haired guy Froggy had seen before appeared.
"Hello there, you really shouldn't be screaming so much, don't you know there are monsters around here?" Vritra spoke with a smile while looking at them.
"You! It is you!" Froggy glared, his body trembling with rage.
"Ah right, thank you for delivering these two idiots here just in time." Vritra said, completely unfazed by their anger.
Froggy was startled once again.
So they had indeed fallen into his plan?
'He planned for them to come to this town... and at exactly this time? H- How did he plan something like this?' Even Froggy was beginning to get a headache.
Trying desperately to understand Vritra's plan.
It was already almost time for the fog monsters to appear, so what exactly was he planning to do in such a short amount of time?
And he deliberately brought those two into the fifth town, what was his true purpose?
"W- We have to find somewhere to hide quickly, the fog monsters will be here any second." One of them muttered before immediately running away without waiting.
Froggy glared at Vritra, feeling that saying anything more would only be a waste of time, before turning around and running away as well.
Until morning, they could only leave everything to fate and hope those two wouldn't help Vritra kill the calamity.
'Now that they are aware of his plans, they shouldn't be stupid enough to fall for the same trap again.' Froggy thought, or rather hoped.
And he was right, the two of them wouldn't fall for the exact same trap so easily.
But Vritra had an entirely different plan.
"Haha, can't catch me? You two are so dumb. You know I was there when Anne and your brother died, want to know their last words?" Shitless asked while running.
Whenever the two attacked, he somehow managed to barely dodge them every single time.
Hearing those words, they only became angrier and angrier, chasing him relentlessly.
Completely ignoring the fact that night was approaching.
Soon, Shitless sprinted into a massive dome.
Blue Moustache and Bull Dog didn't even notice as they ran inside as well, grinning upon seeing Shitless finally stop.
"Now where are you going to run?" they laughed maniacally.
"D- Don't kill me... please spare me. I- I am sorry... pfft, you thought I was actually going to say that?"
RAAAARRRRRRR!!
Just then, a deafening roar sounded from behind Shitless as an enormous tiger-like creature appeared.
It bit down on Shitless, swallowing him whole.
But just as the body was torn apart, it transformed into a clone of Onest.
It seemed they had been tricked yet again.
But there was no way they would stay behind to fight it, so they immediately turned around and tried to flee.
Only then did they notice the sky beginning to darken, the fog monsters would arrive at any moment.
But right then, another message flashed before their eyes.
[A new law has been created!]
[Anyone who has entered the dome can leave only when there are no creatures other than members of their own race alive inside.]

chapters.title: Chapter 848 And the game ends...
paragraphs: As the messages flashed before them, Blue Moustache and Bull Dog looked at each other.
There was shock, fear, and rage on their faces, yet again, they had been tricked into entering this building.
The sky was already turning dark, and soon the fog monsters would be roaming about.
And now they were left with two choices, either kill the calamity and flee.
Or just stay trapped and be killed, failing Vritra's plan. They would surely lose the game then.
But at what cost? Was their life more important or the game?
What would even be the point if they were already dead? But the calamity didn't give them much time to think.
The tiger-like creature charged at them.
Vritra and the others had already left, if those two killed the calamity then it would be their victory.
But if they decided to sacrifice themselves, then it would put Vritra's group in danger.
And so, Vritra needed to be prepared.
"This game turned out better than expected, maybe the mess-up was a good thing." Yasmine spoke, they were already present on the lowest floor of the Night Corp building.
"Yup, I thought it would be a lot more dangerous, and we might even die a few times." Fiona said while eating the hot spicy noodles that had just been cooked.
A flame danced over Diana's palm, its form and shape continuously changing into different things.
She wondered if she would one day be able to do something like that too, but her halo was still weak for now.
Still, it was growing stronger along with her.
Only if she could get her hands on some powerful halo to feed her own halo.
"Those two didn't seem like the type to sacrifice themselves, so the game really might be over." Onest muttered, pulling his bowl away so Shitless couldn't steal his food.
"Your clone was rather good at imitating me, I am impressed. Let me reward you by..." After making a feint, he quickly picked up the biggest piece of meat.
"Keke... by finishing your food faster."
"You damn Baldy, sit farther away!" Onest shouted while moving away himself.
Then he quickly finished his noodles and demonstrated his lightning-fast speed by snatching away several more pieces of meat.
And the two continued quarrelling.
"Husband, is there any condition that we need to kill all the other players to complete the game?" Yennefer asked.
"I don't think there is anything like that, right Divine?" Vritra asked, but noticed that the insect wasn't around.
Instead, Divine's voice sounded directly inside his mind.
"What?"
Vritra repeated the empress's question in his mind, while also asking where he had gone all of a sudden.
"Oh, yeah. There is no need, you have already killed more than enough. And since things are done there, I went out for a bit." Divine replied, before suddenly shouting,
"Go for the head, the head! Yesss! U- Ughh, not in the nose! Oof..."
'What the hell are you watching? That sounds nasty.'
"Huh? It's nothing much, just a wild battle..." He suddenly paused before cheering once more. "Yes yes! Put the fan in his ass!! Let's goooo!"
Vritra: "..."
He didn't even want to imagine what strange thing Divine was watching anymore, so he simply stopped talking.
Now they could just relax and wait for the results, hoping everything turned out fine.
Back inside the dome, Blue Moustache and Bull Dog were trapped together with the calamity.
The darkness continued to deepen and wisps of fog could already be seen creeping along the ground, soon those monsters would start appearing.
"L- Let's get out of here!" Bull Dog shouted, he didn't want to die like this.
He had seen how brutally those creatures killed, a person had been torn apart right in front of him.
"Yes, fuck this game!! It's those gods' fault for fucking it up anyway, those dogs can go eat shit. I don't care, we will just play again!" Blue Moustache shouted while trembling.
Quickly, the two faced the tiger monster and went all out, bombarding it with one powerful skill after another.
It didn't take long before the abomination finally dropped dead.
Instantly, a new set of messages flashed before everyone, but the two of them didn't even have the time to look as they sprinted away in search of a safe place.
[All calamities have been cleared!]
[The Crown remains protected!]
[All flags have been captured!]
[All anomalies have been cleared!]
[All conditions have been met! The game is hereby concluded!]
Hidden far away inside another section of the sewage, Froggy and the others saw those messages and simply slumped to the ground.
It was all over.
Those people's plan had succeeded.
They wondered what would happen now.
Back in the fifth town, Vritra lay comfortably on a bed inside a tent together with his wives.
The messages flashed before them like a pleasant surprise, instantly bringing smiles to all their faces.
"The game is really over! We won!" Maeve exclaimed while lying beside him, suddenly sitting upright.
"Haa... I was getting tired of wearing this crown, finally we are done, and with no casual... uh, almost no casualties." Yasmine added, remembering that Onest had to sacrifice himself once.

There were no major surprises, and the game ended completely in their favour.

'We will have to go meet that crying monk now, I wonder what this is about.'

Vritra wondered what kind of expressions the gods must be making at this very moment.
They would soon be meeting the court anyway, would that guy, Petophil, be there again?
It would be great if he became their lawyer once more, and... would Evelyn be the judge again?
They would be meeting again if that happened, and unknowingly Vritra found himself looking forward to seeing her again.
'I wonder what she is doing now.'

"Haha. It would be no fun if you lost without struggling, your little tricks won't work anymore." Len had already made his preparations.

With a snap of his fingers, flames began burning around his eyes.
It was only a temporary measure, but now he could see through every illusion.

A battle between Higher Beings was unimaginably dangerous, a single strike possessed enough power to destroy dozens of planets.
Even inside this arena where the world rules had been strengthened countless times, it was still difficult to contain such overwhelming power.
Not to mention, neither of them intended to fight seriously.
The maximum either of them would use was only around thirty percent of their true strength.

They would both end up dying.

she knew for certain the game had either already ended or was about to end, and Vritra must have won.

she doubted he even liked her yet.

Yet she wasn't interested in it at all.
This daughter of his...
He truly couldn't understand her sometimes.
Armin, who was in the middle of the battle, glanced toward Evelyn and was instantly filled with anger upon seeing that barrier.
She truly held no interest in him whatsoever.
And it only made him even more frustrated and furious.

She slowly opened her eyes and removed the barrier, looking down at the battered battlefield.
"What an exciting battle, truly showcasing the heirs of two great families... and the winner is..."

Still, it was growing stronger along with her.
Only if she could get her hands on some powerful halo to feed her own halo.

Let's goooo!"

chapters.title: Chapter 849 The Shocking Result
paragraphs: Evelyn yawned as she removed the barrier and saw the condition of the battlefield.
The space was cracked, and the ground had completely disappeared.
Blood could also be seen sprayed over broken, floating pieces of ground.
As she looked around to see the victor, her father's voice rang out.
"What an exciting battle, truly showcasing the heirs of two great families... and the winner is..."
After a dramatic pause, while looking in his daughter's direction, he added, "Armin Garissa!!"
Evelyn was surprised, so he really managed to beat that bulky guy?
Back when the two used to fight for practice, Armin always used to lose.
Len had an absolute advantage with his great speed and strength.
Armin did pick up a few tricks, but it seemed Len was prepared for them too, so how did this guy win?
She saw Len lying in a puddle of blood, both his arms missing.
There was a deep slash across his body that had nearly torn his torso in two.
There wasn't even an ounce of energy left in his body, and his healing had stopped. Len was in a really bad state.
He would survive, but Evelyn truly wondered how he had been driven to such a state.
Then her gaze drifted to the victor... Armin.
And her eyes widened even more in surprise, a question instantly popped into her mind.
'Is... he still alive?'
He was still standing but looked so broken that his body might just fall apart at any moment.
Out of all four limbs, only one leg was left. Both his eyes had been gouged out.
More than half of his torso was gone, and even his skull had been crushed badly.
They were Higher Beings, and killing one was extremely difficult, to the point that they were nearly immortal.
But when fighting someone of the same level, there were, of course, ways they could die too.
It would take more than physical harm though, and in this battle, since Fader was overseeing it,
there was no way anyone was going to die.
'Still, his condition is just as I had expected. He must have been beaten all over the place.' Evelyn thought.
Looks like she would have to watch the highlights of the battle later and see the special moves both of them had used.
Then she glanced at Armin's father, Zengis, who sat in his seat with a wide smile.
He didn't rush forward to help his son, instead simply basking in the glow of victory.
"..." She then glanced at the Asura Empress, who was also calmly seated.
She had removed the curtain and was looking at her son, her thoughts unreadable.
The Asura Empress had red skin and long white hair, her body was well-built and stood over seven feet tall.
Her strength was extremely high. Between Fader, Zengis, and the Empress, no one knew who would win.
In any case, now that the match had concluded and her fate remained just as before,
she would no longer be engaged to Len.
It was time to begin her own plan. It would be great if she could cancel this arrangement before Vritra got here.
With this in mind, Evelyn rose to her feet and began to speak, "Father, I would like to-"
But Fader, fully aware of his daughter's intentions, quickly cut in, "Now, why don't we let our brave fighters rest and heal?"
"Wait-" Evelyn tried to speak again, her brows knitting together in annoyance.
"It is time for you all to leave. Hopefully we will get to witness another exciting match again soon."
After finishing speaking,
Fader quickly clapped his hands, and the entire audience disappeared instantly, leaving the whole place silent.
Len and Armin also disappeared, and only the powerful figures remained.
"Father! What. Are. You. Doing!!" she shouted, staring at her father in rage.

"My daughter, this is not the time for such reckless decisions. Even if you do what you are planning to do, it will bring no results and only make things worse," Fader said, blocking their conversation from reaching the others.
"No, I can-" Evelyn spoke in frustration but was interrupted again.

"I just received a report. There is another major court case. It seems those same gods have caused another huge problem, and it is quite urgent. So, are you going there, or are you planning to stay here? I can send someone in your place."
Fader asked.
Evelyn fell silent. She really wanted to use this chance to cut all ties with Armin.
But it seemed that would truly be impossible. She couldn't understand why her father was trying so hard to stop her.
She even resented her family for seeing her as nothing more than something to be used for their own benefit.
"...I am going there."
In the end, she could only make that decision. If someone else went there,
it could cause trouble for Vritra, but the way her father had suddenly brought up this court case,
it was almost as if he knew she would choose to go. Was it because of the excuse she always gave that she disliked the gods?
Or did he know something?
Whatever the case might be, she simply disappeared, feeling that she might actually punch her father if she stayed there any longer.
Fader stared at the empty space for a bit longer, then laughed and turned around.

"Now, Empress, since you have lost, my daughter will have no relation to Len, and you have already returned the passes to the Secret Realm, so this matter is concluded," he said, looking at the Asura Empress.
"Hmm."
She hummed and rose to her feet before flying away, disappearing as well.

"I am going to see my son, and you had better not play such tricks again. Don't think I don't know what you were trying to do. I will let it pass for Evelyn's sake since she is going to become a member of 'my' family!"
Zengis spoke, emphasizing his words.
"Huh? I wonder what you are talking about, but yeah, the engagement still stands. Take care, and let me know if Armin needs any medicine."
He waved as Zengis disappeared.
"Should we leave too, Father?"
Fader then turned to his own father, Adam, who still sat there staring into the empty space.
"Haa, yeah. That girl is still so impulsive, never thinking about the greater good. She was about to ruin the plan. Well, I guess she will behave once she gets married."
Adam stood up.
"Yes, Father. Right."
Fader nodded while looking at his father with an emotionless expression,
but his thoughts were completely different.
"Anyway, that kid Armin is pretty impressive. I thought he was going to lose. I even placed a huge bet, sigh."
The old man sighed.
"...What bet? You old bas- COUGH... Father, what bet is it this time?!"
Fader felt like pulling his hair out.
"Ah, nothing much. I just made a bet with the Asura Empress that her son would win."
Adam replied casually.
And since Len had lost, Adam had lost the bet as well.
"And what were the conditions this time?"
Fader felt so angry that he wanted to punch his father.
Suddenly he understood Evelyn's feelings.
So this was how badly she wanted to hit him?
"Oh, it wasn't anything serious this time, just your Cloud Palace. But if I had won, I would have taken the entire Asura Realm."
Fader's lips stretched into a thin line as he stared at his father as if he were the biggest idiot alive.
Was it once again because of that cursed witch? The witch who carried a powerful curse upon herself, who stayed with the Asura Empress, and whose curse affected men whenever they were around her.
"You damned bastard!! How dare you give away my beloved Cloud Palace?!!"
That was what Fader wanted to say, but there was no way he could be so disrespectful toward his father.
So, swallowing his anger, he spoke through gritted teeth.
"You motherfucker, what gave you the confidence that you could win after losing more than thirty times? Did your brain come out with your poop?"
Fader asked in a respectful tone.
"W- What? Insolent brat, that is no way to talk! COUGH... Anyway, reflect on what you just said, a-and think of some way to get your Cloud Palace back yourself. That is your punishment!"
After speaking, Adam quickly disappeared.
Fader clutched his head. He felt like he was going crazy.
He looked around, suddenly wanting to take his anger out on someone.
But there was no one left around, so he could only further destroy the entire place.
Deafening roars could be heard for a long while. No wonder the Asura Empress hadn't looked worried at all.
That damned Adam, he really was going to die one of these days.
Unaware of everything her father was going through, Evelyn cursed him with a life of endless misery.
Hoping his teeth would fall out whenever he tried to eat, his bed would burn whenever he slept,
the water would turn into lava whenever he tried to bathe, and his Cloud Palace would completely disappear.
Unknown to her once again, her curses really seemed to be taking effect in real time.
Fader had already lost his most beloved Cloud Palace.
Calming her mind, Evelyn sighed. She knew there was little chance of her plan working out.
But she hadn't expected that she wouldn't even get the chance to try.
'Whatever, at least I am going to see my love again! That is good enough for me, I just wish he would be happy to see me again.'
She wished, her heart would surely soar to the hundredth heaven if only she could see even a little love in his eyes.
While deep in thought, she arrived at the court, her outfit having already changed completely.
She walked toward her seat, a terrifying aura churning around her that silenced the entire court.

No wonder the Asura Empress hadn't looked worried at all.
That damned Adam, he really was going to die one of these days.
Unaware of everything her father was going through, Evelyn cursed him with a life of endless misery.
Hoping his teeth would fall out whenever he tried to eat, his bed would burn whenever he slept,
the water would turn into lava whenever he tried to bathe, and his Cloud Palace would completely disappear.
Unknown to her once again, her curses really seemed to be taking effect in real time.
Fader had already lost his most beloved Cloud Palace.
Calming her mind, Evelyn sighed.
She knew there was little chance of her plan working out.
But she hadn't expected that she wouldn't even get the chance to try.
'Whatever, at least I am going to see my love again!
That is good enough for me, I just wish he would be happy to see me again.'
She wished, her heart would surely soar to the hundredth heaven if only she could see even a little love in his eyes.
While deep in thought, she arrived at the court, her outfit having already changed completely.
She walked toward her seat, a terrifying aura churning around her that silenced the entire court.

chapters.title: Chapter 850 Petonil!
paragraphs: Back inside the game, Vritra and his wives rested for a little while, but soon a message flashed before them.
[You will now be teleported back!]
[All the rewards will be given soon!]
But Vritra knew they wouldn't be sent back to their planet directly.
"Looks like it is time." Vanessa spoke as she stretched her arms and got up.
Then, looking at her son, she pressed her soft, moist pink lips against his, giving him a kiss that lasted nearly a minute.
"My lovely lawyer, are you ready to fight our case?" she asked, making the other women and Vritra laugh.

"Yes, Miss Arclis. You can rest assured, with me taking your case, even if the gods themselves descend, they won't be able to change the verdict!" Vritra spoke confidently before they all burst out laughing.
Soon they got up and walked out of the tent. Vritra stored the bed and tent away into his storage.
Onest and Shitless were also ready, both yawning. They had fallen asleep, it seemed.
"Time for the court case?" Onest asked. It was a world court, yet he wasn't really worried.
If the judge was one of Vritra's women, then there was no way they would lose.
"Yes, we are finally done with this game." Vritra replied.
The next moment, a portal opened before them. Though seeing the other side was impossible, with Null, Vritra and Yennefer could see the interior of the large courtroom.
It was the same as last time, and there were already quite a lot of people seated.
The ten gods were also present there, a dangerous aura surrounding them. They looked really pissed.
Seeing them, Vritra couldn't help but laugh.
And suddenly, he felt that making them wait a little longer wouldn't be a problem.
He looked back at the two men and said, "Go back and sleep a little longer, there is no hurry."
Evelyn hadn't arrived yet anyway, so it wouldn't matter, but this would definitely make the gods puke blood in rage.
'And what better joy is there in life than making those insufferable gods suffer?'
"Really? Won't it cause a problem for us?" Shitless asked, but even while speaking he was already heading back, ready to pull his tent out again.
"No, it's fine. Just sleep as long as you want." Vritra also turned around, amidst the surprised gazes of his wives.
Then they understood and couldn't help but smile. He really wouldn't let any opportunity slip by.
So, without a care, the seven women followed behind Vritra, and after he took out the tent and set a few things inside,
they all entered and decided to rest as well.
Vritra lay down with Vanessa and Yasmine on his left and right. Fiona, upon seeing no space left for herself, decided to sleep on top of him.
This wasn't the first time anyway. Wrapping her arms around him, she gently rested her head on his chest as her supple, voluptuous body pressed against his.
Vritra would have hugged her back, but unfortunately both his hands were being used as pillows by Vanessa and Yasmine.
Still, it felt really nice to be surrounded by such comfortable warmth and softness.
Closing his eyes, Vritra soon fell into a blissful sleep.
Meanwhile, the gods were getting angrier with every minute that passed.
They knew perfectly well how the games worked, and by now a portal must have already appeared there.
Yet the culprits still hadn't arrived. It was obvious Vritra was doing it on purpose.
But they could only remain seated, burning with wrath.
Just like that, eight hours passed.
Vritra was really testing their limits. He would have rested a little longer, but now the portal began to glow and release horn-like sounds.
"Let's go. Haa... that was some good sleep." Vritra sat up, feeling completely refreshed.
After a few minutes they were ready, and after putting away the tent, the group started walking toward the portal.
Vritra took Yasmine's hand and asked while walking, "How are you feeling? There is no problem, right?"
He had been much more attentive ever since she became pregnant and would frequently ask about her physical and mental health.
And Yasmine simply loved all the attention from her husband. Aside from their baby itself, this care made the pregnancy even more worthwhile.
"Yes~ I am feeling great." she replied.
As everyone passed through the portal, they were the last ones to enter.
Before entering, Yasmine stepped in front of him and pressed her soft red lips against his,
giving him a gentle kiss filled with love.
After two seconds, she pulled back, her lips lingering against his for just an instant longer before softly parting.
Vritra was a little surprised, not expecting the kiss, but it felt wonderful.
Finally, the two of them, holding hands with their fingers intertwined, entered the portal.
The moment they stepped through, they saw the large courtroom and felt countless gazes fall upon them.
{Sin Point Gained: Watched +422}
Vritra looked around and found there weren't actually that many people visible. It seemed quite a few were hidden away.
Probably the ones responsible for maintaining law and order here.
Then his gaze swept over the gods, who were glaring back at him.
Their true bodies still couldn't be seen, and they continued to appear in those strange forms: a book, an instrument, a child, an old man, and many others.
Vritra simply gave them a casual smile before sitting down on the opposite side with his family.
The twenty seats were positioned at the front, while the audience sat behind them.
The gods occupied the left section, and Vritra's group sat on the right.
"Yo, didn't expect to meet again after just a few days. I forgot to say goodbye the last time." Vritra spoke calmly, as though greeting a few acquaintances.
The gods didn't reply, but they suddenly remembered when Vritra had fooled them by pretending to be Divine.
They didn't want to bother responding to him. Every word he spoke only made them angrier.
But the audience behind them began whispering among themselves, and although they tried to keep their voices low, they were still quite clear.
"What? Did they really meet again just a few days ago? And judging by the gods' reactions, it seems they were fooled somehow."
"Didn't the gods lose the case last time? I wonder who their lawyer will be this time."
Hearing those words was like rubbing salt into the gods' wounds.
"Where is your lawyer? What was his name again... Pedo... Petophil!" Vritra exclaimed.
"Such a wonderful lawyer. Not only did he get a sentence for his clients, he even managed to get an even bigger sentence for himself."
The ten gods felt like killing all of them right there and then.
They were merely Level 3 Demi Gods,
yet they were acting so brazenly, showing absolutely no respect.

"Just you wait. This time it will be very different. You won't be able to win through deceitful means again. I will wait to see the expression on your face when this is over. I will make you eat your words, make you cry and beg, and all ten of you will receive the gravest punishment!" the Sun God said, his tone steady, as though none of Vritra's taunts had affected him.
"I like your confidence. You have a bright future ahead." Vritra replied. There was no way he would get angry over words like those.
Being able to handle a retort at this level was the bare minimum required to become a top-tier rage baiter.
Soon an announcement echoed throughout the courtroom, instantly silencing everyone.
"The honorable judge has arrived! Everyone stand!"
Just like before, two people appeared beside the judge's chair out of nowhere, speaking in perfect unison.
Everyone in the courtroom immediately rose to their feet as a sign of respect for the beautiful judge who had finally arrived.
Wearing a black outfit that matched Vritra's quite closely, she gracefully walked toward her seat.
No one, not even the gods, dared to stare at her directly. Her beauty was truly unparalleled.
The seven women, however, already knew about her feelings toward Vritra, so they weren't nearly as intimidated.
There wasn't the slightest expression on her gorgeous face as her blonde hair fluttered gently.
Vritra saw her once again. Their meetings had been few, yet she had left a profound mark on his life.
A faint smile appeared on his face. Meeting her again... felt nice.
As Evelyn sat down, everyone else returned to their seats.
The person standing to Evelyn's right presented her with a document containing the details of the case.
"Are the lawyers for both sides present?" Evelyn asked. Her heart was fluttering, yet she hadn't even dared to take a glance at Vritra.
It was as though they could only steal little moments, but somehow that made it even more thrilling.
"Not for the accused's side." the man replied. Then, stepping forward, he asked,
"Will you be defending your own case, or would you like us to arrange a lawyer?"
Vritra stood up. He was feeling such a strong sense of déjà vu.
"I will act as the lawyer for our side and defend our case." he replied, walking to the front.
"And from the gods' side, the lawyer is Petonil!" the same man announced as another person stepped forward.
He was dressed in white attire, stood nearly five feet tall, and carried an unmistakable air of arrogance around him.
Petonil was a lawyer at the God level.
Hearing that name, everyone in the audience exclaimed in shock.
"Isn't that Petophil's father? He is far better than his son. This case... I believe the outcome is already obvious."
"Haa... the gods really went all out. I wonder what they had to give up to invite someone like Petonil here."
"Father, for your son's sake, you must humiliate and defeat them far more thoroughly than what I had to endure!"
Petophil was also present among the audience, but he was too ashamed to show his face openly.
